sanskrit_text: धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः। मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय
transliteration: dharmakṣetre kurukṣetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ, māmakāḥ pāṇḍavāścaiva kimakurvata sañjaya
hindi_meaning: धृतराष्ट्र बोले (टिप्पणी प 0 1.2) - हे संजय! (टिप्पणी प 0 1.3) धर्मभूमि कुरुक्षेत्र में युद्ध की इच्छा से इकट्ठे हुए मेरेे और पाण्डु के पुत्रों ने भी क्या किया?
english_meaning: . Dhṛtarāṣṭrra said: O Sañjaya, what did my sons (and others) and Pāṇḍu's sons (and others) actually do when, eager for battle, they assembled on the sacred field, the Kurukṣetra (Field of the Kurus)?
practical_guidance: Fear and courage live side by side. The Gita doesn't ask you to be fearless — only to act rightly despite the fear. Take one brave step today.

sanskrit_text: दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवानीकं व्यूढं दुर्योधनस्तदा। आचार्यमुपसङ्गम्य राजा वचनमब्रवीत्
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tu pāṇḍavānīkaṃ vyūḍhaṃ duryodhanastadā, ācāryamupasaṅgamya rājā vacanamabravīt
hindi_meaning: संजय बोले - उस समय वज्रव्यूह-से खड़ी हुई पाण्डव-सेना को देखकर राजा दुर्योधन द्रोणाचार्य के पास जाकर यह वचन बोला।
english_meaning: Sanjaya said But then, seeing the army of the Pandavas in battle array, King Duryodhana approached the teacher (Drona) and uttered a speech:
practical_guidance: Fear and courage live side by side. The Gita doesn't ask you to be fearless — only to act rightly despite the fear. Take one brave step today.

sanskrit_text: पश्यैतां पाण्डुपुत्राणामाचार्य महतीं चमूम्। व्यूढां द्रुपदपुत्रेण तव शिष्येण धीमता
transliteration: paśyaitāṃ pāṇḍuputrāṇāmācārya mahatīṃ camūm, vyūḍhāṃ drupadaputreṇa tava śiṣyeṇa dhīmatā
hindi_meaning: हे आचार्य! आपके बुद्धिमान् शिष्य द्रुपदपुत्र धृष्टद्युम्न के द्वारा व्यूहरचना से खड़ी की हुई पाण्डवों की इस बड़ी भारी सेना को देखिये
english_meaning: O teacher, (please) see this vast army of the sons of Pandu, arrayed for battle by the son of Drupada, your intelligent disciple.
practical_guidance: Fear and courage live side by side. The Gita doesn't ask you to be fearless — only to act rightly despite the fear. Take one brave step today.

sanskrit_text: अत्र शूरा महेष्वासा भीमार्जुनसमा युधि। युयुधानो विराटश्च द्रुपदश्च महारथः
transliteration: atra śūrā maheṣvāsā bhīmārjunasamā yudhi, yuyudhāno virāṭaśca drupadaśca mahārathaḥ
hindi_meaning: -- 1.6।। यहाँ (पाण्डवों की सेना में) बड़े-बड़े शूरवीर हैं, जिनके बहुत बड़े-बड़े धनुष हैं तथा जो युद्ध में भीम और अर्जुनके समान हैं। उनमें युयुधान (सात्यकि), राजा विराट और महारथी द्रुपद भी हैं। धृष्टकेतु और चेकितान तथा पराक्रमी काशिराज भी हैं। पुरुजित् और कुन्तिभोज--ये दोनों भाई तथा मनुष्योंमें श्रेष्ठ शैब्य भी हैं। पराक्रमी युधामन्यु और पराक्रमी उत्तमौजा भी हैं। सुभद्रापुत्र अभिमन्यु और द्रौपदी के पाँचों पुत्र भी हैं। ये सब-के-सब महारथी हैं।
english_meaning: Here are the heroes wielding great bows, who in battle are compeers of Bhima and Arjuna: Yuyudhana (Satyaki) and Virata, and the maharatha (great chariot-rider) Drupada;
practical_guidance: Fear and courage live side by side. The Gita doesn't ask you to be fearless — only to act rightly despite the fear. Take one brave step today.

sanskrit_text: धृष्टकेतुश्चेकितानः काशिराजश्च वीर्यवान्। पुरुजित्कुन्तिभोजश्च शैब्यश्च नरपुङ्गवः
transliteration: dhṛṣṭaketuścekitānaḥ kāśirājaśca vīryavān, purujitkuntibhojaśca śaibyaśca narapuṅgavaḥ
hindi_meaning: -- 1.6।। यहाँ (पाण्डवों की सेना में) बड़े-बड़े शूरवीर हैं, जिनके बहुत बड़े-बड़े धनुष हैं तथा जो युद्ध में भीम और अर्जुनके समान हैं। उनमें युयुधान (सात्यकि), राजा विराट और महारथी द्रुपद भी हैं। धृष्टकेतु और चेकितान तथा पराक्रमी काशिराज भी हैं। पुरुजित् और कुन्तिभोज--ये दोनों भाई तथा मनुष्योंमें श्रेष्ठ शैब्य भी हैं। पराक्रमी युधामन्यु और पराक्रमी उत्तमौजा भी हैं। सुभद्रापुत्र अभिमन्यु और द्रौपदी के पाँचों पुत्र भी हैं। ये सब-के-सब महारथी हैं।
english_meaning: Dhrstaketu, Cekitana, and the valiant king of Kasi (Varanasi); Purujit and Kuntibhoja, and Saibya, the choicest among men;
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्त उत्तमौजाश्च वीर्यवान्। सौभद्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्व एव महारथाः
transliteration: yudhāmanyuśca vikrānta uttamaujāśca vīryavān, saubhadro draupadeyāśca sarva eva mahārathāḥ
hindi_meaning: -- 1.6।। यहाँ (पाण्डवों की सेना में) बड़े-बड़े शूरवीर हैं, जिनके बहुत बड़े-बड़े धनुष हैं तथा जो युद्ध में भीम और अर्जुनके समान हैं। उनमें युयुधान (सात्यकि), राजा विराट और महारथी द्रुपद भी हैं। धृष्टकेतु और चेकितान तथा पराक्रमी काशिराज भी हैं। पुरुजित् और कुन्तिभोज--ये दोनों भाई तथा मनुष्योंमें श्रेष्ठ शैब्य भी हैं। पराक्रमी युधामन्यु और पराक्रमी उत्तमौजा भी हैं। सुभद्रापुत्र अभिमन्यु और द्रौपदी के पाँचों पुत्र भी हैं। ये सब-के-सब महारथी हैं।
english_meaning: And the chivalrous Yudhamanyu, and the valiant Uttamaujas; son of Subhadra (Abhimanyu) and the sons of Draupadi all (of whom) are, verily, maharathas.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम। नायका मम सैन्यस्य संज्ञार्थं तान्ब्रवीमि ते
transliteration: asmākaṃ tu viśiṣṭā ye tānnibodha dvijottama, nāyakā mama sainyasya saṃjñārthaṃ tānbravīmi te
hindi_meaning: हे द्विजोत्तम! हमारे पक्ष में भी जो मुख्य हैं, उनपर भी आप ध्यान दीजिये। आपको याद दिलाने के लिये मेरी सेना के जो नायक हैं, उनको मैं कहता हूँ।
english_meaning: But, O best among the Brahmanas, please be appraised of those who are foremost among us, the ?nders of my army. I speak of them to you by way of example.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: भवान्भीष्मश्च कर्णश्च कृपश्च समितिञ्जयः। अश्वत्थामा विकर्णश्च सौमदत्तिस्तथैव च
transliteration: bhavānbhīṣmaśca karṇaśca kṛpaśca samitiñjayaḥ, aśvatthāmā vikarṇaśca saumadattistathaiva ca
hindi_meaning: आप (द्रोणाचार्य) और पितामह भीष्म तथा कर्ण और संग्रामविजयी कृपाचार्य तथा वैसे ही अश्वत्थामा, विकर्ण और सोमदत्त का पुत्र भूरिश्रवा।
english_meaning: (They are:) Your venerable self, Bhisma and Karna, and Krpa who is ever victorious in battle; Asvatthama, Vikarna, Saumadatti and Jayadratha.
practical_guidance: Fear and courage live side by side. The Gita doesn't ask you to be fearless — only to act rightly despite the fear. Take one brave step today.

sanskrit_text: अन्ये च बहवः शूरा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः। नानाशस्त्रप्रहरणाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः
transliteration: anye ca bahavaḥ śūrā madarthe tyaktajīvitāḥ, nānāśastrapraharaṇāḥ sarve yuddhaviśāradāḥ
hindi_meaning: इनके अतिरिक्त बहुत-से शूरवीर हैं, जिन्होंने मेरे लिये अपने जीने की इच्छा का भी त्याग कर दिया है और जो अनेक प्रकार के शस्त्र-अस्त्रों को चलानेवाले हैं तथा जो सब-के-सब युद्धकला में अत्यन्त चतुर हैं।
english_meaning: There are many heroes who have dedicated their lives for my sake, who possess various kinds of weapons and missiles, (and) all of whom are skilled in battle.
practical_guidance: Fear and courage live side by side. The Gita doesn't ask you to be fearless — only to act rightly despite the fear. Take one brave step today.

sanskrit_text: अपर्याप्तं तदस्माकं बलं भीष्माभिरक्षितम्। पर्याप्तं त्विदमेतेषां बलं भीमाभिरक्षितम्
transliteration: aparyāptaṃ tadasmākaṃ balaṃ bhīṣmābhirakṣitam, paryāptaṃ tvidameteṣāṃ balaṃ bhīmābhirakṣitam
hindi_meaning: वह हमारी सेना पाण्डवों पर विजय करने में अपर्याप्त है, असमर्थ है; क्योंकि उसके संरक्षक (उभयपक्षपाती) भीष्म हैं। परन्तु इन पाण्डवों की सेना हमारे पर विजय करने में पर्याप्त है, समर्थ है; क्योंकि इसके संरक्षक (निजसेनापक्षपाती) भीमसेन हैं।
english_meaning: Therefore, our army under the complete protection of Bhisma and others is unlimited. But this army of these (enemies), under the protection of Bhima and others is limited.
practical_guidance: What burden are you carrying that you don't need to carry alone? Offer it up. Trust that the universe holds more than your worry does.

sanskrit_text: अयनेषु च सर्वेषु यथाभागमवस्थिताः। भीष्ममेवाभिरक्षन्तु भवन्तः सर्व एव हि
transliteration: ayaneṣu ca sarveṣu yathābhāgamavasthitāḥ, bhīṣmamevābhirakṣantu bhavantaḥ sarva eva hi
hindi_meaning: आप सब-के-सब लोग सभी मोर्चों पर अपनी-अपनी जगह दृढ़ता से स्थित रहते हुए ही पितामह भीष्म की चारों ओर से रक्षा करें।
english_meaning: However, venerable sirs, all of you without exception, while occupying all the positions in the different directions as alloted (to you respectively), please fully protect Bhisma in particular.
practical_guidance: Sit quietly for five minutes. Ask: 'What is the most meaningful thing I can contribute?' Let the answer arise naturally, without forcing it.

sanskrit_text: तस्य संजनयन्हर्षं कुरुवृद्धः पितामहः। सिंहनादं विनद्योच्चैः शङ्खं दध्मौ प्रतापवान्
transliteration: tasya saṃjanayanharṣaṃ kuruvṛddhaḥ pitāmahaḥ, siṃhanādaṃ vinadyoccaiḥ śaṅkhaṃ dadhmau pratāpavān
hindi_meaning: दुर्योधन के हृदय में हर्ष उत्पन्न करते हुए कुरुवृद्ध प्रभावशाली पितामह भीष्म ने सिंह के समान गरज कर जोर से शंख बजाया।
english_meaning: The valiant grandfather, the eldest of the Kurus, loudly sounding a lion-roar, blew the conch to raise his (Duryodhana's) spirits.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च पणवानकगोमुखाः। सहसैवाभ्यहन्यन्त स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत्
transliteration: tataḥ śaṅkhāśca bheryaśca paṇavānakagomukhāḥ, sahasaivābhyahanyanta sa śabdastumulo'bhavat
hindi_meaning: उसके बाद शंख, भेरी (नगाड़े), ढोल, मृदङ्ग और नरसिंघे बाजे एक साथ बज उठे। उनका वह शब्द बड़ा भयंकर हुआ।
english_meaning: Just immediately after that conchs and kettledrums, and tabors, trumpets and cow-horns blared forth. That sound became tumultuous.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: ततः श्वेतैर्हयैर्युक्ते महति स्यन्दने स्थितौ। माधवः पाण्डवश्चैव दिव्यौ शङ्खौ प्रदध्मतुः
transliteration: tataḥ śvetairhayairyukte mahati syandane sthitau, mādhavaḥ pāṇḍavaścaiva divyau śaṅkhau pradadhmatuḥ
hindi_meaning: उसके बाद सफेद घोड़ों से युक्त महान् रथ पर बैठे हुए लक्ष्मीपति भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण और पाण्डुपुत्र अर्जुन ने दिव्य शंखों को बड़े जोर से बजाया।
english_meaning: Then, Madhava (Krsna) and the son of Pandu (Arjuna), stationed in their magnificent chariot with white horses yoked to it, loudly blew their divine conchs.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: पाञ्चजन्यं हृषीकेशो देवदत्तं धनंजयः। पौण्ड्रं दध्मौ महाशङ्खं भीमकर्मा वृकोदरः
transliteration: pāñcajanyaṃ hṛṣīkeśo devadattaṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ, pauṇḍraṃ dadhmau mahāśaṅkhaṃ bhīmakarmā vṛkodaraḥ
hindi_meaning: अन्तर्यामी भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण ने पाञ्चजन्य नामक तथा धनञ्जय अर्जुन ने देवदत्त नामक शंख बजाया; और भयानक कर्म करनेवाले वृकोदर भीम ने पौण्ड्र नामक महाशंख बजाया।
english_meaning: Hrsikesa (Krsna) (blew the conch) Pancajanya; Dhananjaya (Arjuna) (the conch) Devadatta; and Vrkodara (Bhima) of terrible deeds blew the great conch Paundra;
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: अनन्तविजयं राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च सुघोषमणिपुष्पकौ
transliteration: anantavijayaṃ rājā kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ, nakulaḥ sahadevaśca sughoṣamaṇipuṣpakau
hindi_meaning: कुन्तीपुत्र राजा युधिष्ठिर ने अनन्तविजय नामक शंख बजाया तथा नकुल और सहदेव ने सुघोष और मणिपुष्पक नामक शंख बजाये।
english_meaning: King Yudhisthira, son of Kunti, (blew) the Anantavijaya; Nakula and Sahadeva, the Sughosa and the Manipuspaka (respectively).
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: काश्यश्च परमेष्वासः शिखण्डी च महारथः। धृष्टद्युम्नो विराटश्च सात्यकिश्चापराजितः
transliteration: kāśyaśca parameṣvāsaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca mahārathaḥ, dhṛṣṭadyumno virāṭaśca sātyakiścāparājitaḥ
hindi_meaning: -- 1.18।। हे राजन्! श्रेष्ठ धनुषवाले काशिराज और महारथी शिखण्डी तथा धृष्टद्युम्न एवं राजा विराट और अजेय सात्यकि, राजा द्रुपद और द्रौपदी के पाँचों पुत्र तथा लम्बी-लम्बी भुजाओंवाले सुभद्रा-पुत्र अभिमन्यु - इन सभी ने सब ओर से अलग-अलग (अपने-अपने) शंख बजाये।
english_meaning: And the King of Kasi, wielding a great bow, and the great chariot-rider Sikhandi, Dhrstadyumna and Virata, and Satyaki the unconered;
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: द्रुपदो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः पृथिवीपते। सौभद्रश्च महाबाहुः शङ्खान्दध्मुः पृथक्पृथक्
transliteration: drupado draupadeyāśca sarvaśaḥ pṛthivīpate, saubhadraśca mahābāhuḥ śaṅkhāndadhmuḥ pṛthakpṛthak
hindi_meaning: -- 1.18।। हे राजन्! श्रेष्ठ धनुषवाले काशिराज और महारथी शिखण्डी तथा धृष्टद्युम्न एवं राजा विराट और अजेय सात्यकि, राजा द्रुपद और द्रौपदी के पाँचों पुत्र तथा लम्बी-लम्बी भुजाओंवाले सुभद्रा-पुत्र अभिमन्यु - इन सभी ने सब ओर से अलग-अलग (अपने-अपने) शंख बजाये।
english_meaning: Drupada and the sons of Draupadi, and the son of Subhadra, (Abhimanyu) the mighty-armed all (of them) together, O king, blew their respective conchs.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: स घोषो धार्तराष्ट्राणां हृदयानि व्यदारयत्। नभश्च पृथिवीं चैव तुमुलो व्यनुनादयन्
transliteration: sa ghoṣo dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ hṛdayāni vyadārayat, nabhaśca pṛthivīṃ caiva tumulo vyanunādayan
hindi_meaning: पाण्डव-सेना के शंखों के उस भयंकर शब्द ने आकाश और पृथ्वी को भी गुँजाते हुए अन्यायपूर्वक राज्य हड़पनेवाले दुर्योधन आदि के हृदय विदीर्ण कर दिये।
english_meaning: That tremendous sound pierced the hearts of the sons of Dhrtarastra as it reverberated through the sky and the earth.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: अथ व्यवस्थितान् दृष्ट्वा धार्तराष्ट्रान्कपिध्वजः। प्रवृत्ते शस्त्रसंपाते धनुरुद्यम्य पाण्डवः
transliteration: atha vyavasthitān dṛṣṭvā dhārtarāṣṭrānkapidhvajaḥ, pravṛtte śastrasaṃpāte dhanurudyamya pāṇḍavaḥ
hindi_meaning: हे महीपते! धृतराष्ट्र! अब शस्त्रों के चलने की तैयारी हो ही रही थी कि उस समय अन्यायपूर्वक राज्य को धारण करनेवाले राजाओं और उनके साथियों को व्यवस्थितरूप से सामने खड़े हुए देखकर कपिध्वज पाण्डुपुत्र अर्जुन ने अपना गाण्डीव धनुष उठा लिया और अन्तर्यामी भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण से ये वचन बोले।
english_meaning: O king, thereafter, seeing Dhrtarastra's men standing in their positions, when all the weapons were ready for action, the son of Pandu (Arjuna) who had the insignia of Hanuman of his chariot-flag, raising up his bow, said the following to Hrsikesa.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: हृषीकेशं तदा वाक्यमिदमाह महीपते। सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये रथं स्थापय मेऽच्युत
transliteration: hṛṣīkeśaṃ tadā vākyamidamāha mahīpate, senayorubhayormadhye rathaṃ sthāpaya me'cyuta
hindi_meaning: -- 1.22।। अर्जुन बोले - हे अच्युत! दोनों सेनाओं के मध्य में मेरे रथ को आप तब तक खड़ा कीजिये, जब तक मैं युद्धक्षेत्र में खड़े हुए इन युद्ध की इच्छावालों को देख न लूँ कि इस युद्धरूप उद्योग में मुझे किन-किन के साथ युद्ध करना योग्य है।
english_meaning: Arjuna said O Acyuta, please place my chariot between both the armies .
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: यावदेतान्निरीक्षेऽहं योद्धुकामानवस्थितान्। कैर्मया सह योद्धव्यमस्मिन्रणसमुद्यमे
transliteration: yāvadetānnirīkṣe'haṃ yoddhukāmānavasthitān, kairmayā saha yoddhavyamasminraṇasamudyame
hindi_meaning: -- 1.22।। अर्जुन बोले - हे अच्युत! दोनों सेनाओं के मध्य में मेरे रथ को आप तब तक खड़ा कीजिये, जब तक मैं युद्धक्षेत्र में खड़े हुए इन युद्ध की इच्छावालों को देख न लूँ कि इस युद्धरूप उद्योग में मुझे किन-किनके साथ युद्ध करना योग्य है।
english_meaning: until I survey these who stand intent on fighting, and those who are going to engage in battle with me in this impending war.
practical_guidance: Fear and courage live side by side. The Gita doesn't ask you to be fearless — only to act rightly despite the fear. Take one brave step today.

sanskrit_text: योत्स्यमानानवेक्षेऽहं य एतेऽत्र समागताः। धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्बुद्धेर्युद्धे प्रियचिकीर्षवः
transliteration: yotsyamānānavekṣe'haṃ ya ete'tra samāgatāḥ, dhārtarāṣṭrasya durbuddheryuddhe priyacikīrṣavaḥ
hindi_meaning: दुष्टबुद्धि दुर्योधन का युद्ध में प्रिय करने की इच्छावाले जो ये राजालोग इस सेना में आये हुए हैं, युद्ध करने को उतावले हुए इन सबको मैं देख लूँ।
english_meaning: These who have assembled here and want to accomplish in the war what is dear to the perverted son of Dhrtarastra, I find them to be intent on fighting.
practical_guidance: Fear and courage live side by side. The Gita doesn't ask you to be fearless — only to act rightly despite the fear. Take one brave step today.

sanskrit_text: एवमुक्तो हृषीकेशो गुडाकेशेन भारत। सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये स्थापयित्वा रथोत्तमम्
transliteration: evamukto hṛṣīkeśo guḍākeśena bhārata, senayorubhayormadhye sthāpayitvā rathottamam
hindi_meaning: -- 1.25।। संजय बोले - हे भरतवंशी राजन्! निद्राविजयी अर्जुन के द्वारा इस तरह कहने पर अन्तर्यामी भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण ने दोनों सेनाओं के मध्यभाग में पितामह भीष्म और आचार्य द्रोण के सामने तथा सम्पूर्ण राजाओं के सामने श्रेष्ठ रथ को खड़ा करके इस तरह कहा कि 'हे पार्थ! इन इकट्ठे हुए कुरुवंशियोंको देख'।
english_meaning: 1.25 Sanjay said O scion of the line of Bharata (Dhrtararastra), Hrsikesa, being told so by Gudakesa (Arjuna), placed the excellent chariot between the two armies, in front of Bhisma and Drona as also all the rulers of the earth, and said, 'O Partha (Arjuna), see these assempled people of the Kuru dynasty.'
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: भीष्मद्रोणप्रमुखतः सर्वेषां च महीक्षिताम्। उवाच पार्थ पश्यैतान्समवेतान्कुरूनिति
transliteration: bhīṣmadroṇapramukhataḥ sarveṣāṃ ca mahīkṣitām, uvāca pārtha paśyaitānsamavetānkurūniti
hindi_meaning: -- 1.25।। संजय बोले - हे भरतवंशी राजन्! निद्राविजयी अर्जुन के द्वारा इस तरह कहने पर अन्तर्यामी भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण ने दोनों सेनाओं के मध्यभाग में पितामह भीष्म और आचार्य द्रोण के सामने तथा सम्पूर्ण राजाओं के सामने श्रेष्ठ रथको खड़ा करके इस तरह कहा कि 'हे पार्थ! इन इकट्ठे हुए कुरुवंशियोंको देख'।
english_meaning: 1.25 Sanjay said O scion of the line of Bharata (Dhrtararastra), Hrsikesa, being told so by Gudakesa (Arjuna), placed the excellent chariot between the two armies, in front of Bhisma and Drona as also all the rulers of the earth, and said, 'O Partha (Arjuna), see these assempled people of the Kuru dynasty.'
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: तत्रापश्यत्स्थितान्पार्थः पितृ़नथ पितामहान्। आचार्यान्मातुलान्भ्रातृ़न्पुत्रान्पौत्रान्सखींस्तथा
transliteration: tatrāpaśyatsthitānpārthaḥ pitṛ़natha pitāmahān, ācāryānmātulānbhrātṛ़nputrānpautrānsakhīṃstathā
hindi_meaning: उसके बाद पृथानन्दन अर्जुनने उन दोनों ही सेनाओंमें स्थित पिताओंको, पितामहोंको, आचार्योंको, मामाओंको, भाइयोंको, पुत्रोंको, पौत्रोंको तथा मित्रोंको, ससुरोंको और सुहृदोंको भी देखा।
english_meaning: Then Partha (Arjuna) saw, marshalled among both the armies, (his) uncles as also grandfathers, teachers, maternal uncles, brothers (and (cousins), sons, grandsons, as well as comrades and fathers-in-law and friends.
practical_guidance: You cannot undo the past, only respond to it now. Forgive yourself as you would a dear friend who made a mistake. Then take one right action today.

sanskrit_text: श्वशुरान्सुहृदश्चैव सेनयोरुभयोरपि। तान्समीक्ष्य स कौन्तेयः सर्वान्बन्धूनवस्थितान्
transliteration: śvaśurānsuhṛdaścaiva senayorubhayorapi, tānsamīkṣya sa kaunteyaḥ sarvānbandhūnavasthitān
hindi_meaning: अपनी-अपनी जगह पर स्थित उन सम्पूर्ण बान्धवों को देखकर वे कुन्तीनन्दन अर्जुन अत्यन्त कायरता से युक्त होकर विषाद करते हुए ये वचन बोले।
english_meaning: The son of Kunti (Ajuna), seeing all those rlatives arrayed (there), became overwhelmed by supreme compassion and said this sorrowfully:
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: कृपया परयाऽऽविष्टो विषीदन्निदमब्रवीत्। दृष्ट्वेमं स्वजनं कृष्ण युयुत्सुं समुपस्थितम्
transliteration: kṛpayā parayā''viṣṭo viṣīdannidamabravīt, dṛṣṭvemaṃ svajanaṃ kṛṣṇa yuyutsuṃ samupasthitam
hindi_meaning: -- 1.30।। अर्जुन बोले - हे कृष्ण! युद्ध की इच्छावाले इस कुटुम्ब-समुदाय को अपने सामने उपस्थित देखकर मेरे अङ्ग शिथिल हो रहे हैं और मुख सूख रहा है तथा मेरे शरीर में कँपकँपी आ रही है एवं रोंगटे खड़े हो रहे हैं। हाथ से गाण्डीव धनुष गिर रहा है और त्वचा भी जल रही है। मेरा मन भ्रमित-सा हो रहा है और मैं खड़े रहने में भी असमर्थ हो रहा हूँ।
english_meaning: Arjuna said O Krsna, seeing these relatives and friends who have assembled here with the intention of fighting, my limbs become languid and my mouth becomes completely dry.
practical_guidance: Fear and courage live side by side. The Gita doesn't ask you to be fearless — only to act rightly despite the fear. Take one brave step today.

sanskrit_text: सीदन्ति मम गात्राणि मुखं च परिशुष्यति। वेपथुश्च शरीरे मे रोमहर्षश्च जायते
transliteration: sīdanti mama gātrāṇi mukhaṃ ca pariśuṣyati, vepathuśca śarīre me romaharṣaśca jāyate
hindi_meaning: -- 1.30।। अर्जुन बोले - हे कृष्ण! युद्ध की इच्छावाले इस कुटुम्ब-समुदाय को अपने सामने उपस्थित देखकर मेरे अङ्ग शिथिल हो रहे हैं और मुख सूख रहा है तथा मेरे शरीर में कँपकँपी आ रही है एवं रोंगटे खड़े हो रहे हैं। हाथ से गाण्डीव धनुष गिर रहा है और त्वचा भी जल रही है। मेरा मन भ्रमित-सा हो रहा है और मैं खड़े रहने में भी असमर्थ हो रहा हूँ।
english_meaning: And there is trembling in my body, and there is horripillation; the Gandiva (bow) slips from the hand and even the skin burns intensely.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: गाण्डीवं स्रंसते हस्तात्त्वक्चैव परिदह्यते। न च शक्नोम्यवस्थातुं भ्रमतीव च मे मनः
transliteration: gāṇḍīvaṃ sraṃsate hastāttvakcaiva paridahyate, na ca śaknomyavasthātuṃ bhramatīva ca me manaḥ
hindi_meaning: -- 1.30।। अर्जुन बोले - हे कृष्ण! युद्ध की इच्छावाले इस कुटुम्ब-समुदाय को अपने सामने उपस्थित देखकर मेरे अङ्ग शिथिल हो रहे हैं और मुख सूख रहा है तथा मेरे शरीर में कँपकँपी आ रही है एवं रोंगटे खड़े हो रहे हैं। हाथ से गाण्डीव धनुष गिर रहा है और त्वचा भी जल रही है। मेरा मन भ्रमित-सा हो रहा है और मैं खड़े रहने में भी असमर्थ हो रहा हूँ।
english_meaning: Moreover, O Kesava (Krsna), I am not able to stand firmly, and my mind seems to be whirling. And I notice the omens to be adverse.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: निमित्तानि च पश्यामि विपरीतानि केशव। न च श्रेयोऽनुपश्यामि हत्वा स्वजनमाहवे
transliteration: nimittāni ca paśyāmi viparītāni keśava, na ca śreyo'nupaśyāmi hatvā svajanamāhave
hindi_meaning: हे केशव! मैं लक्षणों - (शकुनों) को भी विपरीत देख रहा हूँ और युद्ध में स्वजनोंको मारकर श्रेय (लाभ) भी नहीं देख रहा हूँ।
english_meaning: Besides, I do not see any good (to be derived) from killing my own people in battle. O Krsna, I do not hanker after victory, nor even a kingdom nor pleasures.
practical_guidance: Fear and courage live side by side. The Gita doesn't ask you to be fearless — only to act rightly despite the fear. Take one brave step today.

sanskrit_text: न काङ्क्षे विजयं कृष्ण न च राज्यं सुखानि च। किं नो राज्येन गोविन्द किं भोगैर्जीवितेन वा
transliteration: na kāṅkṣe vijayaṃ kṛṣṇa na ca rājyaṃ sukhāni ca, kiṃ no rājyena govinda kiṃ bhogairjīvitena vā
hindi_meaning: हे कृष्ण! मैं न तो विजय चाहता हूँ, न राज्य चाहता हूँ और न सुखों को ही चाहता हूँ। हे गोविन्द! हमलोगों को राज्य से क्या लाभ? भोगों से क्या लाभ? अथवा जीने से भी क्या लाभ?
english_meaning: 1.34 O Govinda! What need do we have of a kingdom, or what (need) of enjoyments and livelihood? Those for whom kingdom, enjoyments and pleasures ae desired by us, viz teachers, uncles, fathers-in-law, grandsons, brothers-in-law as also relatives-those very ones stand arrayed for battle risking their lives and wealth.
practical_guidance: Cravings are temporary visitors — they will pass. When an urge arises, pause for three slow breaths before responding. The gap is where freedom lives.

sanskrit_text: येषामर्थे काङ्क्षितं नो राज्यं भोगाः सुखानि च। त इमेऽवस्थिता युद्धे प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा धनानि च
transliteration: yeṣāmarthe kāṅkṣitaṃ no rājyaṃ bhogāḥ sukhāni ca, ta ime'vasthitā yuddhe prāṇāṃstyaktvā dhanāni ca
hindi_meaning: जिनके लिये हमारी राज्य, भोग और सुखकी इच्छा है, वे ही ये सब अपने प्राणों की और धन की आशा का त्याग करके युद्ध में खड़े हैं।
english_meaning: 1.34 O Govinda! What need do we have of a kingdom, or what (need) of enjoyments and livelihood? Those for whom kingdom, enjoyments and pleasures ae desired by us, viz teachers, uncles, fathers-in-law, grandsons, brothers-in-law as also relatives-those very ones stand arrayed for battle risking their lives and wealth.
practical_guidance: Cravings are temporary visitors — they will pass. When an urge arises, pause for three slow breaths before responding. The gap is where freedom lives.

sanskrit_text: आचार्याः पितरः पुत्रास्तथैव च पितामहाः। मातुलाः श्वशुराः पौत्राः श्यालाः सम्बन्धिनस्तथा
transliteration: ācāryāḥ pitaraḥ putrāstathaiva ca pitāmahāḥ, mātulāḥ śvaśurāḥ pautrāḥ śyālāḥ sambandhinastathā
hindi_meaning: -- 1.35।। (टिप्पणी प 0 24.1) आचार्य, पिता, पुत्र और उसी प्रकार पितामह, मामा, ससुर, पौत्र, साले तथा अन्य जितने भी सम्बन्धी हैं, मुझ पर प्रहार करने पर भी मैं इनको मारना नहीं चाहता, और हे मधुसूदन! मुझे त्रिलोकी का राज्य मिलता हो, तो भी मैं इनको मारना नहीं चाहता, फिर पृथ्वी के लिये तो (मैं इनको मारूँ ही) क्या?
english_meaning: 1.34 O Govinda! What need do we have of a kingdom, or what (need) of enjoyments and livelihood? Those for whom kingdom, enjoyments and pleasures ae desired by us, viz teachers, uncles, fathers-in-law, grandsons, brothers-in-law as also relatives-those very ones stand arrayed for battle risking their lives and wealth.
practical_guidance: Cravings are temporary visitors — they will pass. When an urge arises, pause for three slow breaths before responding. The gap is where freedom lives.

sanskrit_text: एतान्न हन्तुमिच्छामि घ्नतोऽपि मधुसूदन। अपि त्रैलोक्यराज्यस्य हेतोः किं नु महीकृते
transliteration: etānna hantumicchāmi ghnato'pi madhusūdana, api trailokyarājyasya hetoḥ kiṃ nu mahīkṛte
hindi_meaning: -- 1.35।। (टिप्पणी प 0 24.1) आचार्य, पिता, पुत्र और उसी प्रकार पितामह, मामा, ससुर, पौत्र, साले तथा अन्य जितने भी सम्बन्धी हैं, मुझपर प्रहार करने पर भी मैं इनको मारना नहीं चाहता, और हे मधुसूदन! मुझे त्रिलोकी का राज्य मिलता हो, तो भी मैं इनको मारना नहीं चाहता, फिर पृथ्वीके लिये तो (मैं इनको मारूँ ही) क्या?
english_meaning: O Madhusudana, even if I am killed, I do not want to kill these even for the sake of a kingdom extending over the three worlds; what to speak of doing so for the earth!
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: निहत्य धार्तराष्ट्रान्नः का प्रीतिः स्याज्जनार्दन। पापमेवाश्रयेदस्मान्हत्वैतानाततायिनः
transliteration: nihatya dhārtarāṣṭrānnaḥ kā prītiḥ syājjanārdana, pāpamevāśrayedasmānhatvaitānātatāyinaḥ
hindi_meaning: हे जनार्दन! इन धृतराष्ट्र-सम्बन्धियों को मारकर हमलोगों को क्या प्रसन्नता होगी? इन आततायियों को मारने से तो हमें पाप ही लगेगा।
english_meaning: O Janardana, what happiness shall we derive by killing the sons of Dhrtarastra? Sin alone will accrue to us by killing these felons.
practical_guidance: You cannot undo the past, only respond to it now. Forgive yourself as you would a dear friend who made a mistake. Then take one right action today.

sanskrit_text: तस्मान्नार्हा वयं हन्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रान्स्वबान्धवान्। स्वजनं हि कथं हत्वा सुखिनः स्याम माधव
transliteration: tasmānnārhā vayaṃ hantuṃ dhārtarāṣṭrānsvabāndhavān, svajanaṃ hi kathaṃ hatvā sukhinaḥ syāma mādhava
hindi_meaning: इसलिये अपने बान्धव इन धृतराष्ट्र-सम्बन्धियों को मारने के लिये हम योग्य नहीं हैं; क्योंकि हे माधव! अपने कुटुम्बियों को मारकर हम कैसे सुखी होंगे?
english_meaning: Therefore, it is not proper for us to kill the sons of Dhrtarastra who are our own relatives. For, O Madhava, how can we be happy by killing our kinsmen?
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: यद्यप्येते न पश्यन्ति लोभोपहतचेतसः। कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं मित्रद्रोहे च पातकम्
transliteration: yadyapyete na paśyanti lobhopahatacetasaḥ, kulakṣayakṛtaṃ doṣaṃ mitradrohe ca pātakam
hindi_meaning: -- 1.39।। यद्यपि लोभ के कारण जिनका विवेक-विचार लुप्त हो गया है, ऐसे ये (दुर्योधन आदि) कुल का नाश करने से होनेवाले दोष को और मित्रों के साथ द्वेष करने से होनेवाले पाप को नहीं देखते, (तो भी) हे जनार्दन! कुल का नाश करने से होनेवाले दोष को ठीक-ठीक जाननेवाले हमलोग इस पाप से निवृत्त होने का विचार क्यों न करें?
english_meaning: 1.39 O Janardana, although these people, whose hearts have become perverted by greed, do not see the evil arising from destroying the family and sin in hostility towards, friends, yet how can we who clearly see the evil arising from destroying the family remain unaware of (the need of) abstaining from this sin?
practical_guidance: You cannot undo the past, only respond to it now. Forgive yourself as you would a dear friend who made a mistake. Then take one right action today.

sanskrit_text: कथं न ज्ञेयमस्माभिः पापादस्मान्निवर्तितुम्। कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं प्रपश्यद्भिर्जनार्दन
transliteration: kathaṃ na jñeyamasmābhiḥ pāpādasmānnivartitum, kulakṣayakṛtaṃ doṣaṃ prapaśyadbhirjanārdana
hindi_meaning: -- 1.39।। यद्यपि लोभ के कारण जिनका विवेक-विचार लुप्त हो गया है, ऐसे ये (दुर्योधन आदि) कुल का नाश करने से होनेवाले दोष को और मित्रों के साथ द्वेष करने से होनेवाले पाप को नहीं देखते, (तो भी) हे जनार्दन! कुल का नाश करने से होनेवाले दोष को ठीक-ठीक जाननेवाले हमलोग इस पाप से निवृत्त होनेका विचार क्यों न करें?
english_meaning: 1.39 O Janardana, although these people, whose hearts have become perverted by greed, do not see the evil arising from destroying the family and sin in hostility towards, friends, yet how can we who clearly see the evil arising from destroying the family remain unaware of (the need of) abstaining from this sin?
practical_guidance: You cannot undo the past, only respond to it now. Forgive yourself as you would a dear friend who made a mistake. Then take one right action today.

sanskrit_text: कुलक्षये प्रणश्यन्ति कुलधर्माः सनातनाः। धर्मे नष्टे कुलं कृत्स्नमधर्मोऽभिभवत्युत
transliteration: kulakṣaye praṇaśyanti kuladharmāḥ sanātanāḥ, dharme naṣṭe kulaṃ kṛtsnamadharmo'bhibhavatyuta
hindi_meaning: कुल का क्षय होने पर सदा से चलते आये कुलधर्म नष्ट हो जाते हैं और धर्म का नाश होनेपर (बचे हुए) सम्पूर्ण कुल को अधर्म दबा लेता है।
english_meaning: From the ruin of the family are totally destroyed the traditional rites and duties of the family. When rites and duties are destroyed, vice overpowers the entire family also.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: अधर्माभिभवात्कृष्ण प्रदुष्यन्ति कुलस्त्रियः। स्त्रीषु दुष्टासु वार्ष्णेय जायते वर्णसङ्करः
transliteration: adharmābhibhavātkṛṣṇa praduṣyanti kulastriyaḥ, strīṣu duṣṭāsu vārṣṇeya jāyate varṇasaṅkaraḥ
hindi_meaning: हे कृष्ण! अधर्म के अधिक बढ़ जाने से कुल की स्त्रियाँ दूषित हो जाती हैं; (और) हे वार्ष्णेय! स्त्रियों के दूषित होने पर वर्णसंकर पैदा हो जाते हैं।
english_meaning: O Krsna, when vice predominates, the women of the family become corrupt. O descendent of the Vrsnis, when women become corrupted, it results in the intermingling of castes.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: सङ्करो नरकायैव कुलघ्नानां कुलस्य च। पतन्ति पितरो ह्येषां लुप्तपिण्डोदकक्रियाः
transliteration: saṅkaro narakāyaiva kulaghnānāṃ kulasya ca, patanti pitaro hyeṣāṃ luptapiṇḍodakakriyāḥ
hindi_meaning: वर्णसंकर कुलघातियों को और कुल को नरक में ले जानेवाला ही होता है। श्राद्ध और तर्पण न मिलने से इन- (कुलघातियों-) के पितर भी अपने स्थान से गिर जाते हैं।
english_meaning: And the intermingling in the family leads the ruiners of the family verily into hell. The forefathers of these fall down (into hell) because of being deprived of the offerings of rice-balls and water.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: दोषैरेतैः कुलघ्नानां वर्णसङ्करकारकैः। उत्साद्यन्ते जातिधर्माः कुलधर्माश्च शाश्वताः
transliteration: doṣairetaiḥ kulaghnānāṃ varṇasaṅkarakārakaiḥ, utsādyante jātidharmāḥ kuladharmāśca śāśvatāḥ
hindi_meaning: इन वर्णसंकर पैदा करनेवाले दोषोंसे कुलघातियों के सदा से चलते आये कुलधर्म और जातिधर्म नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
english_meaning: Due to these misdeeds of the ruiners of the family, which cause intermingling of castes, the traditional rites and duties of the castes and families become destroyed.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: उत्सन्नकुलधर्माणां मनुष्याणां जनार्दन। नरकेऽनियतं वासो भवतीत्यनुशुश्रुम
transliteration: utsannakuladharmāṇāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ janārdana, narake'niyataṃ vāso bhavatītyanuśuśruma
hindi_meaning: हे जनार्दन! जिनके कुलधर्म नष्ट हो जाते हैं, उन मनुष्यों का बहुत काल तक नरकों में वापस होता है, ऐसा हम सुनते आये हैं।
english_meaning: O Janardana, we have heard that living in hell becomes inevitable for those persons whose family duties get destroyed.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: अहो बत महत्पापं कर्तुं व्यवसिता वयम्। यद्राज्यसुखलोभेन हन्तुं स्वजनमुद्यताः
transliteration: aho bata mahatpāpaṃ kartuṃ vyavasitā vayam, yadrājyasukhalobhena hantuṃ svajanamudyatāḥ
hindi_meaning: यह बड़े आश्चर्य और खेद की बात है कि हमलोग बड़ा भारी पाप करने का निश्चय कर बैठे हैं, जो कि राज्य और सुख के लोभ से अपने स्वजनों को मारने के लिये तैयार हो गये हैं!
english_meaning: What a pity that we have resolved to commit a great sin by being eager to kill our own kith and kin, out of greed for the pleasures of a kingdom!
practical_guidance: Cravings are temporary visitors — they will pass. When an urge arises, pause for three slow breaths before responding. The gap is where freedom lives.

sanskrit_text: यदि मामप्रतीकारमशस्त्रं शस्त्रपाणयः। धार्तराष्ट्रा रणे हन्युस्तन्मे क्षेमतरं भवेत्
transliteration: yadi māmapratīkāramaśastraṃ śastrapāṇayaḥ, dhārtarāṣṭrā raṇe hanyustanme kṣemataraṃ bhavet
hindi_meaning: अगर ये हाथों में शस्त्र-अस्त्र लिये हुए धृतराष्ट्र के पक्षपाती लोग युद्धभूमि में सामना न करनेवाले तथा शस्त्ररहित मुझ को मार भी दें, तो वह मेरे लिये बड़ा ही हितकारक होगा।
english_meaning: If, in this battle, the sons of Dhrtarastra armed with weapons kill me who am non-resistant and unarmed, that will be more beneficial to me.
practical_guidance: Fear and courage live side by side. The Gita doesn't ask you to be fearless — only to act rightly despite the fear. Take one brave step today.

sanskrit_text: एवमुक्त्वाऽर्जुनः संख्ये रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्। विसृज्य सशरं चापं शोकसंविग्नमानसः
transliteration: evamuktvā'rjunaḥ saṃkhye rathopastha upāviśat, visṛjya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ śokasaṃvignamānasaḥ
hindi_meaning: संजय बोले - ऐसा कहकर शोकाकुल मनवाले अर्जुन बाणसहित धनुष का त्याग करके युद्धभूमि में रथके मध्यभाग में बैठ गये।
english_meaning: Sanjaya narrated: Having said so, Arjuna, with a mind afflicted with sorrow, sat down on the chariot in the midst of the battle, casting aside the bow along with the arrows.
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: तं तथा कृपयाऽविष्टमश्रुपूर्णाकुलेक्षणम्। विषीदन्तमिदं वाक्यमुवाच मधुसूदनः
transliteration: taṃ tathā kṛpayā'viṣṭamaśrupūrṇākulekṣaṇam, viṣīdantamidaṃ vākyamuvāca madhusūdanaḥ
hindi_meaning: संजय बोले - वैसी कायरता से आविष्ट उन अर्जुन के प्रति, जो कि विषाद कर रहे हैं और आँसुओं के कारण जिनके नेत्रों की देखने की शक्ति अवरुद्ध हो रही है, भगवान् मधुसूदन ये (आगे कहे जानेवाले) वचन बोले।
english_meaning: Sanjaya said To him who had been thus filled with pity, whose eyes were filled with tears and showed distress, and who was sorrowing, Madhusudana uttered these words:
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: कुतस्त्वा कश्मलमिदं विषमे समुपस्थितम्। अनार्यजुष्टमस्वर्ग्यमकीर्तिकरमर्जुन
transliteration: kutastvā kaśmalamidaṃ viṣame samupasthitam, anāryajuṣṭamasvargyamakīrtikaramarjuna
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले (टिप्पणी प 0 38.1) - हे अर्जुन! इस विषम अवसरपर तुम्हें यह कायरता कहाँसे प्राप्त हुई, जिसका कि श्रेष्ठ पुरुष सेवन नहीं करते, जो स्वर्गको देनेवाली नहीं है और कीर्ति करनेवाली भी नहीं है।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said O Arjuna, in this perilous place, whence has come to you this impurity entertained by unenlightened persons, which does not lead to heaven and which brings infamy?
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: क्लैब्यं मा स्म गमः पार्थ नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते। क्षुद्रं हृदयदौर्बल्यं त्यक्त्वोत्तिष्ठ परन्तप॥
transliteration: klaibyam ma sma gamah partha naitat tvayy upapadyate, ksudram hrdaya-daurbalyam tyaktvoттistha parantapa
hindi_meaning: हे पार्थ, इस कायरता को मत अपनाओ — यह तुम्हें शोभा नहीं देती। हे परंतप, हृदय की इस क्षुद्र दुर्बलता को त्यागकर उठो।
english_meaning: O Partha, do not yield to this degrading impotence. It does not become you. Give up such petty weakness of heart and arise, O chastiser of the enemy.
practical_guidance: When you feel like giving up on a job, a goal, or a relationship, Krishna's words ring clearly: arise. This weakness is not who you are. Take one concrete step today — not a giant leap, just one step — and let that momentum carry you forward.

sanskrit_text: कथं भीष्ममहं संख्ये द्रोणं च मधुसूदन। इषुभिः प्रतियोत्स्यामि पूजार्हावरिसूदन
transliteration: kathaṃ bhīṣmamahaṃ saṃkhye droṇaṃ ca madhusūdana, iṣubhiḥ pratiyotsyāmi pūjārhāvarisūdana
hindi_meaning: अर्जुन बोले - हे मधुसूदन! मैं रणभूमिमें भीष्म और द्रोणके साथ बाणोंसे युद्ध कैसे करूँ? क्योंकि हे अरिसूदन! ये दोनों ही पूजाके योग्य हैं।
english_meaning: Arjuna said O Madhusudana, O destroyer of enemies, how can I fight with arrows in battle against Bhisma and Drona who are worthy of adoration?
practical_guidance: Fear and courage live side by side. The Gita doesn't ask you to be fearless — only to act rightly despite the fear. Take one brave step today.

sanskrit_text: गुरूनहत्वा हि महानुभावान् श्रेयो भोक्तुं भैक्ष्यमपीह लोके। हत्वार्थकामांस्तु गुरूनिहैव भुञ्जीय भोगान् रुधिरप्रदिग्धान्
transliteration: gurūnahatvā hi mahānubhāvān śreyo bhoktuṃ bhaikṣyamapīha loke, hatvārthakāmāṃstu gurūnihaiva bhuñjīya bhogān rudhirapradigdhān
hindi_meaning: महानुभाव गुरुजनोंको न मारकर इस लोकमें मैं भिक्षाका अन्न खाना भी श्रेष्ठ समझता हूँ। क्योंकि गुरुजनोंको मारकर यहाँ रक्तसे सने हुए तथा धनकी कामनाकी मुख्यतावाले भोगोंको ही तो भोगूँगा!
english_meaning: Rather than killing the noble-minded elders, it is better in this world to live even on alms. But by killing the elders we shall only be enjoying here the pleasures of wealth and desireable things drenched in blood.
practical_guidance: Cravings are temporary visitors — they will pass. When an urge arises, pause for three slow breaths before responding. The gap is where freedom lives.

sanskrit_text: न चैतद्विद्मः कतरन्नो गरीयो यद्वा जयेम यदि वा नो जयेयुः। यानेव हत्वा न जिजीविषाम स्तेऽवस्थिताः प्रमुखे धार्तराष्ट्राः
transliteration: na caitadvidmaḥ kataranno garīyo yadvā jayema yadi vā no jayeyuḥ, yāneva hatvā na jijīviṣāma ste'vasthitāḥ pramukhe dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ
hindi_meaning: हम यह भी नहीं जानते कि हमलोगोंके लिये युद्ध करना और न करना - इन दोनोंमेंसे कौन-सा अत्यन्त श्रेष्ठ है; और हमें इसका भी पता नहीं है कि हम उन्हें जीतेंगे अथवा वे हमें जीतेंगे। जिनको मारकर हम जीना भी नहीं चाहते, वे ही धृतराष्ट्रके सम्बन्धी हमारे सामने खड़े हैं।
english_meaning: We do not know this as well as to which is the better for us, (and) whether we shall win, or whether they shall coner us. Those very sons of Dhrtarastra, by killing whom we do not wish to live, stand in confrontation.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: कार्पण्यदोषोपहतस्वभावः पृच्छामि त्वां धर्मसंमूढचेताः। यच्छ्रेयः स्यान्निश्चितं ब्रूहि तन्मे शिष्यस्तेऽहं शाधि मां त्वां प्रपन्नम्
transliteration: kārpaṇyadoṣopahatasvabhāvaḥ pṛcchāmi tvāṃ dharmasaṃmūḍhacetāḥ, yacchreyaḥ syānniścitaṃ brūhi tanme śiṣyaste'haṃ śādhi māṃ tvāṃ prapannam
hindi_meaning: कायरतारूप दोषसे तिरस्कृत स्वभाववाला और धर्मके विषयमें मोहित अन्तःकरणवाला मैं आपसे पूछता हूँ कि जो निश्चित कल्याण करनेवाली हो, वह मेरे लिये कहिये। मैं आपका शिष्य हूँ। आपके शरण हुए मुझे शिक्षा दीजिये।
english_meaning: With my nature overpowered by weak commiseration, with a mind bewildered about duty, I supplicate You. Telll me for certain that which is better; I am Your disciple. Instruct me who have taken refuge in You.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: न हि प्रपश्यामि ममापनुद्या द्यच्छोकमुच्छोषणमिन्द्रियाणाम्। अवाप्य भूमावसपत्नमृद्धम् राज्यं सुराणामपि चाधिपत्यम्
transliteration: na hi prapaśyāmi mamāpanudyā dyacchokamucchoṣaṇamindriyāṇām, avāpya bhūmāvasapatnamṛddham rājyaṃ surāṇāmapi cādhipatyam
hindi_meaning: पृथ्वीपर धन-धान्य-समृद्ध और शत्रुरहित राज्य तथा स्वर्गमें देवताओंका आधिपत्य मिल जाय तो भी इन्द्रियोंको सुखानेवाला मेरा जो शोक है, वह दूर हो जाय - ऐसा मैं नहीं देखता हूँ।
english_meaning: Because, I do not see that which can, even after aciring on this earth a prosperous kingdom free from enemies and even sovereignty over the gods, remove my sorrow (which is) blasting the senses.
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: एवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशं गुडाकेशः परन्तप। न योत्स्य इति गोविन्दमुक्त्वा तूष्णीं बभूव ह
transliteration: evamuktvā hṛṣīkeśaṃ guḍākeśaḥ parantapa, na yotsya iti govindamuktvā tūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha
hindi_meaning: संजय बोले - हे शत्रुतापन धृतराष्ट्र! ऐसा कहकर निद्राको जीतनेवाले अर्जुन अन्तर्यामी भगवान् गोविन्दसे 'मैं युद्ध नहीं करूँगा' ऐसा साफ-साफ कहकर चुप हो गये।
english_meaning: Sanjaya said Having spoken thus to Hrsikesa (Krsna), Gudakesa (Arjuna), the afflictor of foes, verily became silent, telling Govinda, 'I shall not fight.' fight.'
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: तमुवाच हृषीकेशः प्रहसन्निव भारत। सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये विषीदन्तमिदं वचः
transliteration: tamuvāca hṛṣīkeśaḥ prahasanniva bhārata, senayorubhayormadhye viṣīdantamidaṃ vacaḥ
hindi_meaning: हे भरतवंशोद्भव धृतराष्ट्र! दोनों सेनाओंके मध्यभागमें विषाद करते हुए उस अर्जुनके प्रति हँसते हुए-से भगवान् हृषीकेश यह (आगे कहे जानेवाले) वचन बोले।
english_meaning: O descendant of Bharata, to him who was sorrowing between the two armies, Hrsikesa, mocking as it were, said these words:
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: अशोच्यानन्वशोचस्त्वं प्रज्ञावादांश्च भाषसे। गतासूनगतासूंश्च नानुशोचन्ति पण्डिताः
transliteration: aśocyānanvaśocastvaṃ prajñāvādāṃśca bhāṣase, gatāsūnagatāsūṃśca nānuśocanti paṇḍitāḥ
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले - तुमने शोक न करनेयोग्यका शोक किया है और पण्डिताईकी बातें कह रहे हो; परन्तु जिनके प्राण चले गये हैं, उनके लिये और जिनके प्राण नहीं गये हैं, उनके लिये पण्डितलोग शोक नहीं करते।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said You grieve for whose who are not to be grieved for; and you speak words of wisdom! The learned do not grieve for the departed and those who have not departed.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: न त्वेवाहं जातु नासं न त्वं नेमे जनाधिपाः। न चैव न भविष्यामः सर्वे वयमतः परम्
transliteration: na tvevāhaṃ jātu nāsaṃ na tvaṃ neme janādhipāḥ, na caiva na bhaviṣyāmaḥ sarve vayamataḥ param
hindi_meaning: किसी कालमें मैं नहीं था और तू नहीं था तथा ये राजालोग नहीं थे, यह बात भी नहीं है; और इसके बाद (भविष्य में) मैं, तू और राजलोग - हम सभी नहीं रहेंगे, यह बात भी नहीं है।
english_meaning: But certainly (it is) not (a fact) that I did not exist at any time; nor you, nor these rulers of men. And surely it is not that we all shall cease to exist after this.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: देहिनोऽस्मिन्यथा देहे कौमारं यौवनं जरा। तथा देहान्तरप्राप्तिर्धीरस्तत्र न मुह्यति
transliteration: dehino'sminyathā dehe kaumāraṃ yauvanaṃ jarā, tathā dehāntaraprāptirdhīrastatra na muhyati
hindi_meaning: देहधारीके इस मनुष्यशरीरमें जैसे बालकपन, जवानी और वृद्धावस्था होती है, ऐसे ही देहान्तरकी प्राप्ति होती है। उस विषयमें धीर मनुष्य मोहित नहीं होता।
english_meaning: As are boyhood, youth and decrepitude to an embodied being in this (present) body, similar is the acisition of another body. This being so, an intelligent person does not get deluded.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: मात्रास्पर्शास्तु कौन्तेय शीतोष्णसुखदुःखदाः। आगमापायिनोऽनित्यास्तांस्तितिक्षस्व भारत॥
transliteration: matra-sparsas tu kaunteya sitosna-sukha-duhkha-dah, agamapayino 'nityas tams titiksasva bharata
hindi_meaning: हे कौन्तेय, सर्दी-गर्मी और सुख-दुख ये सभी इन्द्रिय और विषयों के संपर्क से उत्पन्न होते हैं। ये आने-जाने वाले और अनित्य हैं, इसलिए हे भारत, तुम इन्हें सहन करो।
english_meaning: O son of Kunti, the nonpermanent appearance of happiness and distress, and their disappearance in due course, are like the appearance and disappearance of winter and summer seasons. They arise from sense perception, O scion of Bharata, and one must learn to tolerate them without being disturbed.
practical_guidance: Whatever pain or difficulty you are experiencing right now, know that it is temporary — like a passing season. Instead of trying to escape the feeling, practice simply witnessing it without being swept away. Remind yourself: 'This too shall pass, and I am the calm witness beneath it all.'

sanskrit_text: यं हि न व्यथयन्त्येते पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ। समदुःखसुखं धीरं सोऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते
transliteration: yaṃ hi na vyathayantyete puruṣaṃ puruṣarṣabha, samaduḥkhasukhaṃ dhīraṃ so'mṛtatvāya kalpate
hindi_meaning: कारण कि हे पुरुषोंमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुन! सुख-दुःखमें सम रहनेवाले जिस धीर मनुष्यको ये मात्रास्पर्श (पदार्थ) व्यथित (सुखी-दुःखी) नहीं कर पाते, वह अमर होनेमें समर्थ हो जाता है अर्थात् वह अमर हो जाता है।
english_meaning: O (Arjuna, who are) foremost among men, verily, the person whom these do not torment, the wise man to whom sorrow and happhiness are the same he is fit for Immortality.
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: नासतो विद्यते भावो नाभावो विद्यते सतः। उभयोरपि दृष्टोऽन्तस्त्वनयोस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः
transliteration: nāsato vidyate bhāvo nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ, ubhayorapi dṛṣṭo'ntastvanayostattvadarśibhiḥ
hindi_meaning: (टिप्पणी प 0 55) असत् का तो भाव (सत्ता) विद्यमान नहीं है और सत् का अभाव विद्यमान नहीं है, तत्त्वदर्शी महापुरुषोंने इन दोनोंका ही अन्त अर्थात् तत्त्व देखा है।
english_meaning: Of the unreal there is no being; the real has no nonexistence. But the nature of both these, indeed, has been realized by the seers of Truth.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: अविनाशि तु तद्विद्धि येन सर्वमिदं ततम्। विनाशमव्ययस्यास्य न कश्चित् कर्तुमर्हति
transliteration: avināśi tu tadviddhi yena sarvamidaṃ tatam, vināśamavyayasyāsya na kaścit kartumarhati
hindi_meaning: अविनाशी तो उसको जान, जिससे यह सम्पूर्ण संसार व्याप्त है। इस अविनाशीका विनाश कोई भी नहीं कर सकता।
english_meaning: But know That to be indestructible by which all this is pervaded. None can bring about the destruction of this Immutable.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: अन्तवन्त इमे देहा नित्यस्योक्ताः शरीरिणः। अनाशिनोऽप्रमेयस्य तस्माद्युध्यस्व भारत
transliteration: antavanta ime dehā nityasyoktāḥ śarīriṇaḥ, anāśino'prameyasya tasmādyudhyasva bhārata
hindi_meaning: अविनाशी, अप्रमेय और नित्य रहनेवाले इस शरीरी के ये देह अन्तवाले कहे गये हैं। इसलिये हे अर्जुन! तुम युद्ध करो।
english_meaning: These destructible bodies are said to belong to the everlasting, indestructible, indeterminable, embodied One. Therefore, O descendant of Bharata, join the battle.
practical_guidance: Fear and courage live side by side. The Gita doesn't ask you to be fearless — only to act rightly despite the fear. Take one brave step today.

sanskrit_text: य एनं वेत्ति हन्तारं यश्चैनं मन्यते हतम्। उभौ तौ न विजानीतो नायं हन्ति न हन्यते
transliteration: ya enaṃ vetti hantāraṃ yaścainaṃ manyate hatam, ubhau tau na vijānīto nāyaṃ hanti na hanyate
hindi_meaning: जो मनुष्य इस अविनाशी शरीरीको मारनेवाला मानता है और जो मनुष्य इसको मरा मानता है, वे दोनों ही इसको नहीं जानते; क्योंकि यह न मारता है और न मारा जाता है।
english_meaning: He who thinks of this One as the killer, and he who thinks of this One as the killed both of them do not know. This One does not kill, nor is It killed.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचिन्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः। अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणो न हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे॥
transliteration: na jayate mriyate va kadacin nayam bhutva bhavita va na bhuyah, ajo nityah sasvato 'yam purano na hanyate hanyamane sarire
hindi_meaning: यह आत्मा न कभी जन्म लेती है और न मरती है। यह न तो कभी उत्पन्न हुई है, न होती है, और न होगी। यह अजन्मा, नित्य, शाश्वत और पुरातन है। शरीर के नाश होने पर भी इसका नाश नहीं होता।
english_meaning: The soul is never born nor dies at any time. It has not come into being, does not come into being, and will not come into being. It is unborn, eternal, ever-existing, and primeval. It is not slain when the body is slain.
practical_guidance: When you grieve the loss of a loved one or fear your own death, remember that the soul is eternal and beyond all destruction. Let this truth bring you comfort — what is real can never be lost. Spend a moment today reflecting on your own eternal nature beyond the body.

sanskrit_text: वेदाविनाशिनं नित्यं य एनमजमव्ययम्। कथं स पुरुषः पार्थ कं घातयति हन्ति कम्
transliteration: vedāvināśinaṃ nityaṃ ya enamajamavyayam, kathaṃ sa puruṣaḥ pārtha kaṃ ghātayati hanti kam
hindi_meaning: हे पृथानन्दन! जो मनुष्य इस शरीरीको अविनाशी, नित्य, जन्मरहित और अव्यय जानता है, वह कैसे किसको मारे और कैसे किसको मरवाये?
english_meaning: O Partha, he who knows this One as indestructible, eternal, birthless and undecaying, how and whom does that person kill, or whom does he cause to be killed! [This is not a estion but only an emphatic denial.-Tr.]
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहाय नवानि गृह्णाति नरोऽपराणि। तथा शरीराणि विहाय जीर्णान्यन्यानि संयाति नवानि देही॥
transliteration: vasansi jirnani yatha vihaya navani grhnati naro 'parani, tatha sarirani vihaya jirnany anyani samyati navani dehi
hindi_meaning: जैसे मनुष्य पुराने वस्त्रों को त्यागकर नए वस्त्र धारण करता है, उसी प्रकार आत्मा पुराने शरीरों को छोड़कर नए शरीर धारण करती है।
english_meaning: As a person puts on new garments, giving up old ones, similarly, the soul accepts new material bodies, giving up the old and useless ones.
practical_guidance: Every ending in your life is also a new beginning. When you face a major change — loss of a job, end of a relationship, or any transition — see it as the soul discarding old garments for new ones. Embrace this change with openness rather than clinging to what was.

sanskrit_text: नैनं छिन्दन्ति शस्त्राणि नैनं दहति पावकः। न चैनं क्लेदयन्त्यापो न शोषयति मारुतः
transliteration: nainaṃ chindanti śastrāṇi nainaṃ dahati pāvakaḥ, na cainaṃ kledayantyāpo na śoṣayati mārutaḥ
hindi_meaning: शस्त्र इस शरीरीको काट नहीं सकते, अग्नि इसको जला नहीं सकती, जल इसको गीला नहीं कर सकता और वायु इसको सुखा नहीं सकती।
english_meaning: Weapons do not cut It, fire does not burn It, water does not moisten It, and air does not dry It.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: अच्छेद्योऽयमदाह्योऽयमक्लेद्योऽशोष्य एव च। नित्यः सर्वगतः स्थाणुरचलोऽयं सनातनः
transliteration: acchedyo'yamadāhyo'yamakledyo'śoṣya eva ca, nityaḥ sarvagataḥ sthāṇuracalo'yaṃ sanātanaḥ
hindi_meaning: यह शरीरी काटा नहीं जा सकता, यह जलाया नहीं जा सकता, यह गीला नहीं किया जा सकता और यह सुखाया भी नहीं जा सकता। कारण कि यह नित्य रहनेवाला सबमें परिपूर्ण, अचल, स्थिर स्वभाववाला और अनादि है।
english_meaning: It cannot be cut, It cannot be burnt, cannot be moistened, and surely cannot be dried up. It is eternal, omnipresent, stationary, unmoving and changeless.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: अव्यक्तोऽयमचिन्त्योऽयमविकार्योऽयमुच्यते। तस्मादेवं विदित्वैनं नानुशोचितुमर्हसि
transliteration: avyakto'yamacintyo'yamavikāryo'yamucyate, tasmādevaṃ viditvainaṃ nānuśocitumarhasi
hindi_meaning: यह देही प्रत्यक्ष नहीं दीखता, यह चिन्तनका विषय नहीं है और यह निर्विकार कहा जाता है। अतः इस देहीको ऐसा जानकर शोक नहीं करना चाहिये।
english_meaning: It is said that This is unmanifest; This is inconceivable; This is unchangeable. Therefore, having known This thus, you ougth not to grieve.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: अथ चैनं नित्यजातं नित्यं वा मन्यसे मृतम्। तथापि त्वं महाबाहो नैवं शोचितुमर्हसि
transliteration: atha cainaṃ nityajātaṃ nityaṃ vā manyase mṛtam, tathāpi tvaṃ mahābāho naivaṃ śocitumarhasi
hindi_meaning: हे महाबाहो ! अगर तुम इस देहीको नित्य पैदा होनेवाला अथवा नित्य मरनेवाला भी मानो, तो भी तुम्हें इस प्रकार शोक नहीं करना चाहिये।
english_meaning: On the other hand, if you think this One is born continually or dies constantly, even then, O mighty-armed one, you ought not to grieve thus.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्ध्रुवं जन्म मृतस्य च। तस्मादपरिहार्येऽर्थे न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि
transliteration: jātasya hi dhruvo mṛtyurdhruvaṃ janma mṛtasya ca, tasmādaparihārye'rthe na tvaṃ śocitumarhasi
hindi_meaning: क्योंकि पैदा हुएकी जरूर मृत्यु होगी और मरे हुएका जरूर जन्म होगा। इस (जन्म-मरण-रूप परिवर्तन के प्रवाह) का परिहार अर्थात् निवारण नहीं हो सकता। अतः इस विषयमें तुम्हें शोक नहीं करना चाहिये।
english_meaning: For death of anyone born is certain, and of the dead (re-) birth is a certainly. Therefore you ought not to grieve over an inevitable fact.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: अव्यक्तादीनि भूतानि व्यक्तमध्यानि भारत। अव्यक्तनिधनान्येव तत्र का परिदेवना
transliteration: avyaktādīni bhūtāni vyaktamadhyāni bhārata, avyaktanidhanānyeva tatra kā paridevanā
hindi_meaning: हे भारत ! सभी प्राणी जन्मसे पहले अप्रकट थे और मरनेके बाद अप्रकट हो जायँगे, केवल बीचमें ही प्रकट दीखते हैं। अतः इसमें शोक करनेकी बात ही क्या है?
english_meaning: O descendant of Bharata, all beings remain unmanifest in the beginning;; they become manifest in the middle. After death they certainly become unmanifest. What lamentation can there be with regard to them?
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: आश्चर्यवत्पश्यति कश्चिदेन माश्चर्यवद्वदति तथैव चान्यः। आश्चर्यवच्चैनमन्यः श्रृणोति श्रुत्वाप्येनं वेद न चैव कश्चित्
transliteration: āścaryavatpaśyati kaścidena māścaryavadvadati tathaiva cānyaḥ, āścaryavaccainamanyaḥ śrṛṇoti śrutvāpyenaṃ veda na caiva kaścit
hindi_meaning: कोई इस शरीरीको आश्चर्यकी तरह देखता है और वैसे ही अन्य कोई इसका आश्चर्यकी तरह वर्णन करता है तथा अन्य कोई इसको आश्चर्यकी तरह सुनता है; और इसको सुनकर भी कोई नहीं जानता। अर्थात यह शरीरी दुर्विज्ञेय है।
english_meaning: Someone visualizes It as a wonder; and similarly indeed, someone else talks of It as a wonder; and someone else hears of It as a wonder. And some one else, indeed, does not realize It even after hearing about It.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: देही नित्यमवध्योऽयं देहे सर्वस्य भारत। तस्मात्सर्वाणि भूतानि न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि
transliteration: dehī nityamavadhyo'yaṃ dehe sarvasya bhārata, tasmātsarvāṇi bhūtāni na tvaṃ śocitumarhasi
hindi_meaning: हे भरतवंशोद्भव अर्जुन! सबके देहमें यह देही नित्य ही अवध्य है। इसलिये सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके लिये अर्थात् किसी भी प्राणीके लिये तुम्हें शोक नहीं करना चाहिये।
english_meaning: O descendant of Bharata, this embodied Self existing in everyone's body can never be killed. Therefore you ought not to grieve for all (these) beings.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: स्वधर्ममपि चावेक्ष्य न विकम्पितुमर्हसि। धर्म्याद्धि युद्धाछ्रेयोऽन्यत्क्षत्रियस्य न विद्यते
transliteration: svadharmamapi cāvekṣya na vikampitumarhasi, dharmyāddhi yuddhāchreyo'nyatkṣatriyasya na vidyate
hindi_meaning: अपने स्वधर्म (क्षात्रधर्म) को देखकर भी तुम्हें विकम्पित अर्थात् कर्तव्य-कर्मसे विचलित नहीं होना चाहिये; क्योंकि धर्ममय युद्धसे बढ़कर क्षत्रियके लिये दूसरा कोई कल्याणकारक कर्म नहीं है।
english_meaning: Even considering your own duty you should not waver, since there is nothing else better for a Ksatriya than a righteous battle.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: यदृच्छया चोपपन्नं स्वर्गद्वारमपावृतम्। सुखिनः क्षत्रियाः पार्थ लभन्ते युद्धमीदृशम्
transliteration: yadṛcchayā copapannaṃ svargadvāramapāvṛtam, sukhinaḥ kṣatriyāḥ pārtha labhante yuddhamīdṛśam
hindi_meaning: अपने-आप प्राप्त हुआ युद्ध खुला हुआ स्वर्गका दरवाजा भी है। हे पृथानन्दन ! वे क्षत्रिय बड़े सुखी (भाग्यशाली) हैं, जिनको ऐसा युद्ध प्राप्त होता है।
english_meaning: O son of Partha, happy are the Ksatriyas who come across this kind of a battle, which presents itself unsought for and which is an open gate to heaven.
practical_guidance: Fear and courage live side by side. The Gita doesn't ask you to be fearless — only to act rightly despite the fear. Take one brave step today.

sanskrit_text: अथ चैत्त्वमिमं धर्म्यं संग्रामं न करिष्यसि। ततः स्वधर्मं कीर्तिं च हित्वा पापमवाप्स्यसि
transliteration: atha caittvamimaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ na kariṣyasi, tataḥ svadharmaṃ kīrtiṃ ca hitvā pāpamavāpsyasi
hindi_meaning: अब अगर तू यह धर्ममय युद्ध नहीं करेगा, तो अपने धर्म और कीर्तिका त्याग करके पापको प्राप्त होगा।
english_meaning: On the other hand, if you will not fight this righteous battle, then, forsaking your own duty and fame, you will incur sin.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: अकीर्तिं चापि भूतानि कथयिष्यन्ति तेऽव्ययाम्। संभावितस्य चाकीर्तिर्मरणादतिरिच्यते
transliteration: akīrtiṃ cāpi bhūtāni kathayiṣyanti te'vyayām, saṃbhāvitasya cākīrtirmaraṇādatiricyate
hindi_meaning: और सब प्राणी भी तेरी सदा रहनेवाली अपकीर्तिका कथन अर्थात निंदा करेंगे। वह अपकीर्ति सम्मानित मनुष्यके लिये मृत्युसे भी बढ़कर दुःखदायी होती है।
english_meaning: People also will speak of your unending infamy. And to an honoured person infamy is worse than death.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: भयाद्रणादुपरतं मंस्यन्ते त्वां महारथाः। येषां च त्वं बहुमतो भूत्वा यास्यसि लाघवम्
transliteration: bhayādraṇāduparataṃ maṃsyante tvāṃ mahārathāḥ, yeṣāṃ ca tvaṃ bahumato bhūtvā yāsyasi lāghavam
hindi_meaning: महारथीलोग तुझे भयके कारण युद्धसे उपरत (हटा) हुआ मानेंगे। जिनकी धारणामें तू बहुमान्य हो चुका है, उनकी दृष्टिमें तू लघुताको प्राप्त हो जायगा।
english_meaning: The great chariot-riders will think of you as having desisted from the fight out of fear; and you will into disgrace before them to whom you had been estimable.
practical_guidance: Notice where your attention is — on outcomes you cannot control? Gently bring it back to this moment, and to the one action you can take right now.

sanskrit_text: अवाच्यवादांश्च बहून् वदिष्यन्ति तवाहिताः। निन्दन्तस्तव सामर्थ्यं ततो दुःखतरं नु किम्
transliteration: avācyavādāṃśca bahūn vadiṣyanti tavāhitāḥ, nindantastava sāmarthyaṃ tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim
hindi_meaning: तेरे शत्रुलोग तेरी सार्मथ्यकी निन्दा करते हुए न कहनेयोग्य बहुत-से वचन भी कहेंगे। उससे बढ़कर और दुःखकी बात क्या होगी?
english_meaning: And your enemies will speak many indecent words while denigrating your might. What can be more painful than that?
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: हतो वा प्राप्स्यसि स्वर्गं जित्वा वा भोक्ष्यसे महीम्। तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ कौन्तेय युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः
transliteration: hato vā prāpsyasi svargaṃ jitvā vā bhokṣyase mahīm, tasmāduttiṣṭha kaunteya yuddhāya kṛtaniścayaḥ
hindi_meaning: अगर युद्धमें तू मारा जायगा तो तुझे स्वर्गकी प्राप्ति होगी और अगर युद्धमें तू जीत जायगा तो पृथ्वीका राज्य भोगेगा। अतः हे कुन्तीनन्दन! तू युद्धके लिये निश्चय करके खड़ा हो जा।
english_meaning: Either by being killed you will attain heaven, or by winning you will enjoy the earth. Therefore, O Arjuna, rise up with determination for fighting.
practical_guidance: Fear and courage live side by side. The Gita doesn't ask you to be fearless — only to act rightly despite the fear. Take one brave step today.

sanskrit_text: सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ। ततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व नैवं पापमवाप्स्यसि
transliteration: sukhaduḥkhe same kṛtvā lābhālābhau jayājayau, tato yuddhāya yujyasva naivaṃ pāpamavāpsyasi
hindi_meaning: जय-पराजय, लाभ-हानि और सुख-दुःखको समान करके फिर युद्धमें लग जा। इस प्रकार युद्ध करनेसे तू पापको प्राप्त नहीं होगा।
english_meaning: Treating happiness and sorrow, gain and loss, and conest and defeat with eanimity, then engage in battle. Thus you will not incur sin.
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: एषा तेऽभिहिता सांख्ये बुद्धिर्योगे त्विमां शृणु। बुद्ध्यायुक्तो यया पार्थ कर्मबन्धं प्रहास्यसि
transliteration: eṣā te'bhihitā sāṃkhye buddhiryoge tvimāṃ śṛṇu, buddhyāyukto yayā pārtha karmabandhaṃ prahāsyasi
hindi_meaning: हे पार्थ! यह समबुद्धि तेरे लिए पहले सांख्ययोगमें कही गयी, अब तू इसको कर्मयोगके विषयमें सुन; जिस समबुद्धिसे युक्त हुआ तू कर्मबन्धनका त्याग कर देगा।
english_meaning: O Partha, this wisdom has been imparted to you from the standpoint of Self-realization. But listen to this (wisdom) from the standpoint of Yoga, endowed with which wisdom you will get rid of the bondage of action.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: नेहाभिक्रमनाशोऽस्ति प्रत्यवायो न विद्यते। स्वल्पमप्यस्य धर्मस्य त्रायते महतो भयात्
transliteration: nehābhikramanāśo'sti pratyavāyo na vidyate, svalpamapyasya dharmasya trāyate mahato bhayāt
hindi_meaning: मनुष्यलोकमें इस समबुद्धिरूप धर्मके आरम्भका नाश नहीं होता, इसके अनुष्ठानका उलटा फल भी नहीं होता और इसका थोड़ासा भी अनुष्ठान (जन्म-मरणरूप) महान् भयसे रक्षा कर लेता है।
english_meaning: Here there is no waste of an attempt; nor is there (any) harm. Even a little of this righteousness saves (one) from great fear.
practical_guidance: Notice where your attention is — on outcomes you cannot control? Gently bring it back to this moment, and to the one action you can take right now.

sanskrit_text: व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिरेकेह कुरुनन्दन। बहुशाखा ह्यनन्ताश्च बुद्धयोऽव्यवसायिनाम्
transliteration: vyavasāyātmikā buddhirekeha kurunandana, bahuśākhā hyanantāśca buddhayo'vyavasāyinām
hindi_meaning: हे कुरुनन्दन! इस समबुद्धिकी प्राप्तिके विषयमें व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धि एक ही होती है। अव्यवसायी मनुष्योंकी बुद्धियाँ अनन्त और बहुशाखाओंवाली ही होती हैं।
english_meaning: O scion of the Kuru dynasty, in this there is a single, one-pointed conviction. The thoughts of the irresolute ones have many branches indeed, and are innumerable.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: यामिमां पुष्पितां वाचं प्रवदन्त्यविपश्चितः। वेदवादरताः पार्थ नान्यदस्तीति वादिनः
transliteration: yāmimāṃ puṣpitāṃ vācaṃ pravadantyavipaścitaḥ, vedavādaratāḥ pārtha nānyadastīti vādinaḥ
hindi_meaning: -- 2.43।। हे पृथानन्दन ! जो कामनाओंमें तन्मय हो रहे हैं, स्वर्गको ही श्रेष्ठ माननेवाले हैं, वेदोंमें कहे हुए सकाम कर्मोंमें प्रीति रखनेवाले हैं, भोगोंके सिवाय और कुछ है ही नहीं - ऐसा कहनेवाले हैं, वे अविवेकी मनुष्य इस प्रकारकी जिस पुष्पित (दिखाऊ शोभायुक्त) वाणीको कहा करते हैं, जो कि जन्मरूपी कर्मफलको देनेवाली है तथा भोग और ऐश्वर्यकी प्राप्तिके लिये बहुतसी क्रियाओंका वर्णन करनेवाली है।
english_meaning: -2.43 O son of Prtha, those undiscerning people who utter this flowery talk which promises birth as a result of rites and duties, and is full of various special rites meant for the attainment of enjoyment and affluence , they remain engrossed in the utterances of the Vedas and declare that nothing else exists; their minds are full of desires and they have heaven as the goal.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: कामात्मानः स्वर्गपरा जन्मकर्मफलप्रदाम्। क्रियाविशेषबहुलां भोगैश्वर्यगतिं प्रति
transliteration: kāmātmānaḥ svargaparā janmakarmaphalapradām, kriyāviśeṣabahulāṃ bhogaiśvaryagatiṃ prati
hindi_meaning: -- 2.43।। हे पृथानन्दन ! जो कामनाओंमें तन्मय हो रहे हैं, स्वर्गको ही श्रेष्ठ माननेवाले हैं, वेदोंमें कहे हुए सकाम कर्मोंमें प्रीति रखनेवाले हैं, भोगोंके सिवाय और कुछ है ही नहीं - ऐसा कहनेवाले हैं, वे अविवेकी मनुष्य इस प्रकारकी जिस पुष्पित (दिखाऊ शोभायुक्त) वाणीको कहा करते हैं, जो कि जन्मरूपी कर्मफलको देनेवाली है तथा भोग और ऐश्वर्यकी प्राप्तिके लिये बहुतसी क्रियाओंका वर्णन करनेवाली है।
english_meaning: -2.43 O son of Prtha, those undiscerning people who utter this flowery talk which promises birth as a result of rites and duties, and is full of various special rites meant for the attainment of enjoyment and affluence , they remain engrossed in the utterances of the Vedas and declare that nothing else exists; their minds are full of desires and they have heaven as the goal.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: भोगैश्वर्यप्रसक्तानां तयापहृतचेतसाम्। व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिः समाधौ न विधीयते
transliteration: bhogaiśvaryaprasaktānāṃ tayāpahṛtacetasām, vyavasāyātmikā buddhiḥ samādhau na vidhīyate
hindi_meaning: उस पुष्पित वाणीसे जिसका अन्तःकरण हर लिया गया है अर्थात् भोगोंकी तरफ खिंच गया है और जो भोग तथा ऐश्वर्यमें अत्यन्त आसक्त हैं, उन मनुष्योंकी परमात्मामें निश्चयात्मिका बुद्धि नहीं होती।
english_meaning: One-pointed conviction does not become established in the minds of those who delight in enjoyment and affluence, and whose intellects are carried away by that (speech).
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: त्रैगुण्यविषया वेदा निस्त्रैगुण्यो भवार्जुन। निर्द्वन्द्वो नित्यसत्त्वस्थो निर्योगक्षेम आत्मवान्
transliteration: traiguṇyaviṣayā vedā nistraiguṇyo bhavārjuna, nirdvandvo nityasattvastho niryogakṣema ātmavān
hindi_meaning: वेद तीनों गुणोंके कार्यका ही वर्णन करनेवाले हैं; हे अर्जुन! तू तीनों गुणोंसे रहित हो जा, निर्द्वन्द्व हो जा, निरन्तर नित्य वस्तु परमात्मा में स्थित हो जा, योगक्षेमकी चाहना भी मत रख और परमात्मपरायण हो जा।
english_meaning: O Arjuna, the Vedas [Meaning only the portion dealing with rites and duties (karma-kanda).] have the three alities as their object. You become free from worldliness, free from the pairs of duality, ever-poised in the ality of sattva, without (desire for) acisition and protection, and self-collected.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: यावानर्थ उदपाने सर्वतः संप्लुतोदके। तावान्सर्वेषु वेदेषु ब्राह्मणस्य विजानतः
transliteration: yāvānartha udapāne sarvataḥ saṃplutodake, tāvānsarveṣu vedeṣu brāhmaṇasya vijānataḥ
hindi_meaning: सब तरफसे परिपूर्ण महान् जलाशयके प्राप्त होनेपर छोटे गड्ढों में भरे जल में मनुष्यका जितना प्रयोजन रहता है अर्थात् कुछ भी प्रयोजन नहीं रहता, वेदों और शास्त्रोंको तत्त्वसे जाननेवाले ब्रह्मज्ञानीका सम्पूर्ण वेदोंमें उतना ही प्रयोजन रहता है अर्थात् कुछ भी प्रयोजन नहीं रहता।
english_meaning: A Brahmana with realization has that much utility in all the Vedas as a man has in a well when there is a flood all around.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन। मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि॥
transliteration: karmany evadhikaras te ma phalesu kadachana, ma karma-phala-hetur bhur ma te sango 'stv akarmani
hindi_meaning: तुम्हारा अधिकार केवल कर्म करने में है, उसके फलों में कभी नहीं। कर्म के फल की कामना मत करो और न ही अकर्म में आसक्त हो।
english_meaning: You have a right to perform your prescribed duties, but you are not entitled to the fruits of your actions. Never consider yourself the cause of the results of your activities, and never be attached to not doing your duty.
practical_guidance: Focus entirely on doing your best work today without obsessing over outcomes. When you feel anxious about results, redirect your energy back to the quality of your effort. Ask yourself: 'Am I giving my full effort right now?' — that is all you can control.

sanskrit_text: योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय। सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते
transliteration: yogasthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā dhanañjaya, siddhyasiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṃ yoga ucyate
hindi_meaning: हे धनञ्जय ! तू आसक्तिका त्याग करके सिद्धि-असिद्धिमें सम होकर योगमें स्थित हुआ कर्मोंको कर; क्योंकि समत्व ही योग कहा जाता है।
english_meaning: By being established in Yoga, O Dhananjaya (Arjuna), undertake actions, casting off attachment and remaining eipoised in success and failure. Eanimity is called Yoga.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: दूरेण ह्यवरं कर्म बुद्धियोगाद्धनञ्जय। बुद्धौ शरणमन्विच्छ कृपणाः फलहेतवः
transliteration: dūreṇa hyavaraṃ karma buddhiyogāddhanañjaya, buddhau śaraṇamanviccha kṛpaṇāḥ phalahetavaḥ
hindi_meaning: बुद्धियोग-(समता) की अपेक्षा सकामकर्म दूरसे (अत्यन्त) ही निकृष्ट है। अतः हे धनञ्जय ! तू बुद्धि (समता) का आश्रय ले; क्योंकि फलके हेतु बननेवाले अत्यन्त दीन हैं।
english_meaning: O Dhananjaya, indeed, action is ite inferior to the yoga of wisdom. Take resort to wisdom. Those who thirst for rewards are pitiable.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह उभे सुकृतदुष्कृते। तस्माद्योगाय युज्यस्व योगः कर्मसु कौशलम्
transliteration: buddhiyukto jahātīha ubhe sukṛtaduṣkṛte, tasmādyogāya yujyasva yogaḥ karmasu kauśalam
hindi_meaning: बुद्धि-(समता) से युक्त मनुष्य यहाँ जीवित अवस्थामें ही पुण्य और पाप दोनोंका त्याग कर देता है। अतः तू योग-(समता-) में लग जा, क्योंकि योग ही कर्मोंमें कुशलता है।
english_meaning: Possessed of wisdom, one rejects here both virtue and vice. Therefore devote yourself to (Karma-) yoga. Yoga is skilfulness in action.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: कर्मजं बुद्धियुक्ता हि फलं त्यक्त्वा मनीषिणः। जन्मबन्धविनिर्मुक्ताः पदं गच्छन्त्यनामयम्
transliteration: karmajaṃ buddhiyuktā hi phalaṃ tyaktvā manīṣiṇaḥ, janmabandhavinirmuktāḥ padaṃ gacchantyanāmayam
hindi_meaning: समतायुक्त मनीषी साधक कर्मजन्य फलका त्याग करके जन्मरूप बन्धनसे मुक्त होकर निर्विकार पदको प्राप्त हो जाते हैं।
english_meaning: Because, those who are devoted to wisdom, (they) becoming men of Enlightenment by giving up the fruits produced by actions, reach the state beyond evils by having become freed from the bondage of birth.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: यदा ते मोहकलिलं बुद्धिर्व्यतितरिष्यति। तदा गन्तासि निर्वेदं श्रोतव्यस्य श्रुतस्य च
transliteration: yadā te mohakalilaṃ buddhirvyatitariṣyati, tadā gantāsi nirvedaṃ śrotavyasya śrutasya ca
hindi_meaning: जिस समय तेरी बुद्धि मोहरूपी दलदलको तर जायगी, उसी समय तू सुने हुए और सुननेमें आनेवाले भोगोंसे वैराग्यको प्राप्त हो जायगा।
english_meaning: When your mind will go beyond the turbidity of delusion, then you will acire dispassion for what has to be heard and what has been heard.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: श्रुतिविप्रतिपन्ना ते यदा स्थास्यति निश्चला। समाधावचला बुद्धिस्तदा योगमवाप्स्यसि
transliteration: śrutivipratipannā te yadā sthāsyati niścalā, samādhāvacalā buddhistadā yogamavāpsyasi
hindi_meaning: जिस कालमें शास्त्रीय मतभेदोंसे विचलित हुई तेरी बुद्धि निश्चल हो जायगी और परमात्मामें अचल हो जायगी, उस कालमें तू योगको प्राप्त हो जायगा।
english_meaning: When your mind that has become bewildered by hearing [S. takes the word sruti in the sense of the Vedas.-Tr.] will become unshakable and steadfast in the Self, then you will attain Yoga that arises from discrimination.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: स्थितप्रज्ञस्य का भाषा समाधिस्थस्य केशव। स्थितधीः किं प्रभाषेत किमासीत व्रजेत किम्
transliteration: sthitaprajñasya kā bhāṣā samādhisthasya keśava, sthitadhīḥ kiṃ prabhāṣeta kimāsīta vrajeta kim
hindi_meaning: अर्जुन बोले - हे केशव ! परमात्मामें स्थित स्थिर बुद्धिवाले मनुष्यके क्या लक्षण होते हैं? वह स्थिर बुद्धिवाला मनुष्य कैसे बोलता है, कैसे बैठता है और कैसे चलता है?
english_meaning: Arjuna said O kesava, what is the description of a man of steady wisdom who is Self-absorbed? How does the man of steady wisdom speak? How does he sit? How does he move about?
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: प्रजहाति यदा कामान् सर्वान् पार्थ मनोगतान्। आत्मन्येवात्मना तुष्टः स्थितप्रज्ञस्तदोच्यते
transliteration: prajahāti yadā kāmān sarvān pārtha manogatān, ātmanyevātmanā tuṣṭaḥ sthitaprajñastadocyate
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले - हे पृथानन्दन ! जिस कालमें साधक मनोगत सम्पूर्ण कामनाओंका अच्छी तरह त्याग कर देता है और अपने-आपसे अपने-आपमें ही सन्तुष्ट रहता है, उस कालमें वह स्थितप्रज्ञ कहा जाता है।
english_meaning: The Blessed said O Partha, when one fully renounces all the desires that have entered the mind, and remains satisfied in the Self alone by the Self, then he is called a man of steady wisdom.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: दुःखेष्वनुद्विग्नमनाः सुखेषु विगतस्पृहः। वीतरागभयक्रोधः स्थितधीर्मुनिरुच्यते
transliteration: duḥkheṣvanudvignamanāḥ sukheṣu vigataspṛhaḥ, vītarāgabhayakrodhaḥ sthitadhīrmunirucyate
hindi_meaning: दुःखोंकी प्राप्ति होनेपर जिसके मनमें उद्वेग नहीं होता और सुखोंकी प्राप्ति होनेपर जिसके मनमें स्पृहा नहीं होती तथा जो राग, भय और क्रोधसे सर्वथा रहित हो गया है, वह मननशील मनुष्य स्थिरबुद्धि कहा जाता है।
english_meaning: That monk is called a man of steady wisdom when his mind is unperturbed in sorrow, he is free from longing for delights, and has gone beyond attachment, fear and anger.
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: यः सर्वत्रानभिस्नेहस्तत्तत्प्राप्य शुभाशुभम्। नाभिनन्दति न द्वेष्टि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता
transliteration: yaḥ sarvatrānabhisnehastattatprāpya śubhāśubham, nābhinandati na dveṣṭi tasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā
hindi_meaning: सब जगह आसक्तिरहित हुआ जो मनुष्य उस-उस शुभ-अशुभको प्राप्त करके न तो अभिनन्दित होता है और न द्वेष करता है, उसकी बुद्धि प्रतिष्ठित है।
english_meaning: The wisdom of that person remains established who has not attachment for anything anywhere, who neither welcomes nor rejects anything whatever good or bad when he comes across it.
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.
