sanskrit_text: यदा संहरते चायं कूर्मोऽङ्गानीव सर्वशः। इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता
transliteration: yadā saṃharate cāyaṃ kūrmo'ṅgānīva sarvaśaḥ, indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyastasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā
hindi_meaning: जिस तरह कछुआ अपने अङ्गोंको सब ओरसे समेट लेता है, ऐसे ही जिस कालमें यह कर्मयोगी इन्द्रियोंके विषयोंसे इन्द्रियोंको सब प्रकारसे समेट लेता (हटा लेता) है, तब उसकी बुद्धि प्रतिष्ठित हो जाती है।
english_meaning: And when this one fully withdraws the senses from the objects of the senses, as a tortoise wholly (withdraws) the limbs, then his wisdom remains established.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: विषया विनिवर्तन्ते निराहारस्य देहिनः। रसवर्जं रसोऽप्यस्य परं दृष्ट्वा निवर्तते
transliteration: viṣayā vinivartante nirāhārasya dehinaḥ, rasavarjaṃ raso'pyasya paraṃ dṛṣṭvā nivartate
hindi_meaning: निराहारी (इन्द्रियोंको विषयोंसे हटानेवाले) मनुष्यके भी विषय तो निवृत्त हो जाते हैं, पर रस निवृत्त नहीं होता। परन्तु इस स्थितप्रज्ञ मनुष्यका तो रस भी परमात्मतत्त्वका अनुभव होनेसे निवृत्त हो जाता है।
english_meaning: The objects recede from an abstinent man, with the exception of the taste (for them). Even the taste of this person falls away after realization the Absolute.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: यततो ह्यपि कौन्तेय पुरुषस्य विपश्चितः। इन्द्रियाणि प्रमाथीनि हरन्ति प्रसभं मनः
transliteration: yatato hyapi kaunteya puruṣasya vipaścitaḥ, indriyāṇi pramāthīni haranti prasabhaṃ manaḥ
hindi_meaning: हे कुन्तीनन्दन! (रसबुद्धि रहनेसे) यत्न करते हुए विद्वान् मनुष्यकी भी प्रमथनशील इन्द्रियाँ उसके मनको बलपूर्वक हर लेती हैं।
english_meaning: For, O son of Kunti, the turbulent organs violently snatch away the mind of an intelligent person, even while he is striving diligently.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: तानि सर्वाणि संयम्य युक्त आसीत मत्परः। वशे हि यस्येन्द्रियाणि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता
transliteration: tāni sarvāṇi saṃyamya yukta āsīta matparaḥ, vaśe hi yasyendriyāṇi tasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā
hindi_meaning: कर्मयोगी साधक उन सम्पूर्ण इन्द्रियोंको वशमें करके मेरे परायण होकर बैठे; क्योंकि जिसकी इन्द्रियाँ वशमें हैं, उसकी बुद्धि प्रतिष्ठित है।
english_meaning: Controlling all of them, one should remain concentrated on Me as the supreme. For, the wisdom of one whose organs are under control becomes steadfast.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते। सङ्गात्सञ्जायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते॥
transliteration: dhyayato visayan pumsah sangas tesupajayate, sangat sanjayate kamah kamat krodho 'bhijayate
hindi_meaning: विषयों का चिंतन करने से मनुष्य को उनमें आसक्ति हो जाती है। आसक्ति से काम उत्पन्न होता है और काम से क्रोध उत्पन्न होता है।
english_meaning: While contemplating the objects of the senses, a person develops attachment for them, and from such attachment lust develops, and from lust anger arises.
practical_guidance: Notice what you are spending your mental energy obsessing over — a person, a goal, social media, food, or a substance. That repeated contemplation grows into craving, and unmet craving becomes anger. Practice redirecting your attention for even 10 minutes today to something wholesome.

sanskrit_text: क्रोधाद्भवति सम्मोहः सम्मोहात्स्मृतिविभ्रमः। स्मृतिभ्रंशाद्बुद्धिनाशो बुद्धिनाशात्प्रणश्यति॥
transliteration: krodhad bhavati sammohah sammohat smrti-vibhramah, smrti-bhramsad buddhi-naso buddhi-nasat pranasyati
hindi_meaning: क्रोध से मोह उत्पन्न होता है, मोह से स्मृति भ्रमित हो जाती है। स्मृति के भ्रमित होने से बुद्धि का नाश होता है और बुद्धि के नाश से मनुष्य का पतन हो जाता है।
english_meaning: From anger, complete delusion arises, and from delusion bewilderment of memory. When memory is bewildered, intelligence is lost, and when intelligence is lost one falls down again into the material pool.
practical_guidance: Anger destroys your clarity step by step — it clouds your memory, then your judgment, then your wisdom. Before you respond in anger to someone, pause for 60 seconds. Take three deep breaths. Ask yourself: 'What would the clearest, wisest version of me do right now?'

sanskrit_text: रागद्वेषवियुक्तैस्तु विषयानिन्द्रियैश्चरन्। आत्मवश्यैर्विधेयात्मा प्रसादमधिगच्छति
transliteration: rāgadveṣaviyuktaistu viṣayānindriyaiścaran, ātmavaśyairvidheyātmā prasādamadhigacchati
hindi_meaning: -- 2.65।। वशीभूत अन्तःकरणवाला कर्मयोगी साधक रागद्वेषसे रहित अपने वशमें की हुई इन्द्रियोंके द्वारा विषयोंका सेवन करता हुआ अन्तःकरणकी निर्मलता को प्राप्त हो जाता है। निर्मलता प्राप्त होनेपर साधकके सम्पूर्ण दुःखोंका नाश हो जाता है और ऐसे शुद्ध चित्तवाले साधककी बुद्धि निःसन्देह बहुत जल्दी परमात्मामें स्थिर हो जाती है।
english_meaning: But by perceiving objects with the organs that are free from attraction and repulsion, and are under his own control, the self-controlled man attains serenity.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: प्रसादे सर्वदुःखानां हानिरस्योपजायते। प्रसन्नचेतसो ह्याशु बुद्धिः पर्यवतिष्ठते
transliteration: prasāde sarvaduḥkhānāṃ hānirasyopajāyate, prasannacetaso hyāśu buddhiḥ paryavatiṣṭhate
hindi_meaning: -- 2.65।। वशीभूत अन्तःकरणवाला कर्मयोगी साधक रागद्वेषसे रहित अपने वशमें की हुई इन्द्रियोंके द्वारा विषयोंका सेवन करता हुआ अन्तःकरणकी निर्मलता को प्राप्त हो जाता है। निर्मलता प्राप्त होनेपर साधकके सम्पूर्ण दुःखोंका नाश हो जाता है और ऐसे शुद्ध चित्तवाले साधककी बुद्धि निःसन्देह बहुत जल्दी परमात्मामें स्थिर हो जाती है।
english_meaning: When there is serenity, there follows eradication of all his sorrows, because the wisdom of one who has a serene mind soon becomes firmly established.
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: नास्ति बुद्धिरयुक्तस्य न चायुक्तस्य भावना। न चाभावयतः शान्तिरशान्तस्य कुतः सुखम्
transliteration: nāsti buddhirayuktasya na cāyuktasya bhāvanā, na cābhāvayataḥ śāntiraśāntasya kutaḥ sukham
hindi_meaning: जिसके मन-इन्द्रियाँ संयमित नहीं हैं, ऐसे मनुष्यकी व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धि नहीं होती और व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धि न होनेसे उसमें कर्तव्यपरायणताकी भावना नहीं होती। ऐसी भावना न होनेसे उसको शान्ति नहीं मिलती। फिर शान्तिरहित मनुष्यको सुख कैसे मिल सकता है?
english_meaning: For the unsteady there is no wisdom, and there is no meditation for the unsteady man. And for an unmeditative man there is no peace. How can there be happiness for one without peace?
practical_guidance: Practice being the observer of your emotions today — feel them fully, but stay rooted. Be the sky that holds the storm, not the storm itself.

sanskrit_text: इन्द्रियाणां हि चरतां यन्मनोऽनुविधीयते। तदस्य हरति प्रज्ञां वायुर्नावमिवाम्भसि
transliteration: indriyāṇāṃ hi caratāṃ yanmano'nuvidhīyate, tadasya harati prajñāṃ vāyurnāvamivāmbhasi
hindi_meaning: अपने-अपने विषयोंमें विचरती हुई इन्द्रियोंमेंसे एक ही इन्द्रिय जिस मनको अपना अनुगामी बना लेती है, वह अकेला मन जलमें नौकाको वायुकी तरह इसकी बुद्धिको हर लेता है।
english_meaning: For, the mind which follows in the wake of the wandering senses, that (mind) carries away his wisdom like the mind (diverting) a boat on the waters.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: तस्माद्यस्य महाबाहो निगृहीतानि सर्वशः। इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता
transliteration: tasmādyasya mahābāho nigṛhītāni sarvaśaḥ, indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyastasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā
hindi_meaning: इसलिये हे महाबाहो ! जिस मनुष्यकी इन्द्रियाँ इन्द्रियोंके विषयोंसे सर्वथा निगृहीत (वशमें की हुई) हैं, उसकी बुद्धि स्थिर है।
english_meaning: Therefore, O mighty-armed one, this wisdom becomes established whose organs in all their varieties are withdrawn from their objects.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: या निशा सर्वभूतानां तस्यां जागर्ति संयमी। यस्यां जाग्रति भूतानि सा निशा पश्यतो मुनेः
transliteration: yā niśā sarvabhūtānāṃ tasyāṃ jāgarti saṃyamī, yasyāṃ jāgrati bhūtāni sā niśā paśyato muneḥ
hindi_meaning: सम्पूर्ण प्राणियों की जो रात (परमात्मासे विमुखता) है, उसमें संयमी मनुष्य जागता है, और जिसमें सब प्राणी जागते हैं (भोग और संग्रहमें लगे रहते हैं), वह तत्त्वको जाननेवाले मुनिकी दृष्टिमें रात है।
english_meaning: The self-restrained man keeps awake during that which is night for all creatures. That during which creatures keep awake, it is night to the seeing sage.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: आपूर्यमाणमचलप्रतिष्ठं समुद्रमापः प्रविशन्ति यद्वत्। तद्वत्कामा यं प्रविशन्ति सर्वे स शान्तिमाप्नोति न कामकामी
transliteration: āpūryamāṇamacalapratiṣṭhaṃ samudramāpaḥ praviśanti yadvat, tadvatkāmā yaṃ praviśanti sarve sa śāntimāpnoti na kāmakāmī
hindi_meaning: जैसे सम्पूर्ण नदियोंका जल चारों ओरसे जलद्वारा परिपूर्ण समुद्रमें आकर मिलता है, पर समुद्र अपनी मर्यादामें अचल प्रतिष्ठित रहता है ऐसे ही सम्पूर्ण भोग-पदार्थ जिस संयमी मनुष्य को विकार उत्पन्न किये बिना ही उसको प्राप्त होते हैं, वही मनुष्य परमशान्तिको प्राप्त होता है, भोगोंकी कामनावाला नहीं।
english_meaning: That man attains peace into whom all desires enter in the same way as the waters flow into a sea that remains unchanged (even) when being filled up from all sides. Not so one who is desirous of objects.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: विहाय कामान्यः सर्वान्पुमांश्चरति निःस्पृहः। निर्ममो निरहंकारः स शांतिमधिगच्छति
transliteration: vihāya kāmānyaḥ sarvānpumāṃścarati niḥspṛhaḥ, nirmamo nirahaṃkāraḥ sa śāṃtimadhigacchati
hindi_meaning: जो मनुष्य सम्पूर्ण कामनाओंका त्याग करके स्पृहारहित, ममतारहित और अहंकाररहित होकर आचरण करता है, वह शान्तिको प्राप्त होता है।
english_meaning: That man attains peace who, after rejecting all desires, moves about free from hankering, without the idea of ('me' and) 'mine', and devoid of pride.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: एषा ब्राह्मी स्थितिः पार्थ नैनां प्राप्य विमुह्यति। स्थित्वाऽस्यामन्तकालेऽपि ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृच्छति
transliteration: eṣā brāhmī sthitiḥ pārtha naināṃ prāpya vimuhyati, sthitvā'syāmantakāle'pi brahmanirvāṇamṛcchati
hindi_meaning: हे पृथानन्दन ! यह ब्राह्मी स्थिति है। इसको प्राप्त होकर कभी कोई मोहित नहीं होता। इस स्थितिमें यदि अन्तकालमें भी स्थित हो जाय, तो निर्वाण (शान्त) ब्रह्मकी प्राप्ति हो जाती है।
english_meaning: O Partha, this is the state of being established in Brahman. One does not become deluded after attaining this. One attains identification with Brahman by being established in this state even in the closing years of one's life.
practical_guidance: You cannot undo the past, only respond to it now. Forgive yourself as you would a dear friend who made a mistake. Then take one right action today.

sanskrit_text: ज्यायसी चेत्कर्मणस्ते मता बुद्धिर्जनार्दन। तत्किं कर्मणि घोरे मां नियोजयसि केशव
transliteration: jyāyasī cetkarmaṇaste matā buddhirjanārdana, tatkiṃ karmaṇi ghore māṃ niyojayasi keśava
hindi_meaning: -- 3.2।। अर्जुन बोले -- हे जनार्दन! अगर आप कर्मसे बुद्धि- (ज्ञान-) को श्रेष्ठ मानते हैं, तो फिर हे केशव ! मुझे घोर कर्ममें क्यों लगाते हैं ? आप अपने मिले हुए-से वचनोंसे मेरी बुद्धिको मोहित-सी कर रहे हैं। अतः आप निश्चय करके उस एक बात को कहिये, जिससे मैं कल्याणको प्राप्त हो जाऊँ।
english_meaning: Arjuna said O Janardana (krsna), if it be Your opinion that wisdom is superior to action, why they do you urge me to horrible aciton, O Kesava ?
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: व्यामिश्रेणेव वाक्येन बुद्धिं मोहयसीव मे। तदेकं वद निश्िचत्य येन श्रेयोऽहमाप्नुयाम्
transliteration: vyāmiśreṇeva vākyena buddhiṃ mohayasīva me, tadekaṃ vada niśिcatya yena śreyo'hamāpnuyām
hindi_meaning: -- 3.2।। अर्जुन बोले -- हे जनार्दन! अगर आप कर्मसे बुद्धि- (ज्ञान-) को श्रेष्ठ मानते हैं, तो फिर हे केशव! मुझे घोर कर्ममें क्यों लगाते हैं ? आप अपने मिले हुए-से वचनोंसे मेरी बुद्धिको मोहित-सी कर रहे हैं। अतः आप निश्चय करके एक बात को कहिये, जिससे मैं कल्याणको प्राप्त हो जाऊँ।
english_meaning: You bewilder my understanding, as it were, by a seemingly conflicting statement! Tell me for certain one of these by which I may attain the highest Good.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: लोकेऽस्मिन्द्विविधा निष्ठा पुरा प्रोक्ता मयानघ। ज्ञानयोगेन सांख्यानां कर्मयोगेन योगिनाम्
transliteration: loke'smindvividhā niṣṭhā purā proktā mayānagha, jñānayogena sāṃkhyānāṃ karmayogena yoginām
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले - हे निष्पाप अर्जुन! इस मनुष्यलोकमें दो प्रकारसे होनेवाली निष्ठा मेरे द्वारा पहले कही गयी है। उनमें ज्ञानियोंकी निष्ठा ज्ञानयोगसे और योगियोंकी निष्ठा कर्मयोगसे होती है।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said O unblemished one, two kinds of steadfastness in this world were spoken of by Me in the days of yore-through the Yoga of Knowledge for the men of realization; through the Yoga of Action for the yogis.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: न कर्मणामनारम्भान्नैष्कर्म्यं पुरुषोऽश्नुते। न च संन्यसनादेव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति
transliteration: na karmaṇāmanārambhānnaiṣkarmyaṃ puruṣo'śnute, na ca saṃnyasanādeva siddhiṃ samadhigacchati
hindi_meaning: मनुष्य न तो कर्मोंका आरम्भ किये बिना निष्कर्मताको प्राप्त होता है और न कर्मोंके त्यागमात्रसे सिद्धिको ही प्राप्त होता है।
english_meaning: A person does not attain freedom from action by abstaining from action; nor does he attain fulfilment merely through renunciation.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: न हि कश्िचत्क्षणमपि जातु तिष्ठत्यकर्मकृत्। कार्यते ह्यवशः कर्म सर्वः प्रकृतिजैर्गुणैः
transliteration: na hi kaśिcatkṣaṇamapi jātu tiṣṭhatyakarmakṛt, kāryate hyavaśaḥ karma sarvaḥ prakṛtijairguṇaiḥ
hindi_meaning: कोई भी मनुष्य किसी भी अवस्थामें क्षणमात्र भी कर्म किये बिना नहीं रह सकता; क्योंकि (प्रकृतिके) परवश हुए सब प्राणियोंसे प्रकृतिजन्य गुण कर्म कराते हैं।
english_meaning: Because, no one ever remains even for a moment without doing work. For all are made to work under compulsion by the gunas born of Nature.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन्। इन्द्रियार्थान्विमूढात्मा मिथ्याचारः स उच्यते
transliteration: karmendriyāṇi saṃyamya ya āste manasā smaran, indriyārthānvimūḍhātmā mithyācāraḥ sa ucyate
hindi_meaning: जो कर्मेन्द्रियों- (सम्पूर्ण इन्द्रियों-) को हठपूर्वक रोककर मनसे इन्द्रियोंके विषयोंका चिन्तन करता रहता है, वह मूढ़ बुद्धिवाला मनुष्य मिथ्याचारी (मिथ्या आचरण करनेवाला) कहा जाता है।
english_meaning: One, who after withdrawing the organs of action, sits mentally recollecting the objects of the senses, that one, of deluded mind, is called a hypocrite.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: यस्त्विन्द्रियाणि मनसा नियम्यारभतेऽर्जुन। कर्मेन्द्रियैः कर्मयोगमसक्तः स विशिष्यते
transliteration: yastvindriyāṇi manasā niyamyārabhate'rjuna, karmendriyaiḥ karmayogamasaktaḥ sa viśiṣyate
hindi_meaning: हे अर्जुन! जो मनुष्य मनसे इन्द्रियोंपर नियन्त्रण करके आसक्तिरहित होकर (निष्काम भावसे) समस्त इन्द्रियोंके द्वारा कर्मयोगका आचरण करता है, वही श्रेष्ठ है।
english_meaning: But, O Arjuna, one who engages in Karma-yoga with the organs of action, controlling the organs with the mind and becoming unattached-that one excels.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः। शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः
transliteration: niyataṃ kuru karma tvaṃ karma jyāyo hyakarmaṇaḥ, śarīrayātrāpi ca te na prasiddhyedakarmaṇaḥ
hindi_meaning: तू शास्त्रविधिसे नियत किये हुए कर्तव्य-कर्म कर; क्योंकि कर्म न करनेकी अपेक्षा कर्म करना श्रेष्ठ है तथा कर्म न करनेसे तेरा शरीर-निर्वाह भी सिद्ध नहीं होगा।
english_meaning: You perform the obligatory duties, for action is superior to inaction. And, through inaction, even the maintenance of your body will not be possible.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: यज्ञार्थात्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कर्मबन्धनः। तदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसंगः समाचर
transliteration: yajñārthātkarmaṇo'nyatra loko'yaṃ karmabandhanaḥ, tadarthaṃ karma kaunteya muktasaṃgaḥ samācara
hindi_meaning: यज्ञ (कर्तव्यपालन) के लिये किये जानेवाले कर्मोंसे अन्यत्र (अपने लिये किये जानेवाले) कर्मोंमें लगा हुआ यह मनुष्य-समुदाय कर्मोंसे बँधता है, इसलिये हे कुन्तीनन्दन ! तू आसक्ति-रहित होकर उस यज्ञके लिये ही कर्तव्य-कर्म कर।
english_meaning: This man becomes bound by actions other than that action meant for God. Without being attached, O son of Kunti, you perform actions for Him.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: सहयज्ञाः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा पुरोवाच प्रजापतिः। अनेन प्रसविष्यध्वमेष वोऽस्त्विष्टकामधुक्
transliteration: sahayajñāḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā purovāca prajāpatiḥ, anena prasaviṣyadhvameṣa vo'stviṣṭakāmadhuk
hindi_meaning: -- 3.11।। प्रजापति ब्रह्माजीने सृष्टिके आदिकालमें कर्तव्य-कर्मोंके विधानसहित प्रजा-(मनुष्य आदि-) की रचना करके उनसे (प्रधानतया मनुष्योंसे) कहा कि तुमलोग इस कर्तव्यके द्वारा सबकी वृद्धि करो और वह कर्तव्य-कर्म-रूप यज्ञ तुमलोगोंको कर्तव्य-पालनकी आवश्यक सामग्री प्रदान करनेवाला हो। अपने कर्तव्य-कर्मके द्वारा तुमलोग देवताओंको उन्नत करो और वे देवतालोग अपने कर्तव्यके द्वारा तुमलोगोंको उन्नत करें। इस प्रकार एक-दूसरेको उन्नत करते हुए तुमलोग परम कल्याणको प्राप्त हो जाओगे।
english_meaning: In the days of yore, having created the beings together with the sacrifices, Prajapati said: 'By this you multiply. Let this be your yielder of coveted objects of desire.'
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: देवान्भावयतानेन ते देवा भावयन्तु वः। परस्परं भावयन्तः श्रेयः परमवाप्स्यथ
transliteration: devānbhāvayatānena te devā bhāvayantu vaḥ, parasparaṃ bhāvayantaḥ śreyaḥ paramavāpsyatha
hindi_meaning: -- 3.11।। प्रजापति ब्रह्माजीने सृष्टिके आदिकालमें कर्तव्य-कर्मोंके विधानसहित प्रजा-(मनुष्य आदि-) की रचना करके (उनसे, प्रधानतया मनुष्योंसे) कहा कि तुमलोग इस कर्तव्यके द्वारा सबकी वृद्धि करो और वह कर्तव्य-कर्म-रूप यज्ञ तुमलोगोंको कर्तव्य-पालनकी आवश्यक सामग्री प्रदान करनेवाला हो। अपने कर्तव्य-कर्मके द्वारा तुमलोग देवताओंको उन्नत करो और वे देवतालोग अपने कर्तव्यके द्वारा तुमलोगोंको उन्नत करें। इस प्रकार एक-दूसरेको उन्नत करते हुए तुमलोग परम कल्याणको प्राप्त हो जाओगे।
english_meaning: 'You nourish the gods with this. Let those gods nourish you. Nourishing one another, you shall attain the supreme Good.'
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: इष्टान्भोगान्हि वो देवा दास्यन्ते यज्ञभाविताः। तैर्दत्तानप्रदायैभ्यो यो भुङ्क्ते स्तेन एव सः
transliteration: iṣṭānbhogānhi vo devā dāsyante yajñabhāvitāḥ, tairdattānapradāyaibhyo yo bhuṅkte stena eva saḥ
hindi_meaning: यज्ञसे भावित (पुष्ट) हुए देवता भी तुमलोगोंको (बिना माँगे ही) कर्तव्य-पालनकी आवश्यक सामग्री देते रहेंगे। इस प्रकार उन देवताओंसे प्राप्त हुई सामग्रीको दूसरोंकी सेवामें लगाये बिना जो मनुष्य स्वयं ही उसका उपभोग करता है, वह चोर ही है।
english_meaning: 'Being nourished by sacrifices, the gods will indeed give you the coveted enjoyments. He is certainly a theif who enjoys what have been given by them without offering (these) to them.'
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: यज्ञशिष्टाशिनः सन्तो मुच्यन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः। भुञ्जते ते त्वघं पापा ये पचन्त्यात्मकारणात्
transliteration: yajñaśiṣṭāśinaḥ santo mucyante sarvakilbiṣaiḥ, bhuñjate te tvaghaṃ pāpā ye pacantyātmakāraṇāt
hindi_meaning: यज्ञशेष- (योग-) का अनुभव करनेवाले श्रेष्ठ मनुष्य सम्पूर्ण पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाते हैं। परन्तु जो केवल अपने लिये ही पकाते अर्थात् सब कर्म करते हैं, वे पापीलोग तो पापका ही भक्षण करते हैं।
english_meaning: By becoming partakers of the remembers of sacrifices, they become freed from all sins. But the unholy persons who cook for themselves, they incur sin.
practical_guidance: You cannot undo the past, only respond to it now. Forgive yourself as you would a dear friend who made a mistake. Then take one right action today.

sanskrit_text: अन्नाद्भवन्ति भूतानि पर्जन्यादन्नसम्भवः। यज्ञाद्भवति पर्जन्यो यज्ञः कर्मसमुद्भवः
transliteration: annādbhavanti bhūtāni parjanyādannasambhavaḥ, yajñādbhavati parjanyo yajñaḥ karmasamudbhavaḥ
hindi_meaning: -- 3.15।। सम्पूर्ण प्राणी अन्नसे उत्पन्न होते हैं। अन्न वर्षासे होती है। वर्षा यज्ञसे होती है। यज्ञ कर्मोंसे निष्पन्न होता है। कर्मोंको तू वेदसे उत्पन्न जान और वेदको अक्षरब्रह्मसे प्रकट हुआ जान। इसलिये वह सर्वव्यापी परमात्मा यज्ञ (कर्तव्य-कर्म) में नित्य प्रतिष्ठित है।
english_meaning: From food are born the creatures; the origin of food is from rainfall; rainfall originates from sacrifice; sacrifice has action as its origin.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: कर्म ब्रह्मोद्भवं विद्धि ब्रह्माक्षरसमुद्भवम्। तस्मात्सर्वगतं ब्रह्म नित्यं यज्ञे प्रतिष्ठितम्
transliteration: karma brahmodbhavaṃ viddhi brahmākṣarasamudbhavam, tasmātsarvagataṃ brahma nityaṃ yajñe pratiṣṭhitam
hindi_meaning: -- 3.15।। सम्पूर्ण प्राणी अन्नसे उत्पन्न होते हैं। अन्न वर्षासे होती है। वर्षा यज्ञसे होती है। यज्ञ कर्मोंसे निष्पन्न होता है। कर्मोंको तू वेदसे उत्पन्न जान और वेदको अक्षरब्रह्मसे प्रकट हुआ जान। इसलिये वह सर्वव्यापी परमात्मा यज्ञ (कर्तव्य-कर्म) में नित्य प्रतिष्ठित है।
english_meaning: Know that actin has the veda as its origin; the Vedas has the Immutable as its source. Hence, the all-pervading Veda is for ever based on sacrifice.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: एवं प्रवर्तितं चक्रं नानुवर्तयतीह यः। अघायुरिन्द्रियारामो मोघं पार्थ स जीवति
transliteration: evaṃ pravartitaṃ cakraṃ nānuvartayatīha yaḥ, aghāyurindriyārāmo moghaṃ pārtha sa jīvati
hindi_meaning: हे पार्थ! जो मनुष्य इस लोकमें इस प्रकार परम्परासे प्रचलित सृष्टिचक्रके अनुसार नहीं चलता, वह इन्द्रियोंके द्वारा भोगोंमें रमण करनेवाला अघायु (पापमय जीवन बितानेवाला) मनुष्य संसारमें व्यर्थ ही जीता है।
english_meaning: O Partha, he lives in vain who does not follow here the wheel thus set in motion, whose life is sinful, and who indulges in the senses.
practical_guidance: Cravings are temporary visitors — they will pass. When an urge arises, pause for three slow breaths before responding. The gap is where freedom lives.

sanskrit_text: यस्त्वात्मरतिरेव स्यादात्मतृप्तश्च मानवः। आत्मन्येव च सन्तुष्टस्तस्य कार्यं न विद्यते
transliteration: yastvātmaratireva syādātmatṛptaśca mānavaḥ, ātmanyeva ca santuṣṭastasya kāryaṃ na vidyate
hindi_meaning: जो मनुष्य अपने-आपमें ही रमण करनेवाला और अपने-आपमें ही तृप्त तथा अपने-आपमें ही संतुष्ट है, उसके लिये कोई कर्तव्य नहीं है।
english_meaning: But that man who rejoices only in theSelf and is satisfied with the Self, and is contented only in the Self-for him there is no duty to perform.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: नैव तस्य कृतेनार्थो नाकृतेनेह कश्चन। न चास्य सर्वभूतेषु कश्िचदर्थव्यपाश्रयः
transliteration: naiva tasya kṛtenārtho nākṛteneha kaścana, na cāsya sarvabhūteṣu kaśिcadarthavyapāśrayaḥ
hindi_meaning: उस (कर्मयोगसे सिद्ध हुए) महापुरुषका इस संसारमें न तो कर्म करनेसे कोई प्रयोजन रहता है, और न कर्म न करनेसे ही कोई प्रयोजन रहता है, तथा सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंमें (किसी भी प्राणीके साथ) इसका किञ्चिन्मात्र भी स्वार्थका सम्बन्ध नहीं रहता।
english_meaning: For him there is no concern here at all with performing action; nor any (concern) with nonperformance. Moreover, for him there is no dependence on any object to serve any purpose.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर। असक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः
transliteration: tasmādasaktaḥ satataṃ kāryaṃ karma samācara, asakto hyācarankarma paramāpnoti pūruṣaḥ
hindi_meaning: इसलिये तू निरन्तर आसक्तिरहित होकर कर्तव्य-कर्मका भलीभाँति आचरण कर; क्योंकि आसक्तिरहित होकर कर्म करता हुआ मनुष्य परमात्माको प्राप्त हो जाता है।
english_meaning: Therefore, remaining unattached, always perform the obligatory duty, for, by performing (one's) duty without attachment, a person attains the Highest.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: कर्मणैव हि संसिद्धिमास्थिता जनकादयः। लोकसंग्रहमेवापि संपश्यन्कर्तुमर्हसि
transliteration: karmaṇaiva hi saṃsiddhimāsthitā janakādayaḥ, lokasaṃgrahamevāpi saṃpaśyankartumarhasi
hindi_meaning: राजा जनक-जैसे अनेक महापुरुष भी कर्मके द्वारा ही परमसिद्धिको प्राप्त हुए हैं। इसलिये लोकसंग्रहको देखते हुए भी तू (निष्कामभावसे) कर्म करनेके योग्य है।
english_meaning: For Janaka and others strove to attain Liberation through action itself. You ought to perform (your duties) keeping also in view the prevention of mankind from going astray.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः। स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते॥
transliteration: yad yad acarati sresthah tat tad evetaro janah, sa yat pramanam kurute lokas tad anuvartate
hindi_meaning: श्रेष्ठ पुरुष जो-जो आचरण करता है, सामान्य मनुष्य भी वैसा ही करते हैं। वह जो प्रमाण स्थापित करता है, संसार उसका अनुसरण करता है।
english_meaning: Whatever action a great person performs, common people follow. And whatever standards they set by exemplary acts, all the world pursues.
practical_guidance: You are being watched by those who look up to you — your children, colleagues, or friends — whether you know it or not. Act today as if your actions are setting the standard for those around you. What one behavior can you model with excellence today?

sanskrit_text: न मे पार्थास्ति कर्तव्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु किञ्चन। नानवाप्तमवाप्तव्यं वर्त एव च कर्मणि
transliteration: na me pārthāsti kartavyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu kiñcana, nānavāptamavāptavyaṃ varta eva ca karmaṇi
hindi_meaning: हे पार्थ! मुझे तीनों लोकोंमें न तो कुछ कर्तव्य है और न कोई प्राप्त करनेयोग्य वस्तु अप्राप्त है, फिर भी मैं कर्तव्यकर्ममें ही लगा रहता हूँ।
english_meaning: In all the three worlds, O Partha, there is no duty whatsoever for Me (to fulfil); nothing remains unachieved or to be achieved. [According to S. the translation of this portion is: There is nothing unattained that should be attained.-Tr.] (Still) do I continue in action.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: यदि ह्यहं न वर्तेयं जातु कर्मण्यतन्द्रितः। मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः
transliteration: yadi hyahaṃ na varteyaṃ jātu karmaṇyatandritaḥ, mama vartmānuvartante manuṣyāḥ pārtha sarvaśaḥ
hindi_meaning: -- 3.24।। हे पार्थ! अगर मैं किसी समय सावधान होकर कर्तव्यकर्म न करूँ तो बड़ी हानि हो जाय; क्योंकि मनुष्य सब प्रकारसे मेरे ही मार्गका अनुसरण करते हैं। यदि मैं कर्म न करूँ, तो ये सब मनुष्य नष्ट-भ्रष्ट हो जायँ और मैं वर्णसंकरताको करनेवाला होऊँ तथा इस समस्त प्रजाको नष्ट करनेवाला बनूँ।
english_meaning: For, O Partha, if at any time I do not continue [Ast. and A.A. read varteya instead of varteyam.-Tr.] vigilantly in action, men will follow My path in ever way.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: उत्सीदेयुरिमे लोका न कुर्यां कर्म चेदहम्। सङ्करस्य च कर्ता स्यामुपहन्यामिमाः प्रजाः
transliteration: utsīdeyurime lokā na kuryāṃ karma cedaham, saṅkarasya ca kartā syāmupahanyāmimāḥ prajāḥ
hindi_meaning: -- 3.24।। हे पार्थ ! अगर मैं किसी समय सावधान होकर कर्तव्य-कर्म न करूँ (तो बड़ी हानि हो जाय; क्योंकि) मनुष्य सब प्रकारसे मेरे ही मार्गका अनुसरण करते हैं। यदि मैं कर्म न करूँ, तो ये सब मनुष्य नष्ट-भ्रष्ट हो जायँ और मैं वर्णसंकरताको करनेवाला तथा इस समस्त प्रजाको नष्ट करनेवाला बनूँ।
english_meaning: These worlds will be ruined if I do not perform action. And I shall become the agent of intermingling (of castes), and shall be destroying these beings.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: सक्ताः कर्मण्यविद्वांसो यथा कुर्वन्ति भारत। कुर्याद्विद्वांस्तथासक्तश्िचकीर्षुर्लोकसंग्रहम्
transliteration: saktāḥ karmaṇyavidvāṃso yathā kurvanti bhārata, kuryādvidvāṃstathāsaktaśिcakīrṣurlokasaṃgraham
hindi_meaning: -- 3.26।। हे भरतवंशोद्भव अर्जुन! कर्ममें आसक्त हुए अज्ञानीजन जिस प्रकार कर्म करते हैं, आसक्तिरहित विद्वान भी लोकसंग्रह करना चाहता हुआ उसी प्रकार कर्म करे। तत्त्वज्ञ महापुरुष कर्मोंमें आसक्तिवाले अज्ञानी मनुष्योंकी बुद्धिमें भ्रम उत्पन्न न करे, प्रत्युत स्वयं समस्त कर्मोंको अच्छी तरहसे करता हुआ उनसे भी वैसे ही करवाये।
english_meaning: O scion of the Bharata dynasty, as the unelightened poeple act with attachment to work, so should the enlightened person act, without attachment, being desirous of the prevention of people from going astray.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: न बुद्धिभेदं जनयेदज्ञानां कर्मसङ्गिनाम्। जोषयेत्सर्वकर्माणि विद्वान् युक्तः समाचरन्
transliteration: na buddhibhedaṃ janayedajñānāṃ karmasaṅginām, joṣayetsarvakarmāṇi vidvān yuktaḥ samācaran
hindi_meaning: -- 3.26।। हे भरतवंशोद्भव अर्जुन! कर्ममें आसक्त हुए अज्ञानीजन जिस प्रकार कर्म करते हैं आसक्तिरहित विद्वान भी लोकसंग्रह करना चाहता हुआ उसी प्रकार कर्म करे। सावधान तत्त्वज्ञ महापुरुष कर्मोंमें आसक्तिवाले अज्ञानी मनुष्योंकी बुद्धिमें भ्रम उत्पन्न न करे, प्रत्युत स्वयं समस्त कर्मोंको अच्छी तरहसे करता हुआ उनसे भी वैसे ही करवाये।
english_meaning: The enlightened man should not create disturbance in the beliefs of the ignorant, who are attached to work. Working, while himself remaining deligen [Some translate yuktah as, 'in the right manner'. S. takes it in the sense of Yoga-yuktah, merged in yoga.-Tr.], he should make them do [Another reading is yojayet, meaning the same as josayet.-Tr.] all the duties.
practical_guidance: Sit quietly for five minutes. Ask: 'What is the most meaningful thing I can contribute?' Let the answer arise naturally, without forcing it.

sanskrit_text: प्रकृतेः क्रियमाणानि गुणैः कर्माणि सर्वशः। अहङ्कारविमूढात्मा कर्ताहमिति मन्यते॥
transliteration: prakrteh kriyamanani gunaih karmani sarvasah, ahankara-vimudhatma kartaham iti manyate
hindi_meaning: प्रकृति के गुणों द्वारा सभी कर्म किए जाते हैं, परन्तु अहंकार से मोहित मनुष्य सोचता है कि मैं कर्ता हूं।
english_meaning: The spirit soul bewildered by the influence of false ego thinks itself the doer of activities that are in actuality carried out by the three modes of material nature.
practical_guidance: Much of your suffering comes from the ego's insistence on being the sole author of your life. Today, when something goes well, practice saying 'I was an instrument' rather than 'I did this.' This subtle shift reduces both pride and anxiety over outcomes.

sanskrit_text: तत्त्ववित्तु महाबाहो गुणकर्मविभागयोः। गुणा गुणेषु वर्तन्त इति मत्वा न सज्जते
transliteration: tattvavittu mahābāho guṇakarmavibhāgayoḥ, guṇā guṇeṣu vartanta iti matvā na sajjate
hindi_meaning: हे महाबाहो! गुण-विभाग और कर्म-विभागको तत्त्वसे जाननेवाला महापुरुष 'सम्पूर्ण गुण ही गुणोंमें बरत रहे हैं' -- ऐसा मानकर उनमें आसक्त नहीं होता।
english_meaning: But, O mighty-armed one, the one who is a knower of the facts about the varieties of the gunas (alities) and actions does not become attached, thinking thus: 'The organs rest (act) on the objects of the organs.'
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: प्रकृतेर्गुणसम्मूढाः सज्जन्ते गुणकर्मसु। तानकृत्स्नविदो मन्दान्कृत्स्नविन्न विचालयेत्
transliteration: prakṛterguṇasammūḍhāḥ sajjante guṇakarmasu, tānakṛtsnavido mandānkṛtsnavinna vicālayet
hindi_meaning: प्रकृतिजन्य गुणोंसे अत्यन्त मोहित हुए अज्ञानी मनुष्य गुणों और कर्मोंमें आसक्त रहते हैं। उन पूर्णतया न समझनेवाले मन्दबुद्धि अज्ञानियोंको पूर्णतया जाननेवाला ज्ञानी मनुष्य विचलित न करे।
english_meaning: Those who are wholly deluded by the gunas of Nature become attached to the activities of the gunas. The knower of the All should not disturb those of dull intellect, who do not know the All.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि संन्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा। निराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा युध्यस्व विगतज्वरः
transliteration: mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi saṃnyasyādhyātmacetasā, nirāśīrnirmamo bhūtvā yudhyasva vigatajvaraḥ
hindi_meaning: तू विवेकवती बुद्धिके द्वारा सम्पूर्ण कर्तव्य-कर्मोंको मेरे अर्पण करके कामना, ममता और संताप-रहित होकर युद्धरूप कर्तव्य-कर्मको कर।
english_meaning: Devoid of the fever of the soul, engage in battle by dedicating all actions to Me, with (your) mind intent on the Self, and becoming free from expectations and egoism.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: ये मे मतमिदं नित्यमनुतिष्ठन्ति मानवाः। श्रद्धावन्तोऽनसूयन्तो मुच्यन्ते तेऽपि कर्मभिः
transliteration: ye me matamidaṃ nityamanutiṣṭhanti mānavāḥ, śraddhāvanto'nasūyanto mucyante te'pi karmabhiḥ
hindi_meaning: जो मनुष्य दोष-दृष्टिसे रहित होकर श्रद्धापूर्वक मेरे इस (पूर्वश्लोकमें वर्णित) मतका सदा अनुसरण करते हैं, वे भी कर्मोंके बन्धनसे मुक्त हो जाते हैं।
english_meaning: Those men who ever follow this teaching of Mine with faith and without cavil, they also become freed from actions.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: ये त्वेतदभ्यसूयन्तो नानुतिष्ठन्ति मे मतम्। सर्वज्ञानविमूढांस्तान्विद्धि नष्टानचेतसः
transliteration: ye tvetadabhyasūyanto nānutiṣṭhanti me matam, sarvajñānavimūḍhāṃstānviddhi naṣṭānacetasaḥ
hindi_meaning: परन्तु जो मनुष्य मेरे इस मतमें दोष-दृष्टि करते हुए इसका अनुष्ठान नहीं करते, उन सम्पूर्ण ज्ञानोंमें मोहित और अविवेकी मनुष्योंको नष्ट हुए ही समझो।
english_meaning: But those who, decaying [Finding fault where there is none.] this, do not follow My teaching, know them-who are deluded about all knoweldge [Knowledge concerning the alified and the un-alified Brahman.] and who are devoid of discrimination-to have gone to ruin.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: सदृशं चेष्टते स्वस्याः प्रकृतेर्ज्ञानवानपि। प्रकृतिं यान्ति भूतानि निग्रहः किं करिष्यति
transliteration: sadṛśaṃ ceṣṭate svasyāḥ prakṛterjñānavānapi, prakṛtiṃ yānti bhūtāni nigrahaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati
hindi_meaning: सम्पूर्ण प्राणी प्रकृतिको प्राप्त होते हैं। ज्ञानी महापुरुष भी अपनी प्रकृतिके अनुसार चेष्टा करता है। फिर इसमें किसीका हठ क्या करेगा?
english_meaning: Even a man of wisdom behaves according to his own nature. Being follow (their) nature. What can restraint do?
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: इन्द्रियस्येन्द्रियस्यार्थे रागद्वेषौ व्यवस्थितौ। तयोर्न वशमागच्छेत्तौ ह्यस्य परिपन्थिनौ
transliteration: indriyasyendriyasyārthe rāgadveṣau vyavasthitau, tayorna vaśamāgacchettau hyasya paripanthinau
hindi_meaning: इन्द्रिय-इन्द्रियके अर्थमें (प्रत्येक इन्द्रियके प्रत्येक विषयमें) मनुष्यके राग और द्वेष व्यवस्थासे (अनुकूलता और प्रतिकूलताको लेकर) स्थित हैं। मनुष्यको उन दोनोंके वशमें नहीं होना चाहिये; क्योंकि वे दोनों ही इसके (पारमार्थिक मार्गमें विघ्न डालनेवाले) शत्रु हैं।
english_meaning: Attraction and repulsion are ordained with regard to the objects of all the organs. One should not come under the sway of these two, because they are his adversaries.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्। स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः
transliteration: śreyānsvadharmo viguṇaḥ paradharmātsvanuṣṭhitāt, svadharme nidhanaṃ śreyaḥ paradharmo bhayāvahaḥ
hindi_meaning: अच्छी तरह आचरणमें लाये हुए दूसरेके धर्मसे गुणोंकी कमीवाला अपना धर्म श्रेष्ठ है। अपने धर्ममें तो मरना भी कल्याणकारक है और दूसरेका धर्म भयको देनेवाला है।
english_meaning: One's own duty [Customary or scripturally ordained observances of different castes and sects.-Tr.], though defective, is superior to another's duty well-performed. Death is better while engaged in one's own duty; another's duty is fraught with fear.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: अथ केन प्रयुक्तोऽयं पापं चरति पूरुषः। अनिच्छन्नपि वार्ष्णेय बलादिव नियोजितः
transliteration: atha kena prayukto'yaṃ pāpaṃ carati pūruṣaḥ, anicchannapi vārṣṇeya balādiva niyojitaḥ
hindi_meaning: अर्जुन बोले - हे वार्ष्णेय ! फिर यह मनुष्य न चाहता हुआ भी जबर्दस्ती लगाये हुएकी तरह किससे प्रेरित होकर पापका आचरण करता है?
english_meaning: Arjuna said Now then, O scion of the Vrsni dynasty (Krsna), impelled by what does this man commit sin even against his wish, being constrained by force, as it were?
practical_guidance: You cannot undo the past, only respond to it now. Forgive yourself as you would a dear friend who made a mistake. Then take one right action today.

sanskrit_text: काम एष क्रोध एष रजोगुणसमुद्भवः। महाशनो महापाप्मा विद्ध्येनमिह वैरिणम्॥
transliteration: kama esa krodha esa rajo-guna-samudbhavah, mahasano maha-papma viddhy enam iha vairinam
hindi_meaning: यह काम और क्रोध रजोगुण से उत्पन्न होते हैं — ये सर्वभक्षी और महापापी हैं। इन्हें तुम इस संसार में अपना शत्रु जानो।
english_meaning: It is lust only, Arjuna, which is born of contact with the material mode of passion and later transformed into wrath, and which is the all-devouring sinful enemy of this world.
practical_guidance: Identify the one desire or craving that is causing the most disruption in your life right now. Name it clearly — not with shame, but with honest awareness. Then ask: 'How is this desire serving as my enemy today?' Awareness is the first step to mastery.

sanskrit_text: धूमेनाव्रियते वह्निर्यथाऽऽदर्शो मलेन च। यथोल्बेनावृतो गर्भस्तथा तेनेदमावृतम्
transliteration: dhūmenāvriyate vahniryathā''darśo malena ca, yatholbenāvṛto garbhastathā tenedamāvṛtam
hindi_meaning: जैसे धुएँसे अग्नि और मैलसे दर्पण ढक जाता है तथा जैसे जेरसे गर्भ ढका रहता है, ऐसे ही उस कामके द्वारा यह ज्ञान ( विवेक) ढका हुआ है।
english_meaning: As fire is enveloped by smoke, as a mirror by dirt, and as a foetus remains enclosed in the womb, so in this shrouded by that.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: आवृतं ज्ञानमेतेन ज्ञानिनो नित्यवैरिणा। कामरूपेण कौन्तेय दुष्पूरेणानलेन च
transliteration: āvṛtaṃ jñānametena jñānino nityavairiṇā, kāmarūpeṇa kaunteya duṣpūreṇānalena ca
hindi_meaning: और हे कुन्तीनन्दन ! इस अग्निके समान कभी तृप्त न होनेवाले और विवेकियोंके नित्य वैरी इस कामके द्वारा मनुष्यका विवेक ढका हुआ है।
english_meaning: O son of Kunti, Knowledge is covered by this constant enemy of the wise in the form of desire, which is an insatiable fire.
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिरस्याधिष्ठानमुच्यते। एतैर्विमोहयत्येष ज्ञानमावृत्य देहिनम्
transliteration: indriyāṇi mano buddhirasyādhiṣṭhānamucyate, etairvimohayatyeṣa jñānamāvṛtya dehinam
hindi_meaning: इन्द्रियाँ, मन और बुद्धि इस कामके वास-स्थान कहे गये हैं। यह काम इन- (इन्द्रियाँ, मन और बुद्धि-) के द्वारा ज्ञानको ढककर देहाभिमानी मनुष्यको मोहित करता है।
english_meaning: The organs, mind, and the intellect are said to be its abode. This one diversely deludes the embodied being by veiling Knowledge with the help of these.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: तस्मात्त्वमिन्द्रियाण्यादौ नियम्य भरतर्षभ। पाप्मानं प्रजहि ह्येनं ज्ञानविज्ञाननाशनम्
transliteration: tasmāttvamindriyāṇyādau niyamya bharatarṣabha, pāpmānaṃ prajahi hyenaṃ jñānavijñānanāśanam
hindi_meaning: इसलिये हे भरतवंशियोंमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुन ! तू सबसे पहले इन्द्रियोंको वशमें करके इस ज्ञान और विज्ञानका नाश करनेवाले महान् पापी कामको अवश्य ही बलपूर्वक मार डाल।
english_meaning: Therefore, O scion of the Bharata dynasty, after first controlling the organs, renounce this one [A variant reading is, 'prajahi hi-enam, completely renounce this one'.-Tr.] which is sinful and a destroyer of learning and wisdom.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: इन्द्रियाणि पराण्याहुरिन्द्रियेभ्यः परं मनः। मनसस्तु परा बुद्धिर्यो बुद्धेः परतस्तु सः
transliteration: indriyāṇi parāṇyāhurindriyebhyaḥ paraṃ manaḥ, manasastu parā buddhiryo buddheḥ paratastu saḥ
hindi_meaning: -- 3.43।। इन्द्रियोंको (स्थूलशरीरसे) पर (श्रेष्ठ, सबल, प्रकाशक, व्यापक तथा सूक्ष्म) कहते हैं। इन्द्रियोंसे पर मन है, मनसे भी पर बुद्धि है औऱ जो बुद्धिसे भी पर है, वह (काम) है। इस तरह बुद्धिसे पर - (काम-) को जानकर अपने द्वारा अपने-आपको वशमें करके हे महाबाहो ! तू इस कामरूप दुर्जय शत्रुको मार डाल।
english_meaning: They say that the organs are superior (to the gross body); the mind is superior to the organs; but the intellect is superior to the mind. However, the one who is superior to the intellect is He.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: एवं बुद्धेः परं बुद्ध्वा संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना। जहि शत्रुं महाबाहो कामरूपं दुरासदम्
transliteration: evaṃ buddheḥ paraṃ buddhvā saṃstabhyātmānamātmanā, jahi śatruṃ mahābāho kāmarūpaṃ durāsadam
hindi_meaning: -- 3.43।। इन्द्रियोंको (स्थूलशरीरसे) पर (श्रेष्ठ, सबल, प्रकाशक, व्यापक तथा सूक्ष्म) कहते हैं। इन्द्रियोंसे पर मन है, मनसे भी पर बुद्धि है औऱ जो बुद्धिसे भी पर है वह (काम) है। इस तरह बुद्धिसे पर - (काम-) को जानकर अपने द्वारा अपने-आपको वशमें करके हे महाबाहो ! तू इस कामरूप दुर्जय शत्रुको मार डाल।
english_meaning: [The Ast, introdcues this verse with, 'Tatah kim, what follows from that?'-Tr.] Understanding the Self thus [Understanding৷৷.thus:that desires can be conered through the knowledge of the Self.] as superior to the intellect, and completely establishing (the Self) is spiritual absorption with the (help of) the mind, O mighty-armed one, vanish the enemy in the form of desire, which is difficult to subdue.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: इमं विवस्वते योगं प्रोक्तवानहमव्ययम्। विवस्वान् मनवे प्राह मनुरिक्ष्वाकवेऽब्रवीत्
transliteration: imaṃ vivasvate yogaṃ proktavānahamavyayam, vivasvān manave prāha manurikṣvākave'bravīt
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले - मैंने इस अविनाशी योगको सूर्यसे कहा था। फिर सूर्यने (अपने पुत्र) वैवस्वत मनुसे कहा और मनुने (अपने पुत्र) राजा इक्ष्वाकुसे कहा।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said I imparted this imperishable Yoga to Vivasvan, Vivasvan taught this to Manu, and Manu transmitted this to Iksavaku.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: एवं परम्पराप्राप्तमिमं राजर्षयो विदुः। स कालेनेह महता योगो नष्टः परन्तप
transliteration: evaṃ paramparāprāptamimaṃ rājarṣayo viduḥ, sa kāleneha mahatā yogo naṣṭaḥ parantapa
hindi_meaning: हे परंतप ! इस तरह परम्परासे प्राप्त इस कर्मयोग को राजर्षियोंने जाना। परन्तु बहुत समय बीत जानेके कारण वह योग इस मनुष्यलोकमें लुप्तप्राय हो गया।
english_meaning: The king-sages knew this (yoga) which was received thus in regular succession. That Yoga, O destroyer of foes, in now lost owing to a long lapse of time.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः। भक्तोऽसि मे सखा चेति रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम्
transliteration: sa evāyaṃ mayā te'dya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ, bhakto'si me sakhā ceti rahasyaṃ hyetaduttamam
hindi_meaning: तू मेरा भक्त और प्रिय सखा है, इसलिये वही यह पुरातन योग आज मैंने तुझसे कहा है; क्योंकि यह बड़ा उत्तम रहस्य है।
english_meaning: That ancient Yoga itself, which is this, has been taught to you by Me today, considering that you are My devotee and friend, For, this (Yoga) is a profound secret.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः। कथमेतद्विजानीयां त्वमादौ प्रोक्तवानिति
transliteration: aparaṃ bhavato janma paraṃ janma vivasvataḥ, kathametadvijānīyāṃ tvamādau proktavāniti
hindi_meaning: अर्जुन बोले - आपका जन्म तो अभीका है और सूर्यका जन्म बहुत पुराना है; अतः आपने ही सृष्टिके आदिमें सूर्यसे यह योग कहा था - यह बात मैं कैसे समझूँ?
english_meaning: Arjuna said Your birth was later, (whereas) the birth of Vivasvan was earlier. How am I to understand this that You instructed (him) in the beginning?
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: बहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन। तान्यहं वेद सर्वाणि न त्वं वेत्थ परन्तप
transliteration: bahūni me vyatītāni janmāni tava cārjuna, tānyahaṃ veda sarvāṇi na tvaṃ vettha parantapa
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले -- हे परन्तप अर्जुन ! मेरे और तेरे बहुत-से जन्म हो चुके हैं। उन सबको मैं जानता हूँ, पर तू नहीं जानता।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said O Arjuna, many lives of Mine have passed, and so have yours. I know them all, (but) you know not, O scorcher of enemies!
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: अजोऽपि सन्नव्ययात्मा भूतानामीश्वरोऽपि सन्। प्रकृतिं स्वामधिष्ठाय संभवाम्यात्ममायया
transliteration: ajo'pi sannavyayātmā bhūtānāmīśvaro'pi san, prakṛtiṃ svāmadhiṣṭhāya saṃbhavāmyātmamāyayā
hindi_meaning: मैं अजन्मा और अविनाशी-स्वरूप होते हुए भी तथा सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंका ईश्वर होते हुए भी अपनी प्रकृतिको अधीन करके अपनी योगमायासे प्रकट होता हूँ।
english_meaning: Though I am birthless, undecaying by nature, and the Lord of beings, (still) by subjugating My Prakriti, I take birth by means of My own Maya.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत। अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम्॥
transliteration: yada yada hi dharmasya glanir bhavati bharata, abhyutthanam adharmasya tadatmanam srjamy aham
hindi_meaning: हे भारत, जब-जब धर्म की हानि होती है और अधर्म की वृद्धि होती है, तब-तब मैं स्वयं को प्रकट करता हूं।
english_meaning: Whenever and wherever there is a decline in religious practice, O descendant of Bharata, and a predominant rise of irreligion — at that time I descend Myself.
practical_guidance: When you see injustice, corruption, or moral decline around you and feel helpless, take heart — the universe has a self-correcting force. Your own role is to be the representative of dharma in your small sphere. Do one righteous act today that you might otherwise leave undone.

sanskrit_text: परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम्। धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय सम्भवामि युगे युगे॥
transliteration: paritranaya sadhunam vinasaya ca duskrtam, dharma-samsthapanarthaya sambhavami yuge yuge
hindi_meaning: साधुओं की रक्षा के लिए, दुष्टों के विनाश के लिए और धर्म की स्थापना के लिए मैं युग-युग में प्रकट होता हूं।
english_meaning: To deliver the pious and to annihilate the miscreants, as well as to reestablish the principles of dharma, I Myself appear, millennium after millennium.
practical_guidance: Trust that goodness is ultimately protected by the universe. When you feel unprotected, unseen, or like righteousness is losing ground, this verse is your reminder: good is never truly abandoned. Keep doing good without calculating its reward.

sanskrit_text: जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः। त्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति मामेति सोऽर्जुन
transliteration: janma karma ca me divyamevaṃ yo vetti tattvataḥ, tyaktvā dehaṃ punarjanma naiti māmeti so'rjuna
hindi_meaning: हे अर्जुन ! मेरे जन्म और कर्म दिव्य हैं। इस प्रकार (मेरे जन्म और कर्मको) जो मनुष्य तत्त्वसे जान लेता अर्थात् दृढ़तापूर्वक मान लेता है, वह शरीरका त्याग करके पुनर्जन्मको प्राप्त नहीं होता, प्रत्युत मुझे प्राप्त होता है।
english_meaning: He who thus knows truly the divine birth and actions of Mine does not get r irth after casting off the body. He attains Me, O Arjuna.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया मामुपाश्रिताः। बहवो ज्ञानतपसा पूता मद्भावमागताः
transliteration: vītarāgabhayakrodhā manmayā māmupāśritāḥ, bahavo jñānatapasā pūtā madbhāvamāgatāḥ
hindi_meaning: राग, भय और क्रोधसे सर्वथा रहित, मेरेमें ही तल्लीन, मेरे ही आश्रित तथा ज्ञानरूप तपसे पवित्र हुए बहुत-से भक्त मेरे भाव- (स्वरूप-) को प्राप्त हो चुके हैं।
english_meaning: Many who were devoid of attachment, fear and anger, who were absorbed in Me, who had taken refuge in Me, and were purified by the austerity of Knowledge, have attained My state.
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम्। मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः
transliteration: ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃstathaiva bhajāmyaham, mama vartmānuvartante manuṣyāḥ pārtha sarvaśaḥ
hindi_meaning: हे पृथानन्दन ! जो भक्त जिस प्रकार मेरी शरण लेते हैं, मैं उन्हें उसी प्रकार आश्रय देता हूँ; क्योंकि सभी मनुष्य सब प्रकारसे मेरे मार्गका अनुकरण करते हैं।
english_meaning: According to the manner in which they approach Me, I favour them in that very manner. O son of Partha, human beings follow My path in every way.
practical_guidance: Sit quietly for five minutes. Ask: 'What is the most meaningful thing I can contribute?' Let the answer arise naturally, without forcing it.

sanskrit_text: काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः। क्षिप्रं हि मानुषे लोके सिद्धिर्भवति कर्मजा
transliteration: kāṅkṣantaḥ karmaṇāṃ siddhiṃ yajanta iha devatāḥ, kṣipraṃ hi mānuṣe loke siddhirbhavati karmajā
hindi_meaning: कर्मोंकी सिद्धि (फल) चाहनेवाले मनुष्य देवताओंकी उपासना किया करते हैं; क्योंकि इस मनुष्यलोकमें कर्मोंसे उत्पन्न होनेवाली सिद्धि जल्दी मिल जाती है।
english_meaning: Longing for the fruition of actions (of their rites and duties), they worship the gods here. For, in the human world, success from action comes ickly.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: चातुर्वर्ण्यं मया सृष्टं गुणकर्मविभागशः। तस्य कर्तारमपि मां विद्ध्यकर्तारमव्ययम्
transliteration: cāturvarṇyaṃ mayā sṛṣṭaṃ guṇakarmavibhāgaśaḥ, tasya kartāramapi māṃ viddhyakartāramavyayam
hindi_meaning: -- 4.14।। मेरे द्वारा गुणों और कर्मोंके विभागपूर्वक चारों वर्णोंकी रचना की गयी है। उस-(सृष्टि-रचना आदि-) का कर्ता होनेपर भी मुझ अव्यय रमेश्वरको तू अकर्ता जान। कारण कि कर्मोंके फलमें मेरी स्पृहा नहीं है, इसलिये मुझे कर्म लिप्त नहीं करते। इस प्रकार जो मुझे तत्त्वसे जान लेता है, वह भी कर्मोंसे नहीं बँधता।
english_meaning: The four castes have been created by Me through a classification of the gunas and duties. Even though I am the agent of that (act of classification), still know Me to be a non-agent and changeless.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: न मां कर्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा। इति मां योऽभिजानाति कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते
transliteration: na māṃ karmāṇi limpanti na me karmaphale spṛhā, iti māṃ yo'bhijānāti karmabhirna sa badhyate
hindi_meaning: -- 4.14।। मेरे द्वारा गुणों और कर्मोंके विभागपूर्वक चारों वर्णोंकी रचना की गयी है। उस-(सृष्टि-रचना आदि-) का कर्ता होनेपर भी मुझ अव्यय परमेश्वरको तू अकर्ता जान। कारण कि कर्मोंके फलमें मेरी स्पृहा नहीं है, इसलिये मुझे कर्म लिप्त नहीं करते। इस प्रकार जो मुझे तत्त्वसे जान लेता है, वह भी कर्मोंसे नहीं बँधता।
english_meaning: Actions do not taint Me; for Me there is no hankering for the results of actions. One who knows Me thus, does not become bound by actions.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः। कुरु कर्मैव तस्मात्त्वं पूर्वैः पूर्वतरं कृतम्
transliteration: evaṃ jñātvā kṛtaṃ karma pūrvairapi mumukṣubhiḥ, kuru karmaiva tasmāttvaṃ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraṃ kṛtam
hindi_meaning: पूर्वकालके मुमुक्षुओंने भी इस प्रकार जानकर कर्म किये हैं, इसलिये तू भी पूर्वजोंके द्वारा सदासे किये जानेवाले कर्मोंको ही (उन्हींकी तरह) कर।
english_meaning: Having known thus, duties were performed even by the ancient seekers of Liberation. Thererfore you undertake action itself as was performed earlier by the ancient ones.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: किं कर्म किमकर्मेति कवयोऽप्यत्र मोहिताः। तत्ते कर्म प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात्
transliteration: kiṃ karma kimakarmeti kavayo'pyatra mohitāḥ, tatte karma pravakṣyāmi yajjñātvā mokṣyase'śubhāt
hindi_meaning: कर्म क्या है और अकर्म क्या है -- इस प्रकार इस विषयमें विद्वान् भी मोहित हो जाते हैं। अतः वह कर्म-तत्त्व मैं तुम्हें भलीभाँति कहूँगा, जिसको जानकर तू अशुभ- (संसार-बन्धन-) से मुक्त हो जायगा।
english_meaning: Even the intelligent are confounded as to what is action and what is inaction. I shall tell you of that action by knowing which you will become free from evil.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: कर्मणो ह्यपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः। अकर्मणश्च बोद्धव्यं गहना कर्मणो गतिः
transliteration: karmaṇo hyapi boddhavyaṃ boddhavyaṃ ca vikarmaṇaḥ, akarmaṇaśca boddhavyaṃ gahanā karmaṇo gatiḥ
hindi_meaning: कर्मका तत्त्व भी जानना चाहिये और अकर्मका तत्त्व भी जानना चाहिये तथा विकर्मका तत्त्व भी जानना चाहिये; क्योंकि कर्मकी गति गहन है।
english_meaning: For there is something to be known even about action, and something to be known about prohibited action; and something has to be known about inaction. The true nature of action is inscrutable.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः। स बुद्धिमान् मनुष्येषु स युक्तः कृत्स्नकर्मकृत्
transliteration: karmaṇyakarma yaḥ paśyedakarmaṇi ca karma yaḥ, sa buddhimān manuṣyeṣu sa yuktaḥ kṛtsnakarmakṛt
hindi_meaning: जो मनुष्य कर्ममें अकर्म देखता है और जो अकर्ममें कर्म देखता है, वह मनुष्योंमें बुद्धिमान् है, योगी है और सम्पूर्ण कर्मोंको करनेवाला है।
english_meaning: He who finds inaction in action, and action in inaction, he is the wise one [Possessed of the knowledge of Brahman] among men; he is engaged in yoga and is a performer of all actions!
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: यस्य सर्वे समारम्भाः कामसङ्कल्पवर्जिताः। ज्ञानाग्निदग्धकर्माणं तमाहुः पण्डितं बुधाः
transliteration: yasya sarve samārambhāḥ kāmasaṅkalpavarjitāḥ, jñānāgnidagdhakarmāṇaṃ tamāhuḥ paṇḍitaṃ budhāḥ
hindi_meaning: जिसके सम्पूर्ण कर्मोंके आरम्भ संकल्प और कामनासे रहित हैं तथा जिसके सम्पूर्ण कर्म ज्ञानरूपी अग्निसे जल गये हैं, उसको ज्ञानिजन भी पण्डित (बुद्धिमान्) कहते हैं।
english_meaning: The wise call him learned whose actions are all devoid of desires and their thougts, [Kama-sankalpa is variously translated as 'desires and purposes', 'plans and desires for results', 'hankering for desires', etc. But Sankarcarya shows sankalpa as the cause of kama. -Tr.] and whose actions have been burnt away by the fire of wisdom.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: त्यक्त्वा कर्मफलासङ्गं नित्यतृप्तो निराश्रयः। कर्मण्यभिप्रवृत्तोऽपि नैव किञ्चित्करोति सः
transliteration: tyaktvā karmaphalāsaṅgaṃ nityatṛpto nirāśrayaḥ, karmaṇyabhipravṛtto'pi naiva kiñcitkaroti saḥ
hindi_meaning: जो कर्म और फलकी आसक्तिका त्याग करके आश्रयसे रहित और सदा तृप्त है, वह कर्मोंमें अच्छी तरह लगा हुआ भी वास्तवमें कुछ भी नहीं करता।
english_meaning: Having given up attachment to the results of action, he who is ever-contented, dependent on nothing, he really does not do anything even though engaged in action.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: निराशीर्यतचित्तात्मा त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः। शारीरं केवलं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम्
transliteration: nirāśīryatacittātmā tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ, śārīraṃ kevalaṃ karma kurvannāpnoti kilbiṣam
hindi_meaning: जिसका शरीर और अन्तःकरण अच्छी तरहसे वशमें किया हुआ है, जिसने सब प्रकारके संग्रहका परित्याग कर दिया है, ऐसा आशारहित कर्मयोगी केवल शरीर-सम्बन्धी कर्म करता हुआ भी पापको प्राप्त नहीं होता।
english_meaning: One who is without solicitation, who has the mind and organs under control, (and) is totally without possessions, he incurs no sin by performing actions merely for the (maintenance of the) body.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: यदृच्छालाभसन्तुष्टो द्वन्द्वातीतो विमत्सरः। समः सिद्धावसिद्धौ च कृत्वापि न निबध्यते
transliteration: yadṛcchālābhasantuṣṭo dvandvātīto vimatsaraḥ, samaḥ siddhāvasiddhau ca kṛtvāpi na nibadhyate
hindi_meaning: जो (कर्मयोगी) फल की इच्छा के बिना, अपने-आप जो कुछ मिल जाय, उसमें सन्तुष्ट रहता है और जो ईर्ष्यासे रहित, द्वन्द्वोंसे अतीत तथा सिद्धि और असिद्धिमें सम है, वह कर्म करते हुए भी उससे नहीं बँधता।
english_meaning: Remaining satisfied with what comes unasked for, having transcended the dualities, being free from spite, and eipoised under success and failure, he is not bound even by performing actions.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: गतसङ्गस्य मुक्तस्य ज्ञानावस्थितचेतसः। यज्ञायाचरतः कर्म समग्रं प्रविलीयते
transliteration: gatasaṅgasya muktasya jñānāvasthitacetasaḥ, yajñāyācarataḥ karma samagraṃ pravilīyate
hindi_meaning: जिसकी आसक्ति सर्वथा मिट गयी है, जो मुक्त हो गया है, जिसकी बुद्धि स्वरूपके ज्ञानमें स्थित है, ऐसे केवल यज्ञके लिये कर्म करनेवाले मनुष्यके सम्पूर्ण कर्म विलीन हो जाते हैं।
english_meaning: Of the liberated person who has got rid of attachment, whose mind is fixed in Knowledge, actions undertaken for a sacrifice get totally destroyed.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: ब्रह्मार्पणं ब्रह्महविर्ब्रह्माग्नौ ब्रह्मणा हुतम्। ब्रह्मैव तेन गन्तव्यं ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधिना
transliteration: brahmārpaṇaṃ brahmahavirbrahmāgnau brahmaṇā hutam, brahmaiva tena gantavyaṃ brahmakarmasamādhinā
hindi_meaning: जिस यज्ञमें अर्पण भी ब्रह्म है, हवी भी ब्रह्म है और ब्रह्मरूप कर्ताके द्वारा ब्रह्मरूप अग्निमें आहुति देनारूप क्रिया भी ब्रह्म है, (ऐसे यज्ञको करनेवाले) जिस मनुष्यकी ब्रह्ममें ही कर्म-समाधि हो गयी है, उसके द्वारा प्राप्त करनेयोग्य फल भी ब्रह्म ही है।
english_meaning: The ladle is Brahman [Some translate as 'Brahman is the ladle৷৷.,' etc.-Tr.], the oblations is Brahman, the offering is poured by Brahman in the fire of Brahman. Brahman alone is to be reached by him who has concentration on Brahman as the objective [As an object to be known and attained. (Some translate brahma-karma-samadhina as, 'by him who sees Brahman in action'.)
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: दैवमेवापरे यज्ञं योगिनः पर्युपासते। ब्रह्माग्नावपरे यज्ञं यज्ञेनैवोपजुह्वति
transliteration: daivamevāpare yajñaṃ yoginaḥ paryupāsate, brahmāgnāvapare yajñaṃ yajñenaivopajuhvati
hindi_meaning: अन्य योगीलोग भगवदर्पणरूप यज्ञका ही अनुष्ठान करते हैं और दूसरे योगीलोग ब्रह्मरूप अग्निमें विचाररूप यज्ञके द्वारा ही जीवात्मारूप यज्ञका हवन करते हैं।
english_meaning: Other yogis undertake sacrifice to gods alone, Others offer the Self, as a sacrifice by the Self itself, in the fire of Brahman.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: श्रोत्रादीनीन्द्रियाण्यन्ये संयमाग्निषु जुह्वति। शब्दादीन्विषयानन्य इन्द्रियाग्निषु जुह्वति
transliteration: śrotrādīnīndriyāṇyanye saṃyamāgniṣu juhvati, śabdādīnviṣayānanya indriyāgniṣu juhvati
hindi_meaning: अन्य योगीलोग श्रोत्रादि समस्त इन्द्रियोंका संयमरूप अग्नियोंमें हवन किया करते हैं और दूसरे योगीलोग शब्दादि विषयोंका इन्द्रियरूप अग्नियोंमें हवन किया करते हैं।
english_meaning: Others offer the organs, viz ear etc., in the fires of self-control. Others offer the objects, viz sound etc., in the fires of the organs.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: सर्वाणीन्द्रियकर्माणि प्राणकर्माणि चापरे। आत्मसंयमयोगाग्नौ जुह्वति ज्ञानदीपिते
transliteration: sarvāṇīndriyakarmāṇi prāṇakarmāṇi cāpare, ātmasaṃyamayogāgnau juhvati jñānadīpite
hindi_meaning: अन्य योगीलोग सम्पूर्ण इन्द्रियोंकी क्रियाओंको और प्राणोंकी क्रियाओंको ज्ञानसे प्रकाशित आत्मसंयमयोगरूप अग्निमें हवन किया करते हैं।
english_meaning: Others offer all the activities of the organs and the activities of the vital force into the fire of the yoga of sel-control which has been lighted by Knowledge.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: द्रव्ययज्ञास्तपोयज्ञा योगयज्ञास्तथापरे। स्वाध्यायज्ञानयज्ञाश्च यतयः संशितव्रताः
transliteration: dravyayajñāstapoyajñā yogayajñāstathāpare, svādhyāyajñānayajñāśca yatayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ
hindi_meaning: दूसरे कितने ही तीक्ष्ण व्रत करनेवाले प्रयत्नशील साधक द्रव्य-सम्बन्धी यज्ञ करनेवाले हैं, और कितने ही तपोयज्ञ करनेवाले हैं, और दूसरे कितने ही योगयज्ञ करनेवाले हैं, तथा कितने ही स्वाध्यायरूप ज्ञानयज्ञ करनेवाले हैं।
english_meaning: Similarly, others are performers of sacrifices through wealth, through austerity, through yoga, and through study and knowledge; others are ascetics with severe vows.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: अपाने जुह्वति प्राण प्राणेऽपानं तथाऽपरे। प्राणापानगती रुद्ध्वा प्राणायामपरायणाः
transliteration: apāne juhvati prāṇa prāṇe'pānaṃ tathā'pare, prāṇāpānagatī ruddhvā prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇāḥ
hindi_meaning: -- 4.30।। दूसरे कितने ही प्राणायामके परायण हुए योगीलोग अपानमें प्राणका पूरक करके, प्राण और अपानकी गति रोककर फिर प्राणमें अपानका हवन करते हैं; तथा अन्य कितने ही नियमित आहार करनेवाले प्राणोंका प्राणोंमें हवन किया करते हैं। ये सभी साधक यज्ञोंद्वारा पापोंका नाश करनेवाले और यज्ञोंको जाननेवाले हैं।
english_meaning: Constantly practising control of the vital forces by stopping the movements of the outgoing and the incoming breaths, some offer as a sacrifice the outgoing breath in the incoming breath; while still others, the incoming breath in the outgoing breath.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: अपरे नियताहाराः प्राणान्प्राणेषु जुह्वति। सर्वेऽप्येते यज्ञविदो यज्ञक्षपितकल्मषाः
transliteration: apare niyatāhārāḥ prāṇānprāṇeṣu juhvati, sarve'pyete yajñavido yajñakṣapitakalmaṣāḥ
hindi_meaning: -- 4.30।। दूसरे कितने ही प्राणायामके परायण हुए योगीलोग अपानमें प्राणका पूरक करके, प्राण और अपानकी गति रोककर फिर प्राणमें अपानका हवन करते हैं; तथा अन्य कितने ही नियमित आहार करनेवाले प्राणोंका प्राणोंमें हवन किया करते हैं। ये सभी साधक यज्ञोंद्वारा पापोंका नाश करनेवाले और यज्ञोंको जाननेवाले हैं।
english_meaning: Others, having their food regulated, offer the vital forces in the vital forces. All of them are knowers of the sacrifice and have their sins destroyed by sacrifice.
practical_guidance: You cannot undo the past, only respond to it now. Forgive yourself as you would a dear friend who made a mistake. Then take one right action today.

sanskrit_text: यज्ञशिष्टामृतभुजो यान्ति ब्रह्म सनातनम्। नायं लोकोऽस्त्ययज्ञस्य कुतो़ऽन्यः कुरुसत्तम
transliteration: yajñaśiṣṭāmṛtabhujo yānti brahma sanātanam, nāyaṃ loko'styayajñasya kuto़'nyaḥ kurusattama
hindi_meaning: हे कुरुवंशियोंमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुन ! यज्ञसे बचे हुए अमृतका अनुभव करनेवाले सनातन परब्रह्म परमात्माको प्राप्त होते हैं। यज्ञ न करनेवाले मनुष्यके लिये यह मनुष्यलोक भी सुखदायक नहीं है, फिर परलोक कैसे सुखदायक होगा?
english_meaning: Those who partake of the nectar left over after a sacrifice, reach the eternal Brahman. This world ceases to exist for one who does not perform sacrifices. What to speak of the other (world), O best among the Kurus (Arjuna)!
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे। कर्मजान्विद्धि तान्सर्वानेवं ज्ञात्वा विमोक्ष्यसे
transliteration: evaṃ bahuvidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe, karmajānviddhi tānsarvānevaṃ jñātvā vimokṣyase
hindi_meaning: इस प्रकार और भी बहुत तरहके यज्ञ वेदकी वाणीमें विस्तारसे कहे गये हैं। उन सब यज्ञोंको तू कर्मजन्य जान। इस प्रकार जानकर यज्ञ करनेसे तू (कर्मबन्धनसे) मुक्त हो जायगा।
english_meaning: Thus, various kinds of sacrifices lie spread at the mouth of the Vedas. Know them all to be born of action. Knowing thus, you will become liberated.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: श्रेयान्द्रव्यमयाद्यज्ञाज्ज्ञानयज्ञः परन्तप। सर्वं कर्माखिलं पार्थ ज्ञाने परिसमाप्यते
transliteration: śreyāndravyamayādyajñājjñānayajñaḥ parantapa, sarvaṃ karmākhilaṃ pārtha jñāne parisamāpyate
hindi_meaning: हे परन्तप अर्जुन ! द्रव्यमय यज्ञसे ज्ञानयज्ञ श्रेष्ठ है। सम्पूर्ण कर्म और पदार्थ ज्ञान-(तत्त्वज्ञान-) में समाप्त हो जाते हैं।
english_meaning: O destroyer of enemies, Knowledge considered as a sacrifice is greater than sacrifices reiring materials. O son of Prtha, all actions in their totality culminate in Knowledge.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: तद्विद्धि प्रणिपातेन परिप्रश्नेन सेवया। उपदेक्ष्यन्ति ते ज्ञानं ज्ञानिनस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः
transliteration: tadviddhi praṇipātena paripraśnena sevayā, upadekṣyanti te jñānaṃ jñāninastattvadarśinaḥ
hindi_meaning: उस- (तत्त्वज्ञान-) को (तत्त्वदर्शी ज्ञानी महापुरुषोंके पास जाकर) समझ। उनको साष्टाङ्ग दण्डवत् प्रणाम करनेसे, उनकी सेवा करनेसे और सरलतापूर्वक प्रश्न करनेसे वे तत्त्वदर्शी ज्ञानी महापुरुष तुझे उस तत्त्वज्ञानका उपदेश देंगे।
english_meaning: Know that through prostration, iniry and service. The wise ones who have realized the Truth will impart the Knowledge to you.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: यज्ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्मोहमेवं यास्यसि पाण्डव। येन भूतान्यशेषेण द्रक्ष्यस्यात्मन्यथो मयि
transliteration: yajjñātvā na punarmohamevaṃ yāsyasi pāṇḍava, yena bhūtānyaśeṣeṇa drakṣyasyātmanyatho mayi
hindi_meaning: जिस- (तत्त्वज्ञान-) का अनुभव करनेके बाद तू फिर इस प्रकार मोहको नहीं प्राप्त होगा, और हे अर्जुन ! जिस- (तत्त्वज्ञान-) से तू सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंको निःशेषभावसे पहले अपनेमें और उसके बाद मुझ सच्चिदानन्दघन परमात्मामें देखेगा।
english_meaning: Knowing which, O Pandava (Arjuna), you will not come under delusion again in this way, and through which you will see all beings without exception in the Self and also in Me.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: अपि चेदसि पापेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः पापकृत्तमः। सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं सन्तरिष्यसि
transliteration: api cedasi pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ, sarvaṃ jñānaplavenaiva vṛjinaṃ santariṣyasi
hindi_meaning: अगर तू सब पापियोंसे भी अधिक पापी है, तो भी तू ज्ञानरूपी नौकाके द्वारा निःसन्देह सम्पूर्ण पापसमुद्रसे अच्छी तरह तर जायगा।
english_meaning: Even if you be the worst sinner among all sinners, still you will cross over all the wickedness with the raft of Knowledge alone.
practical_guidance: You cannot undo the past, only respond to it now. Forgive yourself as you would a dear friend who made a mistake. Then take one right action today.

sanskrit_text: यथैधांसि समिद्धोऽग्निर्भस्मसात्कुरुतेऽर्जुन। ज्ञानाग्निः सर्वकर्माणि भस्मसात्कुरुते तथा
transliteration: yathaidhāṃsi samiddho'gnirbhasmasātkurute'rjuna, jñānāgniḥ sarvakarmāṇi bhasmasātkurute tathā
hindi_meaning: हे अर्जुन ! जैसे प्रज्वलित अग्नि ईंधनोंको सर्वथा भस्म कर देती है, ऐसे ही ज्ञानरूपी अग्नि सम्पूर्ण कर्मोंको सर्वथा भस्म कर देती है।
english_meaning: O Arjuna, as a blazing fire reduces pieces of wood to ashes, similarly the fire of Knowledge reduces all actions to ashes.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते। तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति॥
transliteration: na hi jnanena sadrsam pavitram iha vidyate, tat svayam yoga-samsiddhah kalenatmani vindati
hindi_meaning: इस संसार में ज्ञान के समान कोई पवित्र करने वाली वस्तु नहीं है। योग में सिद्ध पुरुष इसे अपने आप समय के साथ अपने भीतर पा लेता है।
english_meaning: In this world, there is nothing so sublime and pure as transcendental knowledge. Such knowledge is the mature fruit of all mysticism. And one who has become accomplished in the practice of devotional service enjoys this knowledge within himself in due course of time.
practical_guidance: Commit to learning something of genuine depth today — not just consuming content, but reflecting on a truth that challenges how you see yourself and the world. Even 15 minutes of deep study or quiet reflection cultivates the wisdom that purifies your entire life.

sanskrit_text: श्रद्धावाँल्लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः। ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शान्तिमचिरेणाधिगच्छति
transliteration: śraddhāvām̐llabhate jñānaṃ tatparaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ, jñānaṃ labdhvā parāṃ śāntimacireṇādhigacchati
hindi_meaning: जो जितेन्द्रिय तथा साधन-परायण है, ऐसा श्रद्धावान् मनुष्य ज्ञानको प्राप्त होता है और ज्ञानको प्राप्त होकर वह तत्काल परम शान्तिको प्राप्त हो जाता है।
english_meaning: The man who has faith, is diligent and has control over the organs, attains Knowledge. Achieving Knowledge, one soon attains supreme Peace.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: अज्ञश्चाश्रद्दधानश्च संशयात्मा विनश्यति। नायं लोकोऽस्ति न परो न सुखं संशयात्मनः
transliteration: ajñaścāśraddadhānaśca saṃśayātmā vinaśyati, nāyaṃ loko'sti na paro na sukhaṃ saṃśayātmanaḥ
hindi_meaning: विवेकहीन और श्रद्धारहित संशयात्मा मनुष्यका पतन हो जाता है। ऐसे संशयात्मा मनुष्यके लिये न यह लोक है न परलोक है और न सुख ही है।
english_meaning: One who is ignorant and faithless, and has a doubting mind perishes. Neither this world nor the next nor happiness exists for one who has a doubting mind.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: योगसंन्यस्तकर्माणं ज्ञानसंछिन्नसंशयम्। आत्मवन्तं न कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय
transliteration: yogasaṃnyastakarmāṇaṃ jñānasaṃchinnasaṃśayam, ātmavantaṃ na karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya
hindi_meaning: हे धनञ्जय ! योग- (समता-) के द्वारा जिसका सम्पूर्ण कर्मोंसे सम्बन्ध-विच्छेद हो गया है और ज्ञानके द्वारा जिसके सम्पूर्ण संशयोंका नाश हो गया है, ऐसे स्वरूप-परायण मनुष्यको कर्म नहीं बाँधते।
english_meaning: O Dhananjaya (Arjuna), actions do not bind one who has renounced actions through yoga, whose doubt has been fully dispelled by Knowledge, and who is not inadvertent.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: तस्मादज्ञानसंभूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनाऽऽत्मनः। छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगमातिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भारत
transliteration: tasmādajñānasaṃbhūtaṃ hṛtsthaṃ jñānāsinā''tmanaḥ, chittvainaṃ saṃśayaṃ yogamātiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhārata
hindi_meaning: इसलिये हे भरतवंशी अर्जुन ! हृदयमें स्थित इस अज्ञानसे उत्पन्न अपने संशयका ज्ञानरूप तलवारसे छेदन करके योग -(समता-) में स्थित हो जा, (और युद्धके लिये) खड़ा हो जा।
english_meaning: Therefore, O scion of the Bharata dyasty, take recourse to yoga and rise up, cutting asunder with the sword of Knowledge this doubt of your own in the heart, arising from ignorance.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि। यच्छ्रेय एतयोरेकं तन्मे ब्रूहि सुनिश्चितम्
transliteration: saṃnyāsaṃ karmaṇāṃ kṛṣṇa punaryogaṃ ca śaṃsasi, yacchreya etayorekaṃ tanme brūhi suniścitam
hindi_meaning: अर्जुन बोले -- हे कृष्ण ! आप कर्मोंका स्वरूपसे त्याग करनेकी और फिर कर्मयोगकी प्रशंसा करते हैं। अतः इन दोनों साधनोंमें जो एक निश्चितरूपसे कल्याणकारक हो, उसको मेरे लिये कहिये।
english_meaning: Arjuna said O Krsna, You praise renunciation of actions, and again, (Karma-) yoga. Tell me for certain that one which is better between these two.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: संन्यासः कर्मयोगश्च निःश्रेयसकरावुभौ। तयोस्तु कर्मसंन्यासात्कर्मयोगो विशिष्यते
transliteration: saṃnyāsaḥ karmayogaśca niḥśreyasakarāvubhau, tayostu karmasaṃnyāsātkarmayogo viśiṣyate
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले -- संन्यास (सांख्ययोग) और कर्मयोग दोनों ही कल्याण करनेवाले हैं। परन्तु उन दोनोंमें भी कर्मसंन्यास- (सांख्ययोग-) से कर्मयोग श्रेष्ठ है।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said Both renunciation of actions and Karma-yoga lead to Liberation. Between the two, Karma-yoga, however, excels over renunciation of actions.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति। निर्द्वन्द्वो हि महाबाहो सुखं बन्धात्प्रमुच्यते
transliteration: jñeyaḥ sa nityasaṃnyāsī yo na dveṣṭi na kāṅkṣati, nirdvandvo hi mahābāho sukhaṃ bandhātpramucyate
hindi_meaning: हे महाबाहो ! जो मनुष्य न किसीसे द्वेष करता है और न किसीकी आकाङ्क्षा करता है; वह (कर्मयोगी) सदा संन्यासी समझनेयोग्य है; क्योंकि द्वन्द्वोंसे रहित मनुष्य सुखपूर्वक संसार-बन्धनसे मुक्त हो जाता है।
english_meaning: He who does not hate and does not crave should be known as a man of constant renunciation.
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: सांख्ययोगौ पृथग्बालाः प्रवदन्ति न पण्डिताः। एकमप्यास्थितः सम्यगुभयोर्विन्दते फलम्
transliteration: sāṃkhyayogau pṛthagbālāḥ pravadanti na paṇḍitāḥ, ekamapyāsthitaḥ samyagubhayorvindate phalam
hindi_meaning: बेसमझ लोग सांख्ययोग और कर्मयोगको अलग-अलग फलवाले कहते हैं, न कि पण्डितजन; क्योंकि इन दोनोंमेंसे एक साधनमें भी अच्छी तरहसे स्थित मनुष्य दोनोंके फलरूप परमात्माको प्राप्त कर लेता है।
english_meaning: The fools, not the learned ones, speak of Sankhya (the path of Knowledge) and (Karma-) yoga as different. Any one who properly resorts to even one (of them) gets the result of both.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: यत्सांख्यैः प्राप्यते स्थानं तद्योगैरपि गम्यते। एकं सांख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स पश्यति
transliteration: yatsāṃkhyaiḥ prāpyate sthānaṃ tadyogairapi gamyate, ekaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati
