hindi_meaning: सांख्ययोगियोंके द्वारा जो तत्त्व प्राप्त किया जाता है, कर्मयोगियोंके द्वारा भी वही प्राप्त किया जाता है। अतः जो मनुष्य सांख्ययोग और कर्मयोगको (फलरूपमें) एक देखता है, वही ठीक देखता है।
english_meaning: The State [Sthana (State) is used in the derivative sense of 'the place in which one remains established, and from which one does not become relegated'.] that is reached by the Sankhyas, that is reached by the yogis as well. He sees who sees Sankhya and yoga as one.
practical_guidance: Cravings are temporary visitors — they will pass. When an urge arises, pause for three slow breaths before responding. The gap is where freedom lives.

sanskrit_text: संन्यासस्तु महाबाहो दुःखमाप्तुमयोगतः। योगयुक्तो मुनिर्ब्रह्म नचिरेणाधिगच्छति
transliteration: saṃnyāsastu mahābāho duḥkhamāptumayogataḥ, yogayukto munirbrahma nacireṇādhigacchati
hindi_meaning: परन्तु हे महाबाहो ! कर्मयोगके बिना संन्यास सिद्ध होना कठिन है। मननशील कर्मयोगी शीघ्र ही ब्रह्मको प्राप्त हो जाता है।
english_meaning: But, O mighty-armed one, renunciation is hard to attain without (Karma-) yoga. The meditative man eipped with yoga attains Brahman without delay.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: योगयुक्तो विशुद्धात्मा विजितात्मा जितेन्द्रियः। सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा कुर्वन्नपि न लिप्यते
transliteration: yogayukto viśuddhātmā vijitātmā jitendriyaḥ, sarvabhūtātmabhūtātmā kurvannapi na lipyate
hindi_meaning: जिसकी इन्द्रियाँ अपने वशमें हैं, जिसका अन्तःकरण निर्मल है, जिसका शरीर अपने वशमें है और सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंकी आत्मा ही जिसकी आत्मा है, ऐसा कर्मयोगी कर्म करते हुए भी लिप्त नहीं होता।
english_meaning: Endowed with yoga, [i.e. devoted to the performance of the nitya and naimittika duties.] pure in mind, controlled in body, a coneror of the organs, the Self of the selves of all beings-he does not become tainted even while performing actions. [The construction of the sentence is this: When this person resorts to nitya and naimittika rites and duties as a means to the achievement of fully Illumination, and thus becomes fully enlightened, then, even when he acts through the apparent functions of the mind, organs, etc., he does not become afflected.]
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: नैव किंचित्करोमीति युक्तो मन्येत तत्त्ववित्। पश्यञ्शृण्वन्स्पृशञ्जिघ्रन्नश्नन्गच्छन्स्वपञ्श्वसन्
transliteration: naiva kiṃcitkaromīti yukto manyeta tattvavit, paśyañśṛṇvanspṛśañjighrannaśnangacchansvapañśvasan
hindi_meaning: -- 5.9।। तत्त्वको जाननेवाला सांख्ययोगी देखता, सुनता, छूता, सूँघता, खाता, चलता, ग्रहण करता, बोलता, मल-मूत्र का त्याग करता, सोता, श्वास लेता तथा आँखें खोलता और मूँदता भी सम्पूर्ण इन्द्रियाँ इन्द्रियोंके विषयोंमें बरत रही हैं' -- ऐसा समझकर 'मैं (स्वयं) कुछ भी नहीं करता हूँ' -- ऐसा माने।
english_meaning: -5.9 Remaining absorbed in the Self, the knower of Reality should think, 'I certainly do not do anything', even while seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, moving, sleeping, breathing, speaking, releasing, holding, opening and closing the eyes-remembering that the organs function in relation to the objects of the organs.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: प्रलपन्विसृजन्गृह्णन्नुन्मिषन्निमिषन्नपि। इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेषु वर्तन्त इति धारयन्
transliteration: pralapanvisṛjangṛhṇannunmiṣannimiṣannapi, indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣu vartanta iti dhārayan
hindi_meaning: -- 5.9।। तत्त्वको जाननेवाला सांख्ययोगी देखता, सुनता, छूता, सूँघता, खाता, चलता, ग्रहण करता, बोलता, मल-मूत्र का त्याग करता, सोता हुआ, श्वास लेता तथा आँखें खोलता और मूँदता हुआ भी 'सम्पूर्ण इन्द्रियाँ इन्द्रियोंके विषयोंमें बरत रही हैं' -- ऐसा समझकर 'मैं (स्वयं) कुछ भी नहीं करता हूँ' -- ऐसा माने।
english_meaning: -5.9 Remaining absorbed in the Self, the knower of Reality should think, 'I certainly do not do anything', even while seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, moving, sleeping, breathing, speaking, releasing, holding, opening and closing the eyes-remembering that the organs function in relation to the objects of the organs.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः। लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा॥
transliteration: brahmany adhaaya karmani sangam tyaktva karoti yah, lipyate na sa papena padma-patram ivambhasa
hindi_meaning: जो मनुष्य सभी कर्म ब्रह्म को समर्पित करके और आसक्ति को त्यागकर कर्म करता है, वह पाप से उसी प्रकार लिप्त नहीं होता जैसे कमल का पत्ता जल से।
english_meaning: One who performs his duty without attachment, surrendering the results unto the Supreme Lord, is unaffected by sinful action, as the lotus leaf is untouched by water.
practical_guidance: When guilt from past actions weighs on you, practice this: before you begin any action today, mentally offer it to something larger than yourself — God, the universe, or the greater good. Then act fully without clinging to outcome or regret. Like a lotus leaf, you can remain untouched by the muddy waters of consequence.

sanskrit_text: कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि। योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वाऽऽत्मशुद्धये
transliteration: kāyena manasā buddhyā kevalairindriyairapi, yoginaḥ karma kurvanti saṅgaṃ tyaktvā''tmaśuddhaye
hindi_meaning: कर्मयोगी आसक्तिका त्याग करके केवल (ममतारहित) इन्द्रियाँ-शरीर-मन-बुद्धि के द्वारा केवल अन्तःकरणकी शुद्धिके लिये ही कर्म करते हैं।
english_meaning: By giving up attachment, the yogis undertake work merely through the body, mind, intellect and even the organs, for the purification of themselves.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: युक्तः कर्मफलं त्यक्त्वा शान्तिमाप्नोति नैष्ठिकीम्। अयुक्तः कामकारेण फले सक्तो निबध्यते
transliteration: yuktaḥ karmaphalaṃ tyaktvā śāntimāpnoti naiṣṭhikīm, ayuktaḥ kāmakāreṇa phale sakto nibadhyate
hindi_meaning: कर्मयोगी कर्मफलका त्याग करके नैष्ठिकी शान्तिको प्राप्त होता है। परन्तु सकाम मनुष्य कामनाके कारण फलमें आसक्त होकर बँध जाता है।
english_meaning: Giving up the result of work by becoming resolute in faith, one attains Peace arising from steadfastness. One who is lacking in resolute faith, being attached to the result under the impulsion of desire, becomes bound.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: सर्वकर्माणि मनसा संन्यस्यास्ते सुखं वशी। नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन्न कारयन्
transliteration: sarvakarmāṇi manasā saṃnyasyāste sukhaṃ vaśī, navadvāre pure dehī naiva kurvanna kārayan
hindi_meaning: जिसकी इन्द्रियाँ और मन वशमें हैं, ऐसा देहधारी पुरुष नौ द्वारोंवाले शरीररूपी पुरमें सम्पूर्ण कर्मोंका विवेकपूर्वक मनसे त्याग करके निःसन्देह न करता हुआ और न करवाता हुआ सुखपूर्वक (अपने स्वरूपमें) स्थित रहता है।
english_meaning: The embodied man of self-control, having given up all actions mentally, continues happily in the town of nine gates, without doing or causing (others) to do anything at all.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः। न कर्मफलसंयोगं स्वभावस्तु प्रवर्तते
transliteration: na kartṛtvaṃ na karmāṇi lokasya sṛjati prabhuḥ, na karmaphalasaṃyogaṃ svabhāvastu pravartate
hindi_meaning: परमेश्वर मनुष्योंके न कर्तापनकी, न कर्मोंकी और न कर्मफलके साथ संयोगकी रचना करते हैं; किन्तु स्वभाव ही बरत रहा है।
english_meaning: The Self does not create agentship or any objects (of desire) for anyone; nor association with the results of actions. But it is Nature that acts.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: नादत्ते कस्यचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः। अज्ञानेनावृतं ज्ञानं तेन मुह्यन्ति जन्तवः
transliteration: nādatte kasyacitpāpaṃ na caiva sukṛtaṃ vibhuḥ, ajñānenāvṛtaṃ jñānaṃ tena muhyanti jantavaḥ
hindi_meaning: सर्वव्यापी परमात्मा न किसीके पापकर्मको और न शुभकर्मको ही ग्रहण करता है; किन्तु अज्ञानसे ज्ञान ढका हुआ है, उसीसे सब जीव मोहित हो रहे हैं।
english_meaning: The Omnipresent neither accepts anybody's sin nor even virtue. Knowledge remains covered by ignorance. Ther y the creatures become deluded.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: ज्ञानेन तु तदज्ञानं येषां नाशितमात्मनः। तेषामादित्यवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम्
transliteration: jñānena tu tadajñānaṃ yeṣāṃ nāśitamātmanaḥ, teṣāmādityavajjñānaṃ prakāśayati tatparam
hindi_meaning: परन्तु जिन्होंने अपने जिस ज्ञान-(विवक-) के द्वारा उस अज्ञानका नाश कर दिया है, उनका वह ज्ञान सूर्यकी तरह परमतत्त्व परमात्माको प्रकाशित कर देता है।
english_meaning: But in the case of those of whom that ignorance of theirs becomes destroyed by the knowledge (of the Self), their Knowledge, like the sun, reveals that supreme Reality.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: तद्बुद्धयस्तदात्मानस्तन्निष्ठास्तत्परायणाः। गच्छन्त्यपुनरावृत्तिं ज्ञाननिर्धूतकल्मषाः
transliteration: tadbuddhayastadātmānastanniṣṭhāstatparāyaṇāḥ, gacchantyapunarāvṛttiṃ jñānanirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ
hindi_meaning: जिनकी बुद्धि तदाकार हो रही है, जिनका मन तदाकार हो रहा है, जिनकी स्थिति परमात्मतत्वमें है, ऐसे परमात्मपरायण साधक ज्ञानके द्वारा पापरहित होकर अपुनरावृत्ति (परमगति) को प्राप्त होते हैं।
english_meaning: Those who have their intellect absorbed in That, whose Self is That, who are steadfast in That, who have That as their supreme Goal-they attain the state of non-returning, their dirt having been removed by Knowledge.
practical_guidance: Sit quietly for five minutes. Ask: 'What is the most meaningful thing I can contribute?' Let the answer arise naturally, without forcing it.

sanskrit_text: विद्याविनयसंपन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि। शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः
transliteration: vidyāvinayasaṃpanne brāhmaṇe gavi hastini, śuni caiva śvapāke ca paṇḍitāḥ samadarśinaḥ
hindi_meaning: ज्ञानी महापुरुष विद्या-विनययुक्त ब्राह्मणमें और चाण्डालमें तथा गाय, हाथी एवं कुत्तेमें भी समरूप परमात्माको देखनेवाले होते हैं।
english_meaning: The learned ones look with eanimity on a Brahmana endowed with learning and humality, a cow, an elephant and even a dog as well as an eater of dog's meat.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः। निर्दोषं हि समं ब्रह्म तस्माद्ब्रह्मणि ते स्थिताः
transliteration: ihaiva tairjitaḥ sargo yeṣāṃ sāmye sthitaṃ manaḥ, nirdoṣaṃ hi samaṃ brahma tasmādbrahmaṇi te sthitāḥ
hindi_meaning: जिनका अन्तःकरण समतामें स्थित है, उन्होंने इस जीवित-अवस्थामें ही सम्पूर्ण संसारको जीत लिया है; ब्रह्म निर्दोष और सम है, इसलिये वे ब्रह्ममें ही स्थित हैं।
english_meaning: Here [i.e. even while living in the body.] itself is r irth conered by them whose minds are established on sameness. Since Brahman is the same (in all) and free from defects, therefore they are established in Brahman.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: न प्रहृष्येत्प्रियं प्राप्य नोद्विजेत्प्राप्य चाप्रियम्। स्थिरबुद्धिरसम्मूढो ब्रह्मविद्ब्रह्मणि स्थितः
transliteration: na prahṛṣyetpriyaṃ prāpya nodvijetprāpya cāpriyam, sthirabuddhirasammūḍho brahmavidbrahmaṇi sthitaḥ
hindi_meaning: जो प्रियको प्राप्त होकर हर्षित न हो और अप्रियको प्राप्त होकर उद्विग्न न हो, वह स्थिर बुद्धिवाला, मूढ़तारहित तथा ब्रह्मको जाननेवाला मनुष्य ब्रह्ममें स्थित है।
english_meaning: A knower of Brahman, who is established in Brahman, should have his intellect steady and should not be deluded. He should not get delighted by getting what is desirable, nor become dejected by getting what is undesirable.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: बाह्यस्पर्शेष्वसक्तात्मा विन्दत्यात्मनि यत्सुखम्। स ब्रह्मयोगयुक्तात्मा सुखमक्षयमश्नुते
transliteration: bāhyasparśeṣvasaktātmā vindatyātmani yatsukham, sa brahmayogayuktātmā sukhamakṣayamaśnute
hindi_meaning: बाह्यस्पर्शमें आसक्तिरहित अन्तःकरणवाला साधक आत्मामें जो सुख है, उसको प्राप्त होता है। फिर वह ब्रह्ममें अभिन्नभावसे स्थित मनुष्य अक्षय सुखका अनुभव करता है।
english_meaning: With his heart unattached to external objects, he gets the bliss that is in the Self. With his heart absorbed in meditation on Brahman, he acires undecaying Bliss.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते। आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः
transliteration: ye hi saṃsparśajā bhogā duḥkhayonaya eva te, ādyantavantaḥ kaunteya na teṣu ramate budhaḥ
hindi_meaning: क्योंकि हे कुन्तीनन्दन ! जो इन्द्रियों और विषयोंके संयोगसे पैदा होनेवाले भोग (सुख) हैं, वे आदि-अन्तवाले और दुःखके ही कारण हैं। अतः विवेकशील मनुष्य उनमें रमण नहीं करता।
english_meaning: Since enjoyments that result from contact (with objects) are verily the sources of sorrow and have a beginning and an end, (therefore) O son of Kunti, the wise one does not delight in them.
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: शक्नोतीहैव यः सोढुं प्राक्शरीरविमोक्षणात्। कामक्रोधोद्भवं वेगं स युक्तः स सुखी नरः
transliteration: śaknotīhaiva yaḥ soḍhuṃ prākśarīravimokṣaṇāt, kāmakrodhodbhavaṃ vegaṃ sa yuktaḥ sa sukhī naraḥ
hindi_meaning: इस मनुष्य-शरीरमें जो कोई (मनुष्य) शरीर छूटनेसे पहले ही काम-क्रोधसे उत्पन्न होनेवाले वेगको सहन करनेमें समर्थ होता है, वह नर योगी है और वही सुखी है।
english_meaning: One who can withstand here itself-before departing from the body-the impulse arising from desire and anger, that man is a yogi; he is happy.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: योऽन्तःसुखोऽन्तरारामस्तथान्तर्ज्योतिरेव यः। स योगी ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं ब्रह्मभूतोऽधिगच्छति
transliteration: yo'ntaḥsukho'ntarārāmastathāntarjyotireva yaḥ, sa yogī brahmanirvāṇaṃ brahmabhūto'dhigacchati
hindi_meaning: जो मनुष्य केवल परमात्मामें सुखवाला है और केवल परमात्मामें रमण करनेवाला है तथा जो केवल परमात्मामें ज्ञानवाला है, वह ब्रह्ममें अपनी स्थितिका अनुभव करनेवाला सांख्ययोगी निर्वाण ब्रह्मको प्राप्त होता है।
english_meaning: One who is happy within, whose pleasure is within, and who has his light only within, that yogi, having become Brahman, attains absorption in Brahman.
practical_guidance: Cravings are temporary visitors — they will pass. When an urge arises, pause for three slow breaths before responding. The gap is where freedom lives.

sanskrit_text: लभन्ते ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः। छिन्नद्वैधा यतात्मानः सर्वभूतहिते रताः
transliteration: labhante brahmanirvāṇamṛṣayaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣāḥ, chinnadvaidhā yatātmānaḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ
hindi_meaning: जिनका शरीर मन-बुद्धि-इन्द्रियोंसहित वशमें है, जो सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके हितमें रत हैं, जिनके सम्पूर्ण संशय मिट गये हैं, जिनके सम्पूर्ण कल्मष (दोष) नष्ट हो गये हैं, वे विवेकी साधक निर्वाण ब्रह्मको प्राप्त होते हैं।
english_meaning: The seers whose sins have been attenuated, who are freed from doubt, whose organs are under control, who are engaged in doing good to all beings, attain absorption in Brahman.
practical_guidance: You cannot undo the past, only respond to it now. Forgive yourself as you would a dear friend who made a mistake. Then take one right action today.

sanskrit_text: कामक्रोधवियुक्तानां यतीनां यतचेतसाम्। अभितो ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं वर्तते विदितात्मनाम्
transliteration: kāmakrodhaviyuktānāṃ yatīnāṃ yatacetasām, abhito brahmanirvāṇaṃ vartate viditātmanām
hindi_meaning: काम-क्रोधसे सर्वथा रहित, जीते हुए मनवाले और स्वरूपका साक्षात्कार किये हुए सांख्ययोगियोंके लिये दोनों ओरसे--शरीरके रहते हुए अथवा शरीर छूटनेके बाद) निर्वाण ब्रह्म परिपूर्ण है।
english_meaning: To the monks who have control over their internal organ, who are free from desire and anger, who have known the Self, there is absorption in Brahman either way.
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: स्पर्शान्कृत्वा बहिर्बाह्यांश्चक्षुश्चैवान्तरे भ्रुवोः। प्राणापानौ समौ कृत्वा नासाभ्यन्तरचारिणौ
transliteration: sparśānkṛtvā bahirbāhyāṃścakṣuścaivāntare bhruvoḥ, prāṇāpānau samau kṛtvā nāsābhyantaracāriṇau
hindi_meaning: -- 5.28।। बाह्य पदार्थोंको बाहर ही छोड़कर और नेत्रोंकी दृष्टिको भौंहोंके बीचमें स्थित करके तथा नासिकामें विचरनेवाले प्राण और अपान वायुको सम करके जिसकी इन्द्रियाँ, मन और बुद्धि अपने वशमें हैं, जो मोक्ष-परायण है तथा जो इच्छा, भय और क्रोधसे सर्वथा रहित है, वह मुनि सदा मुक्त ही है।
english_meaning: -5.28 Keeping the external objects outside, the eyes at the juncture of the eye-brows, and making eal the outgoing and incoming breaths that move through the nostrils, the contemplative who has control over his organs, mind and intellect should be fully intent on Liberation and free from desire, fear and anger. He who is ever is verily free.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: यतेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिर्मुनिर्मोक्षपरायणः। विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो यः सदा मुक्त एव सः
transliteration: yatendriyamanobuddhirmunirmokṣaparāyaṇaḥ, vigatecchābhayakrodho yaḥ sadā mukta eva saḥ
hindi_meaning: -- 5.28।। बाह्य पदार्थोंको बाहर ही छोड़कर और नेत्रोंकी दृष्टिको भौंहोंके बीचमें स्थित करके तथा नासिकामें विचरनेवाले प्राण और अपान वायुको सम करके जिसकी इन्द्रियाँ, मन और बुद्धि अपने वशमें हैं, जो मोक्ष-परायण है तथा जो इच्छा, भय और क्रोधसे सर्वथा रहित है, वह मुनि सदा मुक्त ही है।
english_meaning: -5.28 Keeping the external objects outside, the eyes at the juncture of the eye-brows, and making eal the outgoing and incoming breaths that move through the nostrils, the contemplative who has control over his organs, mind and intellect should be fully intent on Liberation and free from desire, fear and anger. He who is ever is verily free.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम्। सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्छति
transliteration: bhoktāraṃ yajñatapasāṃ sarvalokamaheśvaram, suhṛdaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ jñātvā māṃ śāntimṛcchati
hindi_meaning: भक्त मुझे सब यज्ञों और तपोंका भोक्ता, सम्पूर्ण लोकोंका महान् ईश्वर तथा सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंका सुहृद् (स्वार्थरहित दयालु और प्रेमी) जानकर शान्तिको प्राप्त हो जाता है।
english_meaning: One attains Peace by knowing Me who, as the great Lord of all the worlds, am the enjoyer of sacrifices and austerities, (and) who am the friend of all creatures.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः। स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः
transliteration: anāśritaḥ karmaphalaṃ kāryaṃ karma karoti yaḥ, sa saṃnyāsī ca yogī ca na niragnirna cākriyaḥ
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले -- कर्मफलका आश्रय न लेकर जो कर्तव्यकर्म करता है, वही संन्यासी तथा योगी है; और केवल अग्निका त्याग करनेवाला संन्यासी नहीं होता तथा केवल क्रियाओंका त्याग करनेवाला योगी नहीं होता।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said He who performs an action which is his duty, without depending on the result of action, he is a monk and a yogi; (but) not (so in) he who does not keep a fire and is actionless.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव। न ह्यसंन्यस्तसङ्कल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन
transliteration: yaṃ saṃnyāsamiti prāhuryogaṃ taṃ viddhi pāṇḍava, na hyasaṃnyastasaṅkalpo yogī bhavati kaścana
hindi_meaning: हे अर्जुन ! लोग जिसको संन्यास कहते हैं, उसीको तुम योग समझो; क्योंकि संकल्पोंका त्याग किये बिना मनुष्य कोई-सा भी योगी नहीं हो सकता।
english_meaning: That which they call monasticism, know that to be Yoa, O Pandava, For, nobody who has not given up expectations can be a yogi.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: आरुरुक्षोर्मुनेर्योगं कर्म कारणमुच्यते। योगारूढस्य तस्यैव शमः कारणमुच्यते
transliteration: ārurukṣormuneryogaṃ karma kāraṇamucyate, yogārūḍhasya tasyaiva śamaḥ kāraṇamucyate
hindi_meaning: जो योग-(समता-) में आरूढ़ होना चाहता है, ऐसे मननशील योगीके लिये कर्तव्य-कर्म करना कारण कहा गया है और उसी योगारूढ़ मनुष्यका शम (शान्ति) परमात्मप्राप्तिमें कारण कहा गया है।
english_meaning: For the sage who wishes to ascend to (Dhyana-) yoga, action is said to be the means. For that person, when he has ascended to (Dhyana-)yoga, inaction alone is said to be the means.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्वनुषज्जते। सर्वसङ्कल्पसंन्यासी योगारूढस्तदोच्यते
transliteration: yadā hi nendriyārtheṣu na karmasvanuṣajjate, sarvasaṅkalpasaṃnyāsī yogārūḍhastadocyate
hindi_meaning: जिस समय न इन्द्रियोंके भोगोंमें तथा न कर्मोंमें ही आसक्त होता है, उस समय वह सम्पूर्ण संकल्पोंका त्यागी मनुष्य योगारूढ़ कहा जाता है।
english_meaning: Verily, [Verily: This word emphasizes the fact that, since attachment to sense objects like sound etc. and to actions is an obstacle in the path of Yoga, therefore the removal of that obstruction is the means to its attainment.] when a man who has given up thought about everything does not get attached to sense-objects or acitons, he is then said to be established in Yoga.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्। आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः॥
transliteration: uddhared atmanatmanam natmanam avasadayet, atmaiva hy atmano bandhur atmaiva ripur atmanah
hindi_meaning: मनुष्य को चाहिए कि वह अपने आप को अपने द्वारा उठाए और अपने आप को नीचे न गिरने दे, क्योंकि यह आत्मा ही अपना मित्र है और यह आत्मा ही अपना शत्रु है।
english_meaning: One must deliver himself with the help of his mind, and not degrade himself. The mind is the friend of the conditioned soul, and his enemy as well.
practical_guidance: No one can save you but yourself. This is not harsh — it is empowering. Identify one area where you have been waiting for external rescue — a person, a circumstance, luck — and take one self-directed action in that area today. You are your own best friend when you act wisely.

sanskrit_text: बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः। अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत्॥
transliteration: bandhur atmatmanas tasya yenatmaiva tmanatmaiva jitah, anatmanas tu satrutve vartetatmaiva satru-vat
hindi_meaning: जिस मनुष्य ने अपने मन को जीत लिया है, उसके लिए मन ही उसका मित्र है। परन्तु जिसने मन को नहीं जीता, उसके लिए मन ही शत्रु की तरह काम करता है।
english_meaning: For one who has conquered the mind, the Supersoul is already reached, for he has attained tranquility. To such a person happiness and distress, heat and cold, honor and dishonor are all the same.
practical_guidance: Your mind is either your greatest ally or your most persistent enemy depending on whether you have trained it. Today, when a negative thought arises, do not suppress it — simply observe it without engaging. This one practice of witnessing, done consistently, is how the mind becomes your friend.

sanskrit_text: जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य परमात्मा समाहितः। शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु तथा मानापमानयोः
transliteration: jitātmanaḥ praśāntasya paramātmā samāhitaḥ, śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkheṣu tathā mānāpamānayoḥ
hindi_meaning: जिसने अपने-आपपर अपनी विजय कर ली है, उस शीत-उष्ण (अनुकूलता-प्रतिकूलता) सुख-दुःख तथा मान-अपमानमें निर्विकार मनुष्यको परमात्मा नित्यप्राप्त हैं।
english_meaning: The supreme Self of one who has control over the aggregate of his body and organs, and who is tranil, becomes manifest. (He should be eipoised) [These words are supplied to complete the sentence.] in the midst of cold and heat, happiness and sorrow, as also honour and dishonour.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: ज्ञानविज्ञानतृप्तात्मा कूटस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः। युक्त इत्युच्यते योगी समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः
transliteration: jñānavijñānatṛptātmā kūṭastho vijitendriyaḥ, yukta ityucyate yogī samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ
hindi_meaning: जिसका अन्तःकरण ज्ञान-विज्ञानसे तृप्त है, जो कूटकी तरह निर्विकार है, जितेन्द्रिय है और मिट्टीके ढेले, पत्थर तथा स्वर्णमें समबुद्धिवाला है -- ऐसा योगी युक्त (योगारूढ़) कहा जाता है।
english_meaning: One whose mind is satisfied with knowledge and realization, who is unmoved, who has his organs under control, is sadi to be Self-absorbed. The yogi treats eally a lump of earth, a stone and gold.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: सुहृन्मित्रार्युदासीनमध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु। साधुष्वपि च पापेषु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते
transliteration: suhṛnmitrāryudāsīnamadhyasthadveṣyabandhuṣu, sādhuṣvapi ca pāpeṣu samabuddhirviśiṣyate
hindi_meaning: सुहृद्, मित्र, वैरी, उदासीन, मध्यस्थ, द्वेष्य और सम्बन्धियोंमें तथा साधु-आचरण करनेवालोंमें और पाप-आचरण करनेवालोंमें भी समबुद्धिवाला मनुष्य श्रेष्ठ है।
english_meaning: He excels who has sameness of view with regard to a benefactor, a friend, a foe [Ari (foe) is one who does harm behind one's back.], a neutral, an arbiter, the hateful, [Dvesyah is one who openly hateful.] a relative, good people and even sinners.
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: योगी युञ्जीत सततमात्मानं रहसि स्थितः। एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः
transliteration: yogī yuñjīta satatamātmānaṃ rahasi sthitaḥ, ekākī yatacittātmā nirāśīraparigrahaḥ
hindi_meaning: भोगबुद्धिसे संग्रह न करनेवाला, इच्छारहित और अन्तःकरण तथा शरीरको वशमें रखनेवाला योगी अकेला एकान्तमें स्थित होकर मनको निरन्तर परमात्मामें लगाये।
english_meaning: A yogi should constantly concentrate his mind by staying in a solitary place, alone, with mind and body controlled, free from expectations, (and) free from acisition.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः। नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम्
transliteration: śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiramāsanamātmanaḥ, nātyucchritaṃ nātinīcaṃ cailājinakuśottaram
hindi_meaning: शुद्ध भूमिपर, जिसपर क्रमशः कुश, मृगछाला और वस्त्र बिछे हैं, जो न अत्यन्त ऊँचा है और न अत्यन्त नीचा, ऐसे अपने आसनको स्थिरस्थापन करके।
english_meaning: Having firmly established in a clean place his seat, neither too high nor too low, and made of cloth, skin and kusa-grass, placed successively one below the other;
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः। उपविश्यासने युञ्ज्याद्योगमात्मविशुद्धये
transliteration: tatraikāgraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā yatacittendriyakriyaḥ, upaviśyāsane yuñjyādyogamātmaviśuddhaye
hindi_meaning: उस आसनपर बैठकर चित्त और इन्द्रियोंकी क्रियाओंको वशमें रखते हुए मनको एकाग्र करके अन्तःकरणकी शुद्धिके लिये योगका अभ्यास करे।
english_meaning: (and) sitting on that seat, he should concentrate his mind for the purification of the internal organ, making the mind one-pointed and keeping the actions of the mind and senses under control.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः। संप्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन्
transliteration: samaṃ kāyaśirogrīvaṃ dhārayannacalaṃ sthiraḥ, saṃprekṣya nāsikāgraṃ svaṃ diśaścānavalokayan
hindi_meaning: काया, शिर और ग्रीवाको सीधे अचल धारण करके तथा दिशाओंको न देखकर केवल अपनी नासिकाके अग्रभागको देखते हुए स्थिर होकर बैठे।
english_meaning: Holding the body, head and neck erect and still, being steady, looking at the tip of his own nose-and not looking around;
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीर्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः। मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः
transliteration: praśāntātmā vigatabhīrbrahmacārivrate sthitaḥ, manaḥ saṃyamya maccitto yukta āsīta matparaḥ
hindi_meaning: जिसका अन्तःकरण शान्त है, जो भय-रहित है और जो ब्रह्मचारिव्रतमें स्थित है, ऐसा सावधान योगी मनका संयम करके मेरेमें चित्त लगाता हुआ मेरे परायण होकर बैठे।
english_meaning: He should remain seated with a placid mind, free from fear, firm in the vow of a celibate, and with the mind fixed on Me by controlling it through concentration, having Me as the supreme Goal.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: युञ्जन्नेवं सदाऽऽत्मानं योगी नियतमानसः। शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति
transliteration: yuñjannevaṃ sadā''tmānaṃ yogī niyatamānasaḥ, śāntiṃ nirvāṇaparamāṃ matsaṃsthāmadhigacchati
hindi_meaning: नियत मनवाला योगी मनको इस तरहसे सदा परमात्मामें लगाता हुआ मेरेमें सम्यक् स्थितिवाली जो निर्वाणपरमा शान्ति है, उसको प्राप्त हो जाता है।
english_meaning: Concentrating the mind thus for ever, the yogi of controlled mind achieves the Peace which culminates in Liberation and which abides in Me.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः। न चातिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन
transliteration: nātyaśnatastu yogo'sti na caikāntamanaśnataḥ, na cātisvapnaśīlasya jāgrato naiva cārjuna
hindi_meaning: हे अर्जुन ! यह योग न तो अधिक खानेवालेका और न बिलकुल न खानेवालेका तथा न अधिक सोनेवालेका और न बिलकुल न सोनेवालेका ही सिद्ध होता है।
english_meaning: But, O Arjuna, Yoga is not for one who eats too much, nor for one who does not eat at all; neither for one who habitually sleeps too long, nor surely for one who keeps awake.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु। युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा
transliteration: yuktāhāravihārasya yuktaceṣṭasya karmasu, yuktasvapnāvabodhasya yogo bhavati duḥkhahā
hindi_meaning: दुःखोंका नाश करनेवाला योग तो यथायोग्य आहार और विहार करनेवालेका, कर्मोंमें यथायोग्य चेष्टा करनेवालेका तथा यथायोग्य सोने और जागनेवालेका ही सिद्ध होता है।
english_meaning: Yoga becomes a destroyer of sorrow of one whose eating and movements are regulated, whose effort in works is moderate, and whose sleep and wakefulness are temperate.
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते। निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा
transliteration: yadā viniyataṃ cittamātmanyevāvatiṣṭhate, niḥspṛhaḥ sarvakāmebhyo yukta ityucyate tadā
hindi_meaning: वशमें किया हुआ चित्त जिस कालमें अपने स्वरूपमें ही स्थित हो जाता है और स्वयं सम्पूर्ण पदार्थोंसे निःस्पृह हो जाता है, उस कालमें वह योगी है - ऐसा कहा जाता है।
english_meaning: A man who has become free from hankering for all desirable objects is then said to be Self-absorbed when the controlled mind rests in the Self alone.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता। योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः
transliteration: yathā dīpo nivātastho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā, yogino yatacittasya yuñjato yogamātmanaḥ
hindi_meaning: जैसे स्पन्दनरहित वायुके स्थानमें स्थित दीपककी लौ चेष्टारहित हो जाती है, योगका अभ्यास करते हुए वश में किए हुए चित्तवाले योगीके चित्तकी वैसी ही उपमा कही गयी है।
english_meaning: As a lamp kept in a windless place does not flicker, such is the simile thought of for the yogi whose mind is under control, and who is engaged in concentration on the Self.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया। यत्र चैवात्मनाऽऽत्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति
transliteration: yatroparamate cittaṃ niruddhaṃ yogasevayā, yatra caivātmanā''tmānaṃ paśyannātmani tuṣyati
hindi_meaning: योगका सेवन करनेसे जिस अवस्थामें निरुद्ध चित्त उपराम हो जाता है तथा जिस अवस्थामें स्वयं अपने-आप से अपने-आपको देखता हुआ अपने-आपमें ही सन्तुष्ट हो जाता है।
english_meaning: At the time when the mind restrained through the practice of Yoga gets withdrawn, and just when by seeing the Self by the self one remains contented in the Self alone [A.G. construes the word eva (certainly) with tusyati (remains contented).-Tr.];
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद्बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम्। वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः
transliteration: sukhamātyantikaṃ yattadbuddhigrāhyamatīndriyam, vetti yatra na caivāyaṃ sthitaścalati tattvataḥ
hindi_meaning: जो सुख आत्यन्तिक, अतीन्द्रिय और बुद्धिग्राह्य है, उस सुखका जिस अवस्थामें अनुभव करता है और जिस सुखमें स्थित हुआ यह ध्यानयोगी फिर कभी तत्त्वसे विचलित नहीं होता।
english_meaning: When one experienece that absolute Blisss which can be intuited by the intellect and which is beyond the senses, and being established (thus) this person surely does not swerve from Reality;
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः। यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते
transliteration: yaṃ labdhvā cāparaṃ lābhaṃ manyate nādhikaṃ tataḥ, yasminsthito na duḥkhena guruṇāpi vicālyate
hindi_meaning: जिस लाभकी प्राप्ति होनेपर उससे अधिक कोई दूसरा लाभ उसके माननेमें भी नहीं आता और जिसमें स्थित होनेपर वह बड़े भारी दुःखसे भी विचलित नहीं किया जा सकता।
english_meaning: Obtaining which one does not think of any other acisition to be superior to that, and being established in which one is not perturbed even by great sorrow;
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: तं विद्याद् दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम्। स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा
transliteration: taṃ vidyād duḥkhasaṃyogaviyogaṃ yogasaṃjñitam, sa niścayena yoktavyo yogo'nirviṇṇacetasā
hindi_meaning: जिसमें दुःखोंके संयोगका ही वियोग है, उसीको 'योग' नामसे जानना चाहिये। (वह योग जिस ध्यानयोगका लक्ष्य है,) उस ध्यानयोगका अभ्यास न उकताये हुए चित्तसे निश्चयपूर्वक करना चाहिये।
english_meaning: One should know that severance of contact with sorrow to be what is called Yoga. That Yoga has to be practised with perservance and with an undepressed heart.
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: सङ्कल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः। मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः
transliteration: saṅkalpaprabhavānkāmāṃstyaktvā sarvānaśeṣataḥ, manasaivendriyagrāmaṃ viniyamya samantataḥ
hindi_meaning: संकल्पसे उत्पन्न होनेवाली सम्पूर्ण कामनाओंका सर्वथा त्याग करके और मनसे ही इन्द्रिय-समूहको सभी ओरसे हटाकर।
english_meaning: By totally eschewing all desires which arise from thoughts, and restraining with the mind itself all the organs from every side;
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: शनैः शनैरुपरमेद् बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया। आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत्
transliteration: śanaiḥ śanairuparamed buddhyā dhṛtigṛhītayā, ātmasaṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiñcidapi cintayet
hindi_meaning: धैर्ययुक्त बुद्धिके द्वारा संसारसे धीरे-धीरे उपराम हो जाय और परमात्मस्वरूपमें मन-(बुद्धि-) को सम्यक् प्रकारसे स्थापन करके फिर कुछ भी चिन्तन न करे।
english_meaning: One should gradually withdraw with the intellect endowed with steadiness. Making the mind fixed in the Self, one should not think of anything whatsoever.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम्। ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत्
transliteration: yato yato niścarati manaścañcalamasthiram, tatastato niyamyaitadātmanyeva vaśaṃ nayet
hindi_meaning: यह अस्थिर और चञ्चल मन जहाँ-जहाँ विचरण करता है, वहाँ-वहाँसे हटाकर इसको एक परमात्मामें ही लगाये।
english_meaning: (The yogi) should bring (this mind) under the subjugation of the Self Itself, by restraining it from all those causes whatever due to which the restless, unsteady mind wanders away.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं सुखमुत्तमम्। उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम्
transliteration: praśāntamanasaṃ hyenaṃ yoginaṃ sukhamuttamam, upaiti śāntarajasaṃ brahmabhūtamakalmaṣam
hindi_meaning: जिसके सब पाप नष्ट हो गये हैं, जिसका रजोगुण तथा मन सर्वथा शान्त(निर्मल) हो गया है, ऐसे इस ब्रह्मस्वरूप योगीको निश्चित ही उत्तम (सात्त्विक) सुख प्राप्त होता है।
english_meaning: Supreme Bliss comes to this yogi alone whose mind has become perfectly tranil, whose (ality of) rajas has been eliminated, who has become identified with Brahman, and is taintless.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: युञ्जन्नेवं सदाऽऽत्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः। सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते
transliteration: yuñjannevaṃ sadā''tmānaṃ yogī vigatakalmaṣaḥ, sukhena brahmasaṃsparśamatyantaṃ sukhamaśnute
hindi_meaning: इस प्रकार अपने-आपको सदा परमात्मामें लगाता हुआ पापरहित योगी सुखपूर्वक ब्रह्मप्राप्तिरूप अत्यन्त सुखको प्राप्त हो जाता है।
english_meaning: By concentrating his mind constantly thus, the taintless yogi easily attains the absolute Bliss of contact with Brahman.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि। ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः
transliteration: sarvabhūtasthamātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani, īkṣate yogayuktātmā sarvatra samadarśanaḥ
hindi_meaning: सब जगह अपने स्वरूपको देखनेवाला और ध्यानयोगसे युक्त अन्तःकरणवाला योगा अपने स्वरूपको सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंमें स्थित देखता है और सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंको अपने स्वरूपमें देखता है।
english_meaning: One who has his mind Self-absorbed through Yoga, and who has the vision of sameness every-where, see this Self existing in everything, and every-thing in his Self.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति। तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति
transliteration: yo māṃ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati, tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati
hindi_meaning: जो सबमें मुझे देखता है और सबको मुझमें देखता है, उसके लिये मैं अदृश्य नहीं होता और वह मेरे लिये अदृश्य नहीं होता।
english_meaning: One who sees Me in everything, and sees all things in Me-I do not out of his vision, and he also is not lost to My vision.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः। सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते
transliteration: sarvabhūtasthitaṃ yo māṃ bhajatyekatvamāsthitaḥ, sarvathā vartamāno'pi sa yogī mayi vartate
hindi_meaning: मेरेमें एकीभावसे स्थित हुआ जो योगी सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंमें स्थित मेरा भजन करता है, वह सब कुछ बर्ताव करता हुआ भी मेरेमें ही बर्ताव कर रहा है अर्थात् वह सर्वथा मेरेमें ही स्थित है।
english_meaning: That yogi who, being established in unity, adores Me as existing in all things, he exist in Me-in whatever condition he may be.
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन। सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं सः योगी परमो मतः
transliteration: ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṃ paśyati yo'rjuna, sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ saḥ yogī paramo mataḥ
hindi_meaning: हे अर्जुन ! जो (ध्यानयुक्त ज्ञानी महापुरुष) अपने शरीरकी उपमासे सब जगह अपनेको समान देखता है और सुख अथवा दुःखको भी समान देखता है, वह परम योगी माना गया है।
english_meaning: O Arjuna, that yogi is considered the best who judges what is happiness and sorrow in all beings by the same standard as he would apply to himself.
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन। एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात् स्थितिं स्थिराम्
transliteration: yo'yaṃ yogastvayā proktaḥ sāmyena madhusūdana, etasyāhaṃ na paśyāmi cañcalatvāt sthitiṃ sthirām
hindi_meaning: अर्जुन बोले -- हे मधुसूदन ! आपने समतापूर्वक जो यह योग कहा है, मनकी चञ्चलताके कारण मैं इस योगकी स्थिर स्थिति नहीं देखता हूँ।
english_meaning: Arjuna said O Madhusudana (Krsna), this Yoga that has been spoken of by You as sameness, I do not see its steady continuance, owing to the restlessness (of the mind).
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्दृढम्। तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम्
transliteration: cañcalaṃ hi manaḥ kṛṣṇa pramāthi balavaddṛḍham, tasyāhaṃ nigrahaṃ manye vāyoriva suduṣkaram
hindi_meaning: क्योंकि हे कृष्ण ! मन बड़ा ही चञ्चल, प्रमथनशील, दृढ़ (जिद्दी) और बलवान् है। उसका निग्रह करना मैं वायुकी तरह अत्यन्त कठिन मानता हूँ।
english_meaning: For, O Krsna, the mind is unsteady, turbulent, strong and obstinate. I consider its control to be as greatly difficult as of the wind.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम्। अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते॥
transliteration: asamsayam maha-baho mano durnigraham calam, abhyasena tu kaunteya vairagyena ca grhyate
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान ने कहा: हे महाबाहो, निःसंदेह मन बड़ा चंचल और कठिनाई से वश में होने वाला है। परन्तु हे कौन्तेय, यह अभ्यास और वैराग्य से वश में किया जा सकता है।
english_meaning: Lord Sri Krishna said: O mighty-armed son of Kunti, it is undoubtedly very difficult to curb the restless mind, but it is possible with suitable practice and by detachment.
practical_guidance: If you feel your mind is impossible to control, know that Krishna himself acknowledged this — and gave you the solution: practice and detachment. Start with just 5 minutes of meditation daily. Do not expect perfection. Simply return to the breath each time the mind wanders. Consistency over weeks transforms the mind.

sanskrit_text: असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः। वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः
transliteration: asaṃyatātmanā yogo duṣprāpa iti me matiḥ, vaśyātmanā tu yatatā śakyo'vāptumupāyataḥ
hindi_meaning: जिसका मन पूरा वशमें नहीं है, उसके द्वारा योग प्राप्त होना कठिन है। परन्तु उपायपूर्वक यत्न करनेवाले वश्यात्माको योग प्राप्त हो सकता है, ऐसा मेरा मत है।
english_meaning: My conviction is that Yoga is difficult to be attained by one of uncontrolled mind. But it is possible to be attained through the (above) means by one who strives and has a controlled mind.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः। अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति
transliteration: ayatiḥ śraddhayopeto yogāccalitamānasaḥ, aprāpya yogasaṃsiddhiṃ kāṃ gatiṃ kṛṣṇa gacchati
hindi_meaning: अर्जुन बोले - हे कृष्ण ! जिसकी साधनमें श्रद्धा है, पर जिसका प्रयत्न शिथिल है, वह अन्तसमयमें अगर योगसे विचलितमना हो जाय, तो वह योगसिद्धिको प्राप्त न करके किस गतिको चला जाता है?
english_meaning: Arjuna said O krsna, failing to achieve perfection in Yoga, what goal does one attain who, though possessed of faith, is not diligent and whose mind becomes deflected from Yoga?
practical_guidance: Sit quietly for five minutes. Ask: 'What is the most meaningful thing I can contribute?' Let the answer arise naturally, without forcing it.

sanskrit_text: कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति। अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि
transliteration: kaccinnobhayavibhraṣṭaśchinnābhramiva naśyati, apratiṣṭho mahābāho vimūḍho brahmaṇaḥ pathi
hindi_meaning: हे महाबाहो ! संसारके आश्रयसे रहित और परमात्मप्राप्तिके मार्गमें मोहित अर्थात् विचलित -- इस तरह दोनों ओरसे भ्रष्ट हुआ साधक क्या छिन्न-भिन्न बादलकी तरह नष्ट तो नहीं हो जाता ?
english_meaning: O Mighty-armed one, fallen from both, without support, deluded on the path to Brahman, does he not get ruined like a scattered cloud?
practical_guidance: Sit quietly for five minutes. Ask: 'What is the most meaningful thing I can contribute?' Let the answer arise naturally, without forcing it.

sanskrit_text: एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः। त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्युपपद्यते
transliteration: etanme saṃśayaṃ kṛṣṇa chettumarhasyaśeṣataḥ, tvadanyaḥ saṃśayasyāsya chettā na hyupapadyate
hindi_meaning: हे कृष्ण! मेरे इस सन्देहका सर्वथा छेदन करनेके लिये आप ही योग्य हैं; क्योंकि इस संशयका छेदन करनेवाला आपके सिवाय दूसरा कोई हो नहीं सकता।
english_meaning: O Krsna, You should totally eradicate this doubt of mine. For, none other than Yourself can be the dispeller of this doubt!
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते। नहि कल्याणकृत्कश्िचद्दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति
transliteration: pārtha naiveha nāmutra vināśastasya vidyate, nahi kalyāṇakṛtkaśिcaddurgatiṃ tāta gacchati
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले -- हे पृथानन्दन ! उसका न तो इस लोकमें और न परलोकमें ही विनाश होता है; क्योंकि हे प्यारे ! कल्याणकारी काम करनेवाला कोई भी मनुष्य दुर्गतिको प्राप्त नहीं जाता।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said O Partha, there is certainly no ruin for him here or hereafter. For, no one engaged in good meets with a deplorable end, My son!
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः। शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते
transliteration: prāpya puṇyakṛtāṃ lokānuṣitvā śāśvatīḥ samāḥ, śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe yogabhraṣṭo'bhijāyate
hindi_meaning: वह योगभ्रष्ट पुण्यकर्म करनेवालोंके लोकोंको प्राप्त होकर और वहाँ बहुत वर्षोंतक रहकर फिर यहाँ शुद्ध श्रीमानोंके घरमें जन्म लेता है।
english_meaning: Attaining the worlds of the righteous, and residing there for eternal years, the man fallen from Yoga is born in the house of the pious and the properous.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम्। एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम्
transliteration: athavā yogināmeva kule bhavati dhīmatām, etaddhi durlabhataraṃ loke janma yadīdṛśam
hindi_meaning: अथवा (वैराग्यवान्) योगभ्रष्ट ज्ञानवान् योगियोंके कुलमें ही जन्म लेता है। इस प्रकारका जो यह जन्म है, यह संसारमें बहुत ही दुर्लभ है।
english_meaning: Or he is born in the family of wise yogis [Persons possessing knowledge of Brahman. (S. concedes that some rare householders also can have this knowledge, and he cites the instances of Vasistha, Agastya, Janaka and Asvapati of olden days, and Vacaspati and the author of Khanada of recent times.)] only. Such a birth as is of this kind is surely more difficult to get in the world.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम्। यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन
transliteration: tatra taṃ buddhisaṃyogaṃ labhate paurvadehikam, yatate ca tato bhūyaḥ saṃsiddhau kurunandana
hindi_meaning: हे कुरुनन्दन ! वहाँपर उसको पूर्वजन्मकृत साधन-सम्पत्ति अनायास ही प्राप्त हो जाती है। फिर उससे वह साधनकी सिद्धिके विषयमें पुनः विशेषतासे यत्न करता है।
english_meaning: There he becomes endowed with that wisdom acired in the previous body. and he strives more than before for perfection, O scion of the Kuru dynasty.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः। जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते
transliteration: pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva hriyate hyavaśo'pi saḥ, jijñāsurapi yogasya śabdabrahmātivartate
hindi_meaning: वह (श्रीमानोंके घरमें जन्म लेनेवाला योगभ्रष्ट मनुष्य) भोगोंके परवश होता हुआ भी पूर्वजन्ममें किये हुए अभ्यास-(साधन-) के कारण ही परमात्माकी तरफ खिंच जाता है; क्योंकि योग-(समता-) का जिज्ञासु भी वेदोंमें कहे हुए सकाम कर्मोंका अतिक्रमण कर जाता है।
english_meaning: For, by that very past practice, he is carried forward even in spite of himself! Even a seeker of Yoga transcends the result of the performance of Vedic rituals!
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः। अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम्
transliteration: prayatnādyatamānastu yogī saṃśuddhakilbiṣaḥ, anekajanmasaṃsiddhastato yāti parāṃ gatim
hindi_meaning: परन्तु जो योगी प्रयत्नपूर्वक यत्न करता है और जिसके पाप नष्ट हो गये हैं तथा जो अनेक जन्मोंसे सिद्ध हुआ है, वह योगी फिर परमगतिको प्राप्त हो जाता है।
english_meaning: However, the yogi, applying himself assiduously, becoming purified from sin and attaining perfection through many births, ther y acheives the highest Goal.
practical_guidance: Sit quietly for five minutes. Ask: 'What is the most meaningful thing I can contribute?' Let the answer arise naturally, without forcing it.

sanskrit_text: तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः। कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन
transliteration: tapasvibhyo'dhiko yogī jñānibhyo'pi mato'dhikaḥ, karmibhyaścādhiko yogī tasmādyogī bhavārjuna
hindi_meaning: (सकामभाववाले) तपस्वियोंसे भी योगी श्रेष्ठ है, ज्ञानियोंसे भी योगी श्रेष्ठ है और कर्मियोंसे भी योगी श्रेष्ठ है -- ऐसा मेरा मत है। अतः हे अर्जुन ! तू योगी हो जा।
english_meaning: A yogi is higher than men of austerity; he is considered higher even than men of knowledge. The yogi is also higher than men of action. Therefore, O Arjuna, do you become a yogi.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना। श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः
transliteration: yogināmapi sarveṣāṃ madgatenāntarātmanā, śraddhāvānbhajate yo māṃ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ
hindi_meaning: सम्पूर्ण योगियोंमें भी जो श्रद्धावान् भक्त मुझमें तल्लीन हुए मनसे मेरा भजन करता है, वह मेरे मतमें सर्वश्रेष्ठ योगी है।
english_meaning: Even among all the yogis, he who adores Me with his mind fixed on Me and with faith,he is considered by Me to be the best of the yogis.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः। असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु
transliteration: mayyāsaktamanāḥ pārtha yogaṃ yuñjanmadāśrayaḥ, asaṃśayaṃ samagraṃ māṃ yathā jñāsyasi tacchṛṇu
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले -- हे पृथानन्दन ! मुझमें आसक्त मनवाला, मेरे आश्रित होकर योगका अभ्यास करता हुआ तू मेरे समग्ररूपको निःसन्देह जैसा जानेगा, उसको सुन।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said O Partha, hear how you, having the mind fixed on Me, practising the Yoga of Meditation and taking refuge in Me, will know Me with certainly and in fulness.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः। यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते
transliteration: jñānaṃ te'haṃ savijñānamidaṃ vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ, yajjñātvā neha bhūyo'nyajjñātavyamavaśiṣyate
hindi_meaning: तेरे लिये मैं विज्ञानसहित ज्ञान सम्पूर्णतासे कहूँगा, जिसको जाननेके बाद फिर यहाँ कुछ भी जानना बाकी नहीं रहेगा।
english_meaning: I shall tell you in detail of this Knowledge which is combined with realization, [From the statement, 'jnasyasi, you will know', in the earlier verse, one may conclude that the Lord is speaking of indirect or theoretical knowledge. The word 'idam, this' rules out such a conclusion; and it has also been said that this Knowledge is 'savijnanam, combined with direct experienece, realization'; it is Consciousness.] after experience which there remains nothing else here to be known again.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्चिद्यतति सिद्धये। यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्चिन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः
transliteration: manuṣyāṇāṃ sahasreṣu kaścidyatati siddhaye, yatatāmapi siddhānāṃ kaścinmāṃ vetti tattvataḥ
hindi_meaning: हजारों मनुष्योंमें कोई एक वास्तविक सिद्धिके लिये यत्न करता है और उन यत्न करनेवाले सिद्धोंमें कोई एक ही मुझे तत्त्वसे जानता है।
english_meaning: Among thousands of men a rare one endeavours for perfection. Even of the perfected ones who are diligent, one perchance knows Me in truth.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च। अहङ्कार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा
transliteration: bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca, ahaṅkāra itīyaṃ me bhinnā prakṛtiraṣṭadhā
hindi_meaning: -- 7.5।। पृथ्वी, जल, तेज, वायु, आकाश -- ये पञ्चमहाभूत और मन, बुद्धि तथा अहंकार -- यह आठ प्रकारके भेदोंवाली मेरी 'अपरा' प्रकृति है। हे महाबाहो ! इस अपरा प्रकृतिसे भिन्न जीवरूप बनी हुई मेरी 'परा' प्रकृतिको जान, जिसके द्वारा यह जगत् धारण किया जाता है।
english_meaning: This Prakrti of Mine is divided eight-fold thus: earth, water, fire, air, space, mind, intellect and also egoism.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम्। जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत्
transliteration: apareyamitastvanyāṃ prakṛtiṃ viddhi me parām, jīvabhūtāṃ mahābāho yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat
hindi_meaning: -- 7.5।। पृथ्वी, जल, तेज, वायु, आकाश -- ये पञ्चमहाभूत और मन, बुद्धि तथा अहंकार -- यह आठ प्रकारके भेदोंवाली मेरी अपरा प्रकृति है। हे महाबाहो ! इस 'अपरा' प्रकृतिसे भिन्न मेरी जीवरूपा बनी हुुई मेरी 'परा' प्रकृतिको जान, जिसके द्वारा यह जगत् धारण किया जाता है।
english_meaning: O mighty-armed one, this is the inferior (Prakrti). Know the other Prakrti of Mine which, however, is higher than this, which has taken the from of individual souls, and by which this world is uphelp.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय। अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा
transliteration: etadyonīni bhūtāni sarvāṇītyupadhāraya, ahaṃ kṛtsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayastathā
hindi_meaning: अपरा और परा -- इन दोनों प्रकृतियोंके संयोगसे ही सम्पूर्ण प्राणी उत्पन्न होते हैं, ऐसा तुम समझो। मैं सम्पूर्ण जगत् का प्रभव तथा प्रलय हूँ।
english_meaning: Understand thus that all things (sentient and insentient) have these as their source. I am the origin as also the end of the whole Universe.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय। मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव
transliteration: mattaḥ parataraṃ nānyatkiñcidasti dhanañjaya, mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva
hindi_meaning: हे धनञ्जय ! मेरे बढ़कर (इस जगत् का) दूसरा कोई किञ्चिन्मात्र भी कारण नहीं है। जैसे सूतकी मणियाँ सूतके धागेमें पिरोयी हुई होती हैं, ऐसे ही यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् मेरेमें ही ओत-प्रोत है।
english_meaning: O Dhananjaya, there is nothing else whatsoever higher than Myself. All this is strung on Me like pearls on a string.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः। प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु
transliteration: raso'hamapsu kaunteya prabhāsmi śaśisūryayoḥ, praṇavaḥ sarvavedeṣu śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṃ nṛṣu
hindi_meaning: हे कुन्तीनन्दन ! जलोंमें रस मैं हूँ, चन्द्रमा और सूर्यमें प्रभा (प्रकाश) मैं हूँ, सम्पूर्ण वेदोंमें प्रणव (ओंकार) मैं हूँ, आकाशमें शब्द और मनुष्योंमें पुरुषार्थ मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: O son of Kunti, I am the taste of water, I am the effulgence of the moon and the sun; (the letter) Om in all the Vedas, the sound in space, and manhood in men.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ। जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु
transliteration: puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca tejaścāsmi vibhāvasau, jīvanaṃ sarvabhūteṣu tapaścāsmi tapasviṣu
hindi_meaning: पृथ्वीमें पवित्र गन्ध मैं हूँ, और अग्निमें तेज मैं हूँ, तथा सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंमें जीवनीशक्ति मैं हूँ और तपस्वियोंमें तपस्या मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: I am also the sweet fragrance in the earth; I am the brillinace in the fire, and the life in all beings; and I am the austerity of the ascetics.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम्। बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्
transliteration: bījaṃ māṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viddhi pārtha sanātanam, buddhirbuddhimatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham
hindi_meaning: हे पृथानन्दन ! सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंका अनादि बीज मुझे जान। बुद्धिमानोंमें बुद्धि और तेजस्वियोंमें तेज मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: O Partha, know Me to be the eternal Seed of all beings. I am the intellect of the intelligent, I am the courage of the courageous.
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम्। धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ
transliteration: balaṃ balavatāṃ cāhaṃ kāmarāgavivarjitam, dharmāviruddho bhūteṣu kāmo'smi bharatarṣabha
hindi_meaning: हे भरतवंशियोंमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुन ! बलवालोंमें काम और रागसे रहित बल मैं हूँ। मनुषयोंमें धर्मसे अविरुद्ध (धर्मयुक्त) काम मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: And of the strong I am the strength which is devoid of passion and attachment. Among creatures I am desire which is not contrary to righteousness, O scion of the Bharata dyansty.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये। मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि नत्वहं तेषु ते मयि
transliteration: ye caiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasāstāmasāśca ye, matta eveti tānviddhi natvahaṃ teṣu te mayi
hindi_meaning: (और तो क्या कहूँ) जितने भी सात्त्विक, राजस और तामस भाव हैं, वे सब मुझ से ही होते हैं -- ऐसा समझो। पर मैं उनमें और वे मेरेमें नहीं हैं।
english_meaning: Those things that indeed are made of (the ality of ) sattva, and those things that are made of (the ality of) rajas and tamas, know them to have sprung from Me alone. However, I am not in them; they are in Me!
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत्। मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम्
transliteration: tribhirguṇamayairbhāvairebhiḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat, mohitaṃ nābhijānāti māmebhyaḥ paramavyayam
hindi_meaning: किन्तु - इन तीनों गुणरूप भावोंसे मोहित यह सब जगत् इन गुणोंसे अतीत अविनाशी मुझे नहीं जानता।
english_meaning: All this world, deluded as it is by these three things made of the gunas (alities), does not know Me who am transcendental to these and undecaying.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया। मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते
transliteration: daivī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā, māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāṃ taranti te
hindi_meaning: क्योंकि मेरी यह गुणमयी दैवी माया बड़ी दुरत्यय है अर्थात् इससे पार पाना बड़ा कठिन है। जो केवल मेरे ही शरण होते हैं, वे इस मायाको तर जाते हैं।
english_meaning: Since this divine Maya of Mine which is constituted by the gunas is difficult to cross over, (therefore) those who take refuge in Me alone cross over this Maya.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः। माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः
transliteration: na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ, māyayāpahṛtajñānā āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ
hindi_meaning: मायाके द्वारा अपहृत ज्ञानवाले, आसुर भावका आश्रय लेनेवाले और मनुष्योंमें महान् नीच तथा पाप-कर्म करनेवाले मूढ़ मनुष्य मेरे शरण नहीं होते।९
english_meaning: The foolish evildoers, who are the most depraved among men, who are deprived of (their) wisdom by Maya, and who resort to demoniacal ways, do not take refuge in Me.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन। आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ
transliteration: caturvidhā bhajante māṃ janāḥ sukṛtino'rjuna, ārto jijñāsurarthārthī jñānī ca bharatarṣabha
hindi_meaning: हे भरतवंशियोंमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुनव ! पवित्र कर्म करनेवाले अर्थार्थी, आर्त, जिज्ञासु और ज्ञानी अर्थात् प्रेमी -- ये चार प्रकारके मनुष्य मेरा भजन करते हैं अर्थात् मेरे शरण होते हैं।
english_meaning: O Arjuna, foremost of the Bharata dynasty, four classes of people of virtuous deeds adore Me: the afflicted, the seeker of Knowledge, the seeker of wealth and the man of Knowledge.
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्ितर्विशिष्यते। प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः
transliteration: teṣāṃ jñānī nityayukta ekabhakिtarviśiṣyate, priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ
hindi_meaning: उन चार भक्तोंमें मेरेमें निरन्तर लगा हुआ, अनन्यभक्तिवाला ज्ञानी अर्थात् प्रेमी भक्त श्रेष्ठ है; क्योंकि ज्ञानी भक्तको मैं अत्यन्त प्रिय हूँ और वह भी मेरेको अत्यन्त प्रिय है।
english_meaning: Of them, the man of Knowledge, endowed with constant steadfastness and one-pointed devotion, excels. For I am very much dear to the man of Knowledge, and he too is dear to Me.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम्। आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम्
transliteration: udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam, āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā māmevānuttamāṃ gatim
hindi_meaning: पहले कहे हुए सब-के-सब भक्त बड़े उदार (श्रेष्ठ भाववाले) हैं। परन्तु ज्ञानी (प्रेमी) तो मेरा स्वरूप ही है -- ऐसा मेरा मत है। कारण कि वह युक्तात्मा है और जिससे श्रेष्ठ दूसरी कोई गति नहीं है, ऐसे मेरेमें ही दृढ़ आस्थावाला है।
english_meaning: All of these, indeed, are noble, but the man of Knowledge is the very Self. (This is) My opinion. For, with a steadfast mind, he is set on the path leading to Me alone who am the super-excellent Goal.
practical_guidance: Sit quietly for five minutes. Ask: 'What is the most meaningful thing I can contribute?' Let the answer arise naturally, without forcing it.

sanskrit_text: बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते। वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः॥
transliteration: bahunam janmanam ante jnanavaan mam prapadyate, vasudevah sarvam iti sa mahatma su-durlabhah
hindi_meaning: अनेक जन्मों के अंत में ज्ञानी मुझे प्राप्त होता है — वासुदेव ही सब कुछ है — ऐसा जानकर वह मुझे प्राप्त होता है। ऐसा महात्मा अत्यंत दुर्लभ है।
english_meaning: After many births and deaths, one who is actually in knowledge surrenders unto Me, knowing Me to be the cause of all causes and all that is. Such a great soul is very rare.
practical_guidance: True wisdom is not accumulation of information but the lived recognition that everything around you — people, events, even difficulties — is an expression of the divine. Practice seeing God in the ordinary today: in a glass of water, in a stranger's face, in a difficult moment.

sanskrit_text: कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः। तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया
transliteration: kāmaistaistairhṛtajñānāḥ prapadyante'nyadevatāḥ, taṃ taṃ niyamamāsthāya prakṛtyā niyatāḥ svayā
hindi_meaning: उन-उन कामनाओंसे जिनका ज्ञान अपहृत हो गया है, ऐसे वे मनुष्य अपनी-अपनी प्रकृतिसे नियन्त्रित होकर (देवताओंके) उन-उन नियमोंको धारण करते हुए उन-उन देवताओंके शरण हो जाते हैं।
english_meaning: People, deprived of their wisdom by desires for various objects and guided by their own nature, resort to other deities following the relevant methods.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति। तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम्
transliteration: yo yo yāṃ yāṃ tanuṃ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitumicchati, tasya tasyācalāṃ śraddhāṃ tāmeva vidadhāmyaham
hindi_meaning: जो-जो भक्त जिस-जिस देवताका श्रद्धापूर्वक पूजन करना चाहता है, उस-उस देवताके प्रति मैं उसकी श्रद्धाको दृढ़ कर देता हूँ।
english_meaning: Whichever form (of a deity) any devotee wants to worship with faith, that very firm faith of his I strengthen.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते। लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान् हि तान्
transliteration: sa tayā śraddhayā yuktastasyārādhanamīhate, labhate ca tataḥ kāmānmayaiva vihitān hi tān
hindi_meaning: उस (मेरे द्वारा दृढ़ की हुई) श्रद्धासे युक्त होकर वह मनुष्य (सकामभावपूर्वक) उस देवताकी उपासना करता है और उसकी वह कामना पूरी भी होती है; परन्तु वह कामना-पूर्ति मेरे द्वारा विहित की हुई होती है।
english_meaning: Being imbued with that faith, that person engages in worshipping that form, and he gets those very desired results therefrom as they are dispensed by Me alone.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम्। देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि
transliteration: antavattu phalaṃ teṣāṃ tadbhavatyalpamedhasām, devāndevayajo yānti madbhaktā yānti māmapi
hindi_meaning: परन्तु उन अल्पबुद्धिवाले मनुष्योंको उन देवताओंकी आराधनाका फल अन्तवाला (नाशवान्) ही मिलता है। देवताओंका पूजन करनेवाले देवताओंको प्राप्त होते हैं और मेरे भक्त मेरे ही प्राप्त होते हैं।
english_meaning: That result of theirs who are of poor intellect is indeed limited. The worshippers of gods go to the gods. My devotees go to Me alone.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: अव्यक्तं व्यक्ितमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः। परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम्
transliteration: avyaktaṃ vyakिtamāpannaṃ manyante māmabuddhayaḥ, paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mamāvyayamanuttamam
hindi_meaning: बुद्धिहीन मनुष्य मेरे सर्वश्रेष्ठ अविनाशी परमभावको न जानते हुए अव्यक्त (मन-इन्द्रियोंसे पर) मुझ सच्चिदानन्दघन परमात्माको मनुष्यकी तरह ही शरीर धारण करनेवाला मानते हैं।
english_meaning: The unintelligent, unaware of My supreme state which is immutable and unsurpassable, think of Me as the unmanifest that has become manifest.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः। मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम्
transliteration: nāhaṃ prakāśaḥ sarvasya yogamāyāsamāvṛtaḥ, mūḍho'yaṃ nābhijānāti loko māmajamavyayam
hindi_meaning: जो मूढ़ मनुष्य मेरेको अज और अविनाशी ठीक तरहसे नहीं जानते (मानते), उन सबके सामने योगमायासे अच्छी तरहसे आवृत हुआ मैं प्रकट नहीं होता।
english_meaning: Being enveloped by yoga-maya, I do not become manifest to all. This deluded world does not know Me who am birthless and undecaying.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन। भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन
transliteration: vedāhaṃ samatītāni vartamānāni cārjuna, bhaviṣyāṇi ca bhūtāni māṃ tu veda na kaścana
hindi_meaning: हे अर्जुन ! जो प्राणी भूतकालमें हो चुके हैं, तथा जो वर्तमानमें हैं और जो भविष्यमें होंगे, उन सब प्राणियोंको तो मैं जानता हूँ; परन्तु मेरेको कोई (मूढ़ मनुष्य) नहीं जानता।
english_meaning: O Arjuna, I know the past and the present as also the future beings; but no one knows Me!
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत। सर्वभूतानि संमोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप
transliteration: icchādveṣasamutthena dvandvamohena bhārata, sarvabhūtāni saṃmohaṃ sarge yānti parantapa
hindi_meaning: हे भरतवंशमें उत्पन्न परंतप ! इच्छा (राग) और द्वेषसे उत्पन्न होनेवाले द्वन्द्व-मोहसे मोहित सम्पूर्ण प्राणी संसारमें मूढ़ताको अर्थात् जन्म-मरणको प्राप्त हो रहे हैं।
english_meaning: O scion of the Bharata dynasty, O destroyer of foes, due to the delusion of duality arising from likes and dislikes, all creatures become bewildered at the time of their birth.
practical_guidance: You cannot undo the past, only respond to it now. Forgive yourself as you would a dear friend who made a mistake. Then take one right action today.

sanskrit_text: येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम्। ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः
transliteration: yeṣāṃ tvantagataṃ pāpaṃ janānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām, te dvandvamohanirmuktā bhajante māṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ
hindi_meaning: परन्तु जिन पुण्यकर्मा मनुष्योंके पाप नष्ट गये हैं, वे द्वन्द्वमोहसे रहित हुए मनुष्य दृढ़व्रती होकर मेरा भजन करते हैं।
english_meaning: On the other hand, those persons who are of virtuous deeds, whose sin has come to an end, they, being free from the delusion of dulaity and firm in their convictions, adore Me.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये। ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम्
transliteration: jarāmaraṇamokṣāya māmāśritya yatanti ye, te brahma tadviduḥ kṛtsnamadhyātmaṃ karma cākhilam
hindi_meaning: जरा (वृद्धावस्था) और मरण (मृत्यु) से मोक्ष पानेके लिये जो मेरा आश्रय लेकर प्रयत्न करते हैं, वे उस ब्रह्मको, सम्पूर्ण अध्यात्मको और सम्पूर्ण कर्मको भी जान जाते हैं।
english_meaning: Those who strive by resorting to Me for becoming free from old age and death, they know that Brahman, everything about the individual Self, and all about actions. [They know Brahman as being all the individual entities and all actions. This verse prescribes meditation on the alified Brahman for aspirants of the middle class. Verses beginning with the 14the speak about the reaization of the unalified Brahman by aspirants of the highest class.]
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः। प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः
transliteration: sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ māṃ sādhiyajñaṃ ca ye viduḥ, prayāṇakāle'pi ca māṃ te viduryuktacetasaḥ
hindi_meaning: जो मनुष्य अधिभूत, अधिदैव और अधियज्ञके सहित मुझे जानते हैं, वे युक्तचेता मनुष्य अन्तकालमें भी मुझे ही जानते हैं अर्थात् प्राप्त होते हैं।
english_meaning: Those who know me as existing in the physical and the divine planes, and also in the context of the sacrifice, they of concentrated minds know Me even at the time of death.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: किं तद्ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम। अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते
transliteration: kiṃ tadbrahma kimadhyātmaṃ kiṃ karma puruṣottama, adhibhūtaṃ ca kiṃ proktamadhidaivaṃ kimucyate
hindi_meaning: -- 8.2।। अर्जुन बोले -- हे पुरुषोत्तम ! वह ब्रह्म क्या है? अध्यात्म क्या है? कर्म क्या है? अधिभूत किसको कहा गया है? और अधिदैव किसको कहा जाता है? यहाँ अधियज्ञ कौन है और वह इस देहमें कैसे है? हे मधूसूदन ! नियतात्मा (वशीभूत अंतःकरण वाले) मनुष्यके द्वारा अन्तकालमें आप कैसे जाननेमें आते हैं?
english_meaning: Arjuna said O supreme person, what is that Brahman? What is that which exists in the individual plane? What is action? And what is that which is said to exist in the physical plane? What is that which is said to be existing in the divine plane?
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन। प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः
transliteration: adhiyajñaḥ kathaṃ ko'tra dehe'sminmadhusūdana, prayāṇakāle ca kathaṃ jñeyo'si niyatātmabhiḥ
hindi_meaning: -- 8.2।। अर्जुन बोले -- हे पुरुषोत्तम ! वह ब्रह्म क्या है? अध्यात्म क्या है? कर्म क्या है? अधिभूत किसको कहा गया है? और अधिदैव किसको कहा जाता है? यहाँ अधियज्ञ कौन है और वह इस देहमें कैसे है? हे मधूसूदन ! नियतात्मा (वशीभूत अन्तःकरणवाले) मनुष्यके द्वारा अन्तकालमें आप कैसे जाननेमें आते हैं?
english_meaning: O Madhusudana, how, and who, is the entity existing in the sacrifice here in this body? And at the time of death, how are You to be known by people of concentrated minds?
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते। भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः
transliteration: akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ svabhāvo'dhyātmamucyate, bhūtabhāvodbhavakaro visargaḥ karmasaṃjñitaḥ
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले -- परम अक्षर ब्रह्म है और जीवका अपना जो होनापन है, उसको अध्यात्म कहते हैं। प्राणियों का उद्भव (सत्ता को प्रकट) करनेवाला जो त्याग है उसको कर्म कहा जाता है।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said The Immutable is the supreme Brahman; self-hood is said to the entity present in the individual plane. By action is meant the offerings which bring about the origin of the existence of things.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम्। अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर
transliteration: adhibhūtaṃ kṣaro bhāvaḥ puruṣaścādhidaivatam, adhiyajño'hamevātra dehe dehabhṛtāṃ vara
hindi_meaning: हे देहधारियोंमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुन ! क्षरभाव अर्थात् नाशवान् पदार्थको अधिभूत कहते हैं, पुरुष अर्थात् हिरण्यगर्भ ब्रह्माजी अधिदैव हैं और इस देहमें अन्तर्यामीरूपसे मैं ही अधियज्ञ हूँ।
english_meaning: The which exists in the physical plane is the mutable entity, and what exists in the divine plane is the Person. O best among the embodied beings, I Myself am the entity that exists in the sacrifice in this body.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.
