sanskrit_text: अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम्। यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः
transliteration: antakāle ca māmeva smaranmuktvā kalevaram, yaḥ prayāti sa madbhāvaṃ yāti nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ
hindi_meaning: जो मनुष्य अन्तकालमें भी मेरा स्मरण करते हुए शरीर छोड़कर जाता है, वह मेरे स्वरुप को ही प्राप्त होता है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है।
english_meaning: And at the time of death, anyone who departs by giving up the body while thinking of Me alone, he attains My state. There is no doubt about this.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम्। तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः
transliteration: yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaranbhāvaṃ tyajatyante kalevaram, taṃ tamevaiti kaunteya sadā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ
hindi_meaning: हे कुन्तीपुत्र अर्जुन ! मनुष्य अन्तकाल में जिस-जिस भी भावका स्मरण करते हुए शरीर छोड़ता है वह उस (अन्तकालके) भावसे सदा भावित होता हुआ उस-उसको ही प्राप्त होता है अर्थात् उस-उस योनिमें ही चला जाता है।
english_meaning: O son of Kunti, thinking of any entity whichever it may be one gives up the body at the end, he attains that very one, having been always engrossed in its thought.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च। मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयम्
transliteration: tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu māmanusmara yudhya ca, mayyarpitamanobuddhirmāmevaiṣyasyasaṃśayam
hindi_meaning: इसलिये तू सब समयमें मेरा स्मरण कर और युद्ध भी कर। मेरेमें मन और बुद्धि अर्पित करनेवाला तू निःसन्देह मेरेको ही प्राप्त होगा।
english_meaning: Therefore, think of Me at all times and fight. There is no doubt that by dedicating your mind and intellect to Me, you will attain Me alone.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना। परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन्
transliteration: abhyāsayogayuktena cetasā nānyagāminā, paramaṃ puruṣaṃ divyaṃ yāti pārthānucintayan
hindi_meaning: हे पृथानन्दन ! अभ्यासयोगसे युक्त और अन्यका चिन्तन न करनेवाले चित्तसे परम दिव्य पुरुषका चिन्तन करता हुआ (शरीर छोड़नेवाला मनुष्य) उसीको प्राप्त हो जाता है।
english_meaning: O son of Prtha, by meditating with a mind which is engaged in the yoga of practice and which does not stray away to anything else, one reaches the supreme Person existing in the effulgent region.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: कविं पुराणमनुशासितार मणोरणीयांसमनुस्मरेद्यः। सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूप मादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात्
transliteration: kaviṃ purāṇamanuśāsitāra maṇoraṇīyāṃsamanusmaredyaḥ, sarvasya dhātāramacintyarūpa mādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt
hindi_meaning: जो सर्वज्ञ, पुराण, शासन करनेवाला, सूक्ष्म-से-सूक्ष्म, सबका धारण-पोषण करनेवाला, अज्ञानसे अत्यन्त परे, सूर्यकी तरह प्रकाशस्वरूप -- ऐसे अचिन्त्य स्वरूपका चिन्तन करता है।
english_meaning: He who meditates on the Omniscient, the Anceint, the Ruler, subtler than the subtle, the Ordainer of everything, of inconceivable form, effulgent like the sun, and beyond darkness-(he attains the supreme Person).
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: प्रयाणकाले मनसाऽचलेन भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव। भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक् स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम्
transliteration: prayāṇakāle manasā'calena bhaktyā yukto yogabalena caiva, bhruvormadhye prāṇamāveśya samyak sa taṃ paraṃ puruṣamupaiti divyam
hindi_meaning: वह भक्तियुक्त मनुष्य अन्तसमयमें अचल मनसे और योगबलके द्वारा भृकुटीके मध्यमें प्राणोंको अच्छी तरहसे प्रविष्ट करके (शरीर छोड़नेपर) उस परम दिव्य पुरुषको ही प्राप्त होता है।
english_meaning: At the time of death, having fully fixed the Prana (vita force) between the en rows with an unswering mind, and being imbued with devotion as also the strength of concentration, he reaches that resplendent supreme person.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः। यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति तत्ते पदं संग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये
transliteration: yadakṣaraṃ vedavido vadanti viśanti yadyatayo vītarāgāḥ, yadicchanto brahmacaryaṃ caranti tatte padaṃ saṃgraheṇa pravakṣye
hindi_meaning: वेदवेत्ता लोग जिसको अक्षर कहते हैं, वीतराग यति जिसको प्राप्त करते हैं और साधक जिसकी प्राप्तिकी इच्छा करते हुए ब्रह्मचर्यका पालन करते हैं, वह पद मैं तेरे लिये संक्षेपसे कहूँगा।
english_meaning: I shall speak to you briefly of that immutable Goal which the knowers of the Vedas declare, into which enter the deligent ones free from attachment, and aspiring for which people practise celibacy.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च। मूर्ध्न्याधायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणाम्
transliteration: sarvadvārāṇi saṃyamya mano hṛdi nirudhya ca, mūrdhnyādhāyātmanaḥ prāṇamāsthito yogadhāraṇām
hindi_meaning: -- 8.13।। (इन्द्रियोंके) सम्पूर्ण द्वारोंको रोककर मनका हृदयमें निरोध करके और अपने प्राणोंको मस्तकमें स्थापित करके योगधारणामें सम्यक् प्रकारसे स्थित हुआ जो 'ऊँ' इस एक अक्षर ब्रह्मका उच्चारण और मेरा स्मरण करता हुआ शरीरको छोड़कर जाता है, वह परमगतिको प्राप्त होता है।
english_meaning: Having controlled all the passages, having confined the mind in the heart, and having fixed his own vital force in the head, (and then) continuing in the firmness in yoga;
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन्। यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम्
transliteration: omityekākṣaraṃ brahma vyāharanmāmanusmaran, yaḥ prayāti tyajandehaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
hindi_meaning: -- 8.13।। (इन्द्रियोंके) सम्पूर्ण द्वारोंको रोककर मनका हृदयमें निरोध करके और अपने प्राणोंको मस्तकमें स्थापित करके योगधारणामें सम्यक् प्रकारसे स्थित हुआ जो साधक 'ऊँ' इस एक अक्षर ब्रह्मका उच्चारण और मेरा स्मरण करता हुआ शरीरको छोड़कर जाता है, वह परमगतिको प्राप्त होता है।
english_meaning: He who departs by leaving the body while uttering the single syllable, viz Om, which is Brahman, and thinking of Me, he attains the supreme Goal.
practical_guidance: Sit quietly for five minutes. Ask: 'What is the most meaningful thing I can contribute?' Let the answer arise naturally, without forcing it.

sanskrit_text: अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः। तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः
transliteration: ananyacetāḥ satataṃ yo māṃ smarati nityaśaḥ, tasyāhaṃ sulabhaḥ pārtha nityayuktasya yoginaḥ
hindi_meaning: हे पृथानन्दन ! अनन्यचित्तवाला जो मनुष्य मेरा नित्य-निरन्तर स्मरण करता है, उस नित्ययुक्त योगीके लिये मैं सुलभ हूँ अर्थात् उसको सुलभतासे प्राप्त हो जाता हूँ।
english_meaning: O son of Prtha, to that yogi of constant concentration and single-minded attention, who remembers Me uninterruptedly and for long, I am easy of attainment.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम्। नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः
transliteration: māmupetya punarjanma duḥkhālayamaśāśvatam, nāpnuvanti mahātmānaḥ saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ
hindi_meaning: महात्मालोग मुझे प्राप्त करके दुःखालय और अशाश्वत पुनर्जन्मको प्राप्त नहीं होते; क्योंकि वे परमसिद्धिको प्राप्त हो गये हैं अर्थात् उनको परम प्रेमकी प्राप्ति हो गयी है।
english_meaning: As a result of reaching Me, the exalted ones who have attained the highest perfection do not get r irth which is an abode of sorrows and which is impermanent.
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन। मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते
transliteration: ābrahmabhuvanāllokāḥ punarāvartino'rjuna, māmupetya tu kaunteya punarjanma na vidyate
hindi_meaning: हे अर्जुन ! ब्रह्मलोकतक सभी लोक पुनरावर्ती है; परन्तु हे कौन्तेय ! मुझे प्राप्त होनेपर पुनर्जन्म नहीं होता।
english_meaning: O Arjuna, all the worlds together with the world of Brahma are subject to return. But, O son of Kunti, there is no r irth after reaching Me.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद्ब्रह्मणो विदुः। रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः
transliteration: sahasrayugaparyantamaharyadbrahmaṇo viduḥ, rātriṃ yugasahasrāntāṃ te'horātravido janāḥ
hindi_meaning: जो मनुष्य ब्रह्माके एक हज़ार चतुर्युगीवाले एक दिनको और सहस्त्र चतुर्युगीपर्यन्त एक रातको जानते हैं, वे मनुष्य ब्रह्माके दिन और रातको जाननेवाले हैं।
english_meaning: Those poeple who are knowers of what day and night are, know the day of Brahma which ends in a thousand yugas [The four yugas (in the human worlds), viz Satya, Treta, Dwapara, and Kali are made up of 4,320,000 years. This period multiplied by a thousand constitutes one day of Brahma. His night also extends over an eal period. See M.S. and V.S.A.], and His night which ends in a thousand yugas.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: अव्यक्ताद्व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहरागमे। रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके
transliteration: avyaktādvyaktayaḥ sarvāḥ prabhavantyaharāgame, rātryāgame pralīyante tatraivāvyaktasaṃjñake
hindi_meaning: ब्रह्माजीके दिनके आरम्भकालमें अव्यक्त- (ब्रह्माजीके सूक्ष्म-शरीर-) से सम्पूर्ण प्राणी पैदा होते हैं और ब्रह्माजीकी रातके आरम्भकालमें उसी अव्यक्तमें सम्पूर्ण प्राणी लीन हो जाते हैं।
english_meaning: With the coming of day all manifested things emerge from the Unmanifest and when night comes they merge in that itself which is called the Unmanifested.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते। रात्र्यागमेऽवशः पार्थ प्रभवत्यहरागमे
transliteration: bhūtagrāmaḥ sa evāyaṃ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate, rātryāgame'vaśaḥ pārtha prabhavatyaharāgame
hindi_meaning: हे पार्थ ! वही यह प्राणिसमुदाय उत्पन्न हो-होकर प्रकृतिके परवश हुआ ब्रह्माके दिनके समय उत्पन्न होता है और ब्रह्माकी रात्रिके समय लीन होता है।
english_meaning: O son of Prtha, after being born again and again, that very multitude of beings disappears in spite of itself at the approach of night. It comes to life at the approach of day.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तोऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः। यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति
transliteration: parastasmāttu bhāvo'nyo'vyakto'vyaktātsanātanaḥ, yaḥ sa sarveṣu bhūteṣu naśyatsu na vinaśyati
hindi_meaning: परन्तु उस अव्यक्त- (ब्रह्माजीके सूक्ष्म-शरीर-) से अन्य अनादि सर्वश्रेष्ठ भावरूप जो अव्यक्त है, उसका सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके नष्ट होनेपर भी नाश नहीं होता।
english_meaning: But distinct from that Unmanifested is the other eternal unmainfest Reality, who does not get destroyed when all beings get destroyed.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम्। यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम
transliteration: avyakto'kṣara ityuktastamāhuḥ paramāṃ gatim, yaṃ prāpya na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama
hindi_meaning: उसीको अव्यक्त और अक्षर कहा गया है और उसीको परमगति कहा गया है तथा जिसको प्राप्त होनेपर जीव फिर लौटकर नहीं आते, वह मेरा परमधाम है।
english_meaning: He who has been mentioned as the Unmanifested, the Immutable, they call Him the supreme Goal. That is the supreme abode of Mine, reaching which they do not return.
practical_guidance: Sit quietly for five minutes. Ask: 'What is the most meaningful thing I can contribute?' Let the answer arise naturally, without forcing it.

sanskrit_text: पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया। यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम्
transliteration: puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyastvananyayā, yasyāntaḥsthāni bhūtāni yena sarvamidaṃ tatam
hindi_meaning: हे पृथानन्दन अर्जुन ! सम्पूर्ण प्राणी जिसके अन्तर्गत हैं और जिससे यह सम्पूर्ण संसार व्याप्त है, वह परम पुरुष परमात्मा तो अनन्यभक्तिसे प्राप्त होनेयोग्य है।
english_meaning: O son of Prtha, that supreme Person-in whom are included (all) the beings and by whom all this is pervaded-is, indeed, reached through one-pointed devotion.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः। प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ
transliteration: yatra kāle tvanāvṛttimāvṛttiṃ caiva yoginaḥ, prayātā yānti taṃ kālaṃ vakṣyāmi bharatarṣabha
hindi_meaning: हे भरतवंशियोंमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुन ! जिस काल अर्थात् मार्गमें शरीर छोड़कर गये हुए योगी अनावृत्तिको प्राप्त होते हैं अर्थात् पीछे लौटकर नहीं आते और (जिस मार्गमें गये हुए) आवृत्तिको प्राप्त होते हैं अर्थात् पीछे लौटकर आते हैं, उस कालको अर्थात् दोनों मार्गोंको मैं कहूँगा।
english_meaning: O best of the Bharata dynasty, I shall now speak of that time by departing at which the yogis attain the State of Non-return, and also (of the time by departing at which they attain) the State of Return.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: अग्निर्ज्योतिरहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम्। तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः
transliteration: agnirjyotirahaḥ śuklaḥ ṣaṇmāsā uttarāyaṇam, tatra prayātā gacchanti brahma brahmavido janāḥ
hindi_meaning: जिस मार्गमें प्रकाशस्वरूप अग्निका अधिपति देवता, दिनका अधिपति देवता, शुक्लपक्षका अधिपति देवता, और छः महीनोंवाले उत्तरायणका अधिपति देवता है, शरीर छोड़कर उस मार्गसे गये हुए ब्रह्मवेत्ता पुरुष (पहले ब्रह्मलोकको प्राप्त होकर पीछे ब्रह्माजीके साथ) ब्रह्मको प्राप्त हो जाते हैं।
english_meaning: Fire, light, daytime, the birght forrnight, the six months of the Northern solstice-by following this Path, persons who are knowers of Brahman attain Brahman when they die.
practical_guidance: Sit quietly for five minutes. Ask: 'What is the most meaningful thing I can contribute?' Let the answer arise naturally, without forcing it.

sanskrit_text: धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम्। तत्र चान्द्रमसं ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्तते
transliteration: dhūmo rātristathā kṛṣṇaḥ ṣaṇmāsā dakṣiṇāyanam, tatra cāndramasaṃ jyotiryogī prāpya nivartate
hindi_meaning: जिस मार्गमें धूमका अधिपति देवता, रात्रिका अधिपति देवता, कृष्णपक्षका अधिपति देवता और छः महीनोंवाले दक्षिणायनका अधिपति देवता है, शरीर छोड़कर उस मार्गसे गया हुआ योगी (सकाम मनुष्य) चन्द्रमाकी ज्योतिको प्राप्त होकर लौट आता है अर्थात् जन्म-मरणको प्राप्त होता है।
english_meaning: Smoke, night, as also the dark fortnight and the six months of the Southern solstice-following this Path the yogi having reached the lunar light, returns.
practical_guidance: Sit quietly for five minutes. Ask: 'What is the most meaningful thing I can contribute?' Let the answer arise naturally, without forcing it.

sanskrit_text: शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते। एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययाऽऽवर्तते पुनः
transliteration: śuklakṛṣṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śāśvate mate, ekayā yātyanāvṛttimanyayā''vartate punaḥ
hindi_meaning: क्योंकि शुक्ल और कृष्ण -- ये दोनों गतियाँ अनादिकालसे जगत्-(प्राणिमात्र-) के साथ सम्बन्ध रखनेवाली मानी गई हैं। इनमेंसे एक गतिमें जानेवालेको लौटना नहीं पड़ता और दूसरी गतिमें जानेवालेको लौटना पड़ता है।
english_meaning: These two courses of the world, which are white and black, are verily considered eternal. By the one a man goes to the State of Non-return; by the other he returns again.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन। तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगयुक्तो भवार्जुन
transliteration: naite sṛtī pārtha jānanyogī muhyati kaścana, tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu yogayukto bhavārjuna
hindi_meaning: हे पृथानन्दन ! इन दोनों मार्गोंको जाननेवाला कोई भी योगी मोहित नहीं होता। अतः हे अर्जुन ! तू सब समयमें योगयुक्त हो जा।
english_meaning: O son of Prtha, no yogi [One steadfast in meditation.) whosoever has known these two courses becomes deluded. Therefore, O Arjuna, be you steadfast in yoga at all times.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव दानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम्। अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम्
transliteration: vedeṣu yajñeṣu tapaḥsu caiva dāneṣu yatpuṇyaphalaṃ pradiṣṭam, atyeti tatsarvamidaṃ viditvā yogī paraṃ sthānamupaiti cādyam
hindi_meaning: योगी इसको (शुक्ल और कृष्णमार्गके रहस्यको) जानकर वेदोंमें, यज्ञोंमें, तपोंमें तथा दानमें जो-जो पुण्यफल कहे गये हैं, उन सभी पुण्यफलोंका अतिक्रमण कर जाता है और आदिस्थान परमात्माको प्राप्त हो जाता है।
english_meaning: Having known this, the yogi transcends all those results of rigtheous deeds that are declared with regard to the Vedas, sacrifices, austerities and also charities, and he reaches the primordial supreme State.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे। ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात्
transliteration: idaṃ tu te guhyatamaṃ pravakṣyāmyanasūyave, jñānaṃ vijñānasahitaṃ yajjñātvā mokṣyase'śubhāt
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले -- यह अत्यन्त गोपनीय विज्ञानसहित ज्ञान दोषदृष्टिरहित तेरे लिये तो मैं फिर अच्छी तरहसे कहूँगा, जिसको जानकर तू अशुभसे अर्थात् जन्म-मरणरूप संसारसे मुक्त हो जायगा।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said However, to you who are not given to cavilling I shall speak of this highest secret itself, which is Knowledge [Jnana may mean Brahman that is Consciousness, or Its knowledge gathered from the Vedas (paroksa-jnana). Vijnana is direct experience (aparoksa-jnana).] combined with experience, by realizing which you shall be free from evil.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: राजविद्या राजगुह्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम्। प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमव्ययम्
transliteration: rājavidyā rājaguhyaṃ pavitramidamuttamam, pratyakṣāvagamaṃ dharmyaṃ susukhaṃ kartumavyayam
hindi_meaning: यह सम्पूर्ण विद्याओंका और सम्पूर्ण गोपनीयोंका राजा है। यह अति पवित्र तथा अतिश्रेष्ठ है और इसका फल भी प्रत्यक्ष है। यह धर्ममय है, अविनाशी है और करनेमें बहुत सुगम है अर्थात् इसको प्राप्त करना बहुत सुगम है।
english_meaning: This is the Sovereign Knowledge, the Sovereign Profundity, the best sanctifire; directly realizable, righteous, very easy to practise and imperishable.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप। अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि
transliteration: aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā dharmasyāsya parantapa, aprāpya māṃ nivartante mṛtyusaṃsāravartmani
hindi_meaning: हे परंतप! इस धर्मकी महिमापर श्रद्धा न रखनेवाले मनुष्य मेरे प्राप्त न होकर मृत्युरूप संसारके मार्गमें लौटते रहते हैं अर्थात् बार-बार जन्मते-मरते रहते हैं।
english_meaning: O destroyer of foes, persons who are regardless of this Dharma (knowledge of the Self) certainly go round and round, without reaching Me, along the path of transmigration which is fraught with death.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना। मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्ववस्थितः
transliteration: mayā tatamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagadavyaktamūrtinā, matsthāni sarvabhūtāni na cāhaṃ teṣvavasthitaḥ
hindi_meaning: -- 9.5।। यह सब संसार मेरे निराकार स्वरूपसे व्याप्त है। सम्पूर्ण प्राणी मेरेमें स्थित हैं; परन्तु मैं उनमें स्थित नहीं हूँ तथा वे प्राणी भी मुझ में स्थित नहीं हैं -- मेरे इस ईश्वर-सम्बन्धी योग-(सामर्थ्य-) को देख ! सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंको उत्पन्न करनेवाला और उनका धारण, भरण-पोषण करनेवाला मेरा स्वरूप उन प्राणियोंमें स्थित नहीं है।
english_meaning: This whole world is prevaded by Me in My unmanifest form. All beings exist in Me, but I am not contained in them!
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्। भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः
transliteration: na ca matsthāni bhūtāni paśya me yogamaiśvaram, bhūtabhṛnna ca bhūtastho mamātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ
hindi_meaning: -- 9.5।। यह सब संसार मेरे निराकार स्वरूपसे व्याप्त है। सम्पूर्ण प्राणी मुझ में स्थित हैं; परन्तु मैं उनमें स्थित नहीं हूँ तथा वे प्राणी भी मेरेमें स्थित नहीं हैं -- मेरे इस ईश्वर-सम्बन्धी योग-(सामर्थ्य-) को देख ! सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंको उत्पन्न करनेवाला और उनका धारण, भरण-पोषण करनेवाला मेरा स्वरूप उन प्राणियोंमें स्थित नहीं है।
english_meaning: Nor do the beings dwell in Me. Behod My divine Yoga! I am the sustainer and originator of beings, but My Self is not contained in the beings.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: यथाऽऽकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान्। तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय
transliteration: yathā''kāśasthito nityaṃ vāyuḥ sarvatrago mahān, tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni matsthānītyupadhāraya
hindi_meaning: जैसे सब जगह विचरनेवाली महान् वायु नित्य ही आकाशमें स्थित रहती है, ऐसे ही सम्पूर्ण प्राणी मुझमें ही स्थित रहते हैं -- ऐसा तुम मान लो।
english_meaning: Understand thus that just as the voluminous wind moving everywhere is ever present in space, similarly all beings abide in Me.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम्। कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम्
transliteration: sarvabhūtāni kaunteya prakṛtiṃ yānti māmikām, kalpakṣaye punastāni kalpādau visṛjāmyaham
hindi_meaning: हे कुन्तीनन्दन ! कल्पोंका क्षय होनेपर सम्पूर्ण प्राणी मेरी प्रकृतिको प्राप्त होते हैं और कल्पोंके आदिमें मैं फिर उनकी रचना करता हूँ।
english_meaning: O son Kunti, all the beings go back at the end of a cycle to My Prakrti. I project them forth again at the beginning of a cycle.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः। भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात्
transliteration: prakṛtiṃ svāmavaṣṭabhya visṛjāmi punaḥ punaḥ, bhūtagrāmamimaṃ kṛtsnamavaśaṃ prakṛtervaśāt
hindi_meaning: प्रकृतिके वशमें होनेसे परतन्त्र हुए इस सम्पूर्ण प्राणिसमुदायको मैं (कल्पोंके आदिमें) अपनी प्रकृतिको वशमें करके बार-बार रचता हूँ।
english_meaning: Keeping My own prakrti under control, I project forth again and again the whole of this multitude of beings which are powerless owing to the influence of (their own) nature.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय। उदासीनवदासीनमसक्तं तेषु कर्मसु
transliteration: na ca māṃ tāni karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya, udāsīnavadāsīnamasaktaṃ teṣu karmasu
hindi_meaning: हे धनञ्जय ! उन (सृष्टि-रचना आदि) कर्मोंमें अनासक्त और उदासीनकी तरह रहते हुए मेरेको वे कर्म नहीं बाँधते।
english_meaning: O Dhananjaya (Arjuna), nor do those actions bind Me, remaining (as I do) like one unconcerned with, and unattached to, those actions.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: मयाऽध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम्। हेतुनाऽनेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते
transliteration: mayā'dhyakṣeṇa prakṛtiḥ sūyate sacarācaram, hetunā'nena kaunteya jagadviparivartate
hindi_meaning: प्रकृति मेरी अध्यक्षतामें सम्पूर्ण चराचर जगत् को रचती है। हे कुन्तीनन्दन ! इसी हेतुसे जगत् का विविध प्रकारसे परिवर्तन होता है।
english_meaning: Under Me as the supervisor, the Prakrti produces (the world) of the moving and the non-moving things. Owing to this reason, O son of Kunti, the world revolves.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम्। परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम्
transliteration: avajānanti māṃ mūḍhā mānuṣīṃ tanumāśritam, paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mama bhūtamaheśvaram
hindi_meaning: मूर्खलोग मेरे सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके महान् ईश्वररूप परमभावको न जानते हुए मुझे मनुष्यशरीरके आश्रित मानकर अर्थात् साधारण मनुष्य मानकर मेरी अवज्ञा करते हैं।
english_meaning: Not knowing My supreme nature as the Lord of all beings, foolish people disregard Me who have taken a human body.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः। राक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः
transliteration: moghāśā moghakarmāṇo moghajñānā vicetasaḥ, rākṣasīmāsurīṃ caiva prakṛtiṃ mohinīṃ śritāḥ
hindi_meaning: जिनकी सब आशाएँ व्यर्थ होती हैं, सब शुभ-कर्म व्यर्थ होते हैं और सब ज्ञान व्यर्थ होते हैं अर्थात् जिनकी आशाएँ, कर्म और ज्ञान सत्-फल देनेवाले नहीं होते, ऐसे अविवेकी मनुष्य आसुरी, राक्षसी और मोहिनी फकृतिका आश्रय लेते हैं।
english_meaning: Of vain hopes, of vain actions, of vain knowledge, and senseless, they become verily possessed of the deceptive disposition of fiends and demons.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः। भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम्
transliteration: mahātmānastu māṃ pārtha daivīṃ prakṛtimāśritāḥ, bhajantyananyamanaso jñātvā bhūtādimavyayam
hindi_meaning: परन्तु हे पृथानन्दन ! दैवी प्रकृतिके आश्रित अनन्यमनवाले महात्मालोग मुझे सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंका आदि और अविनाशी समझकर मेरा भजन करते हैं।
english_meaning: O son of Prtha, the noble ones, being possessed of divine nature, surely adore Me with single-mindedness, knowing Me as the immutable source of all objects.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः। नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते
transliteration: satataṃ kīrtayanto māṃ yatantaśca dṛḍhavratāḥ, namasyantaśca māṃ bhaktyā nityayuktā upāsate
hindi_meaning: नित्य- (मेरेमें) युक्त मनुष्य दृढ़व्रती होकर लगनपूर्वक साधनमें लगे हुए और भक्तिपूर्वक कीर्तन करते हुए तथा नमस्कार करते हुये निरन्तर मेरी उपासना करते हैं।
english_meaning: Always glorifying Me and striving, the men of firm vows worship Me by paying obeisance to Me and being ever endowed with devotion.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते। एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम्
transliteration: jñānayajñena cāpyanye yajanto māmupāsate, ekatvena pṛthaktvena bahudhā viśvatomukham
hindi_meaning: दूसरे साधक ज्ञानयज्ञके द्वारा एकीभावसे (अभेद-भावसे) मेरा पूजन करते हुए मेरी उपासना करते हैं और दूसरे कई साधक अपनेको पृथक् मानकर चारों तरफ मुखवाले मेरे विराट्ररुपकी अर्थात् संसारको मेरा विराट्ररुप मानकर (सेव्य-सेवकभावसे) मेरी अनेक प्रकारसे उपासना करते हैं।
english_meaning: Others verily worship Me by adoring exclusively through the sacrifice of the knowledge of oneness; (others worship Me) multifariously, and (others) as the multiformed existing variously.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाऽहमहमौषधम्। मंत्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम्
transliteration: ahaṃ kraturahaṃ yajñaḥ svadhā'hamahamauṣadham, maṃtro'hamahamevājyamahamagnirahaṃ hutam
hindi_meaning: -- 9.18।। क्रतु मैं हूँ, यज्ञ मैं हूँ, स्वधा मैं हूँ, औषध मैं हूँ, मन्त्र मैं हूँ, घृत मैं हूँ, अग्नि मैं हूँ और हवनरूप क्रिया भी मैं हूँ। जाननेयोग्य पवित्र, ओंकार, ऋग्वेद, सामवेद और यजुर्वेद भी मैं ही हूँ। इस सम्पूर्ण जगत्का पिता, धाता, माता, पितामह, गति, भर्ता, प्रभु, साक्षी, निवास, आश्रय, सुहृद्, उत्पत्ति, प्रलय, स्थान, निधान तथा अविनाशी बीज भी मैं ही हूँ।
english_meaning: I am the kratu, I am the yajna, I am the svadha, I am the ausadha, I am the mantra, I Myself am the ajya, I am the fire, and I am the act of offering.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: पिताऽहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः। वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक् साम यजुरेव च
transliteration: pitā'hamasya jagato mātā dhātā pitāmahaḥ, vedyaṃ pavitramoṃkāra ṛk sāma yajureva ca
hindi_meaning: -- 9.18।। क्रतु मैं हूँ, यज्ञ मैं हूँ, स्वधा मैं हूँ, औषध मैं हूँ, मन्त्र मैं हूँ, घृत मैं हूँ, अग्नि मैं हूँ और हवनरूप क्रिया भी मैं हूँ। जाननेयोग्य पवित्र, ओंकार, ऋग्वेद, सामवेद और यजुर्वेद भी मैं ही हूँ। इस सम्पूर्ण जगत् का पिता, धाता, माता, पितामह, गति, भर्ता, प्रभु, साक्षी, निवास, आश्रय, सुहृद्, उत्पत्ति, प्रलय, स्थान, निधान तथा अविनाशी बीज भी मैं ही हूँ।
english_meaning: Of this world I am the father, mother, ordainer, (and the), grand-father; I am the knowable, the sancitifier, the syllable Om as also Rk, Sama and Yajus.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत्। प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम्
transliteration: gatirbhartā prabhuḥ sākṣī nivāsaḥ śaraṇaṃ suhṛt, prabhavaḥ pralayaḥ sthānaṃ nidhānaṃ bījamavyayam
hindi_meaning: -- 9.18।। क्रतु मैं हूँ, यज्ञ मैं हूँ, स्वधा मैं हूँ, औषध मैं हूँ, मन्त्र मैं हूँ, घृत मैं हूँ, अग्नि मैं हूँ और हवनरूप क्रिया भी मैं हूँ। जाननेयोग्य पवित्र, ओंकार, ऋग्वेद, सामवेद और यजुर्वेद भी मैं ही हूँ। इस सम्पूर्ण जगत्का पिता, धाता, माता, पितामह, गति, भर्ता, प्रभु, साक्षी, निवास, आश्रय, सुहृद्, उत्पत्ति, प्रलय, स्थान, निधान तथा अविनाशी बीज भी मैं ही हूँ।
english_meaning: (I am) the fruit of actions, the nourisher, the Lord, witness, abode, refuge, friend, origin, end, foundation, store and the imperishable seed.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च। अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन
transliteration: tapāmyahamahaṃ varṣaṃ nigṛhṇāmyutsṛjāmi ca, amṛtaṃ caiva mṛtyuśca sadasaccāhamarjuna
hindi_meaning: हे अर्जुन ! (संसारके हितके लिये) मैं ही सूर्यरूपसे तपता हूँ, जलको ग्रहण करता हूँ और फिर उस जलको वर्षारूपसे बरसा देता हूँ। (और तो क्या कहूँ) अमृत और मृत्यु तथा सत् और असत् भी मैं ही हूँ।
english_meaning: O Arjuna, I give heat, I withhold and pour down rain. I am verily the nectar, and also death existence and nonexistence.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापा यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते। ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक मश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान्
transliteration: traividyā māṃ somapāḥ pūtapāpā yajñairiṣṭvā svargatiṃ prārthayante, te puṇyamāsādya surendraloka maśnanti divyāndivi devabhogān
hindi_meaning: वेदत्रयीमें कहे हुए सकाम अनुष्ठानको करनेवाले और सोमरसको पीनेवाले जो पापरहित मनुष्य यज्ञोंके द्वारा इन्द्ररूपसे मेरा पूजन करके स्वर्ग-प्राप्तिकी प्रार्थना करते हैं, वे पुण्यके फलस्वरूप इन्द्रलोकको प्राप्त करके वहाँ स्वर्गमें देवताओंके दिव्य भोगोंको भोगते हैं।
english_meaning: Those who are versed in the Vedas, who are drinkers of Soma and are purified of sin, pray for the heavenly goal by worshipping Me through sacrifices. Having reached the place (world) of the king of gods, which is the result of righteousness, they enjoy in heaven th divine pleasure of gods.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति। एव त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्ना गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते
transliteration: te taṃ bhuktvā svargalokaṃ viśālaṃ kṣīṇe puṇye martyalokaṃ viśanti, eva trayīdharmamanuprapannā gatāgataṃ kāmakāmā labhante
hindi_meaning: वे उस विशाल स्वर्गलोकके भोगोंको भोगकर पुण्य क्षीण होनेपर मृत्युलोकमें आ जाते हैं। इस प्रकार तीनों वेदोंमें कहे हुए सकाम धर्मका आश्रय लिये हुए भोगोंकी कामना करनेवाले मनुष्य आवागमनको प्राप्त होते हैं।
english_meaning: After having enjoyed that vast heavenly world, they enter into the human world on the exhaustion of their merit. Thus, those who follow the rites and duties prescribed in the three Vedas, and are desirous of pleasures, attain the state of going and returning.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते। तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम्॥
transliteration: ananyash cintayanto mam ye janah paryupasate, tesam nityabhiyuktanam yoga-ksemam vahamy aham
hindi_meaning: जो भक्त मुझे अनन्य भाव से निरंतर चिंतन करते हुए उपासना करते हैं, उन नित्ययुक्त भक्तों का योगक्षेम मैं स्वयं वहन करता हूं।
english_meaning: But those who always worship Me with exclusive devotion, meditating on My transcendental form — to them I carry what they lack, and I preserve what they have.
practical_guidance: If you are anxious about finances, security, or an uncertain future, this verse is a direct promise: sincere devotion invites divine provision. Today, release one worry to God and replace it with one act of sincere gratitude.

sanskrit_text: येऽप्यन्यदेवता भक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः। तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम्
transliteration: ye'pyanyadevatā bhaktā yajante śraddhayā'nvitāḥ, te'pi māmeva kaunteya yajantyavidhipūrvakam
hindi_meaning: हे कुन्तीनन्दन! जो भी भक्त (मनुष्य) श्रद्धापूर्वक अन्य देवताओंका पूजन करते हैं, वे भी करते हैं मेरा ही पूजन, पर करते है अविधिपूर्वक
english_meaning: Even those who, being devoted to other deities and endowed with faith, worship (them), they also, O son of Kunti, worship Me alone (though) following the wrong method.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च। न तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते
transliteration: ahaṃ hi sarvayajñānāṃ bhoktā ca prabhureva ca, na tu māmabhijānanti tattvenātaścyavanti te
hindi_meaning: क्योंकि मैं ही सम्पूर्ण यज्ञोंका भोक्ता और स्वामी भी हूँ; परन्तु वे मेरेको तत्त्वसे नहीं जानते, इसीसे उनका पतन होता है।
english_meaning: I indeed am the enjoyer as also the Lord of all sacrifices; but they do not know Me in reality. Therefore they fall.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: यान्ति देवव्रता देवान् पितृ़न्यान्ति पितृव्रताः। भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम्
transliteration: yānti devavratā devān pitṛ़nyānti pitṛvratāḥ, bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti madyājino'pi mām
hindi_meaning: (सकामभावसे) देवताओंका पूजन करनेवाले (शरीर छोड़नेपर) देवताओंको प्राप्त होते हैं। पितरोंका पूजन करनेवाले पितरोंको प्राप्त होते हैं। भूत-प्रेतोंका पूजन करनेवाले भूत-प्रेतोंको प्राप्त होते हैं। परन्तु मेरा पूजन करनेवाले मुझे ही प्राप्त होते हैं।
english_meaning: Votaries of the gods reach the gods; the votarites of the manes go to the manes; the worshippers of the Beings reach the Beings; and those who worship Me reach Me.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति। तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः॥
transliteration: patram puspam phalam toyam yo me bhaktya prayacchati, tad aham bhakty-upahrtam asnami prayatatmanah
hindi_meaning: जो भक्त मुझे पत्र, पुष्प, फल और जल भक्तिपूर्वक अर्पित करता है, उस शुद्धात्मा भक्त का भक्तिपूर्वक दिया हुआ अर्पण मैं स्वीकार करता हूं।
english_meaning: If one offers Me with love and devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit or water, I will accept it.
practical_guidance: You do not need elaborate rituals or grand gestures to connect with the divine. Offer whatever you have — a simple prayer, a flower, a glass of water — with genuine love. The sincerity of your heart matters infinitely more than the grandeur of your offering.

sanskrit_text: यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत्। यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम्
transliteration: yatkaroṣi yadaśnāsi yajjuhoṣi dadāsi yat, yattapasyasi kaunteya tatkuruṣva madarpaṇam
hindi_meaning: हे कुन्तीपुत्र ! तू जो कुछ करता है, जो कुछ खाता है, जो कुछ यज्ञ करता है, जो कुछ दान देता है और जो कुछ तप करता है, वह सब मेरे अर्पण कर दे।
english_meaning: O son of Kunti, whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer as a sacrifice, whatever you give and whatever austerities you undertake, (all) that you offer to Me.
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: शुभाशुभफलैरेवं मोक्ष्यसे कर्मबन्धनैः। संन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा विमुक्तो मामुपैष्यसि
transliteration: śubhāśubhaphalairevaṃ mokṣyase karmabandhanaiḥ, saṃnyāsayogayuktātmā vimukto māmupaiṣyasi
hindi_meaning: इस प्रकार मेरे अर्पण करनेसे जिनसे कर्मबन्धन होता है, ऐसे शुभ (विहित) और अशुभ (निषिद्ध) सम्पूर्ण कर्मोंके फलोंसे तू मुक्त हो जायगा। ऐसे अपनेसहित सब कुछ मेरे अर्पण करनेवाला और सबसे मुक्त हुआ तू मेरेको प्राप्त हो जायगा।
english_meaning: Thus, you will become free from bondage in the form of actions which are productive of good and bad results. Havng your mind inbued with the yoga of renunciation and becoming free, you will attain Me.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः। ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम्
transliteration: samo'haṃ sarvabhūteṣu na me dveṣyo'sti na priyaḥ, ye bhajanti tu māṃ bhaktyā mayi te teṣu cāpyaham
hindi_meaning: मैं सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंमें समान हूँ। उन प्राणियोंमें न तो कोई मेरा द्वेषी है और न कोई प्रिय है। परन्तु जो भक्तिपूर्वक मेरा भजन करते हैं, वे मेरेमें हैं और मैं उनमें हूँ।
english_meaning: I am impartial towards all beings; to Me there is none detastable or none dear. But those who worship Me with devotion, they exist in Me, and I too exist in them.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक्। साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः
transliteration: api cetsudurācāro bhajate māmananyabhāk, sādhureva sa mantavyaḥ samyagvyavasito hi saḥ
hindi_meaning: अगर कोई दुराचारी-से-दुराचारी भी अनन्यभावसे मेरा भजन करता है, तो उसको साधु ही मानना चाहिये। कारण कि उसने निश्चय बहुत अच्छी तरह कर लिया है।
english_meaning: Even if a man of very bad conduct worships Me with one-pointed devotion, he is to be considered verily good; for he has resolved rightly.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति। कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति
transliteration: kṣipraṃ bhavati dharmātmā śaśvacchāntiṃ nigacchati, kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati
hindi_meaning: वह तत्काल (उसी क्षण) धर्मात्मा हो जाता है और निरन्तर रहनेवाली शान्तिको प्राप्त हो जाता है। हे कुन्तीनन्दन ! तुम प्रतिज्ञा करो कि मेरे भक्तका विनाश (पतन) नहीं होता।
english_meaning: He soon becomes possessed of a virtuous mind; he attains everlasting peace. Do you proclain boldly, O son of Kunti, that My devotee does not get ruined.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः। स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम्
transliteration: māṃ hi pārtha vyapāśritya ye'pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ, striyo vaiśyāstathā śūdrāste'pi yānti parāṃ gatim
hindi_meaning: हे पृथानन्दन ! जो भी पापयोनिवाले हों तथा जो भी स्त्रियाँ, वैश्य और शूद्र हों, वे भी सर्वथा मेरे शरण होकर निःसन्देह परमगतिको प्राप्त हो जाते हैं।
english_meaning: For, O son of Prtha, even those who are born of sin-women, Vaisyas, as also Sudras [S.'s construction of this portion is: women, Vaisyas as also Sudras, and even others who are born of sin (i.e., those who are born low and are of vile deeds, viz Mlecchas, Pukkasas and others). M.S. also takes papa-yonayah (born of sin) as a separate phrase, and classifies women and others only as those d arred from Vedic study, etc.-Tr.]-, even they reach the highest Goal by taking shelter under Me.
practical_guidance: Sit quietly for five minutes. Ask: 'What is the most meaningful thing I can contribute?' Let the answer arise naturally, without forcing it.

sanskrit_text: किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा। अनित्यमसुखं लोकमिमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम्
transliteration: kiṃ punarbrāhmaṇāḥ puṇyā bhaktā rājarṣayastathā, anityamasukhaṃ lokamimaṃ prāpya bhajasva mām
hindi_meaning: जो पवित्र आचरणवाले ब्राह्मण और ऋषिस्वरूप क्षत्रिय भगवान् के भक्त हों, वे परमगतिको प्राप्त हो जायँ, इसमें तो कहना ही क्या है। इसलिये इस अनित्य और सुखरहित शरीरको प्राप्त करके तू मेरा भजन कर।
english_meaning: What to speak of the holy Brahmanas as also of devout kind-sages! Having come to this ephemeral and miserable world, do you worship Me.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु। मामेवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणः
transliteration: manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru, māmevaiṣyasi yuktvaivamātmānaṃ matparāyaṇaḥ
hindi_meaning: तू मेरा भक्त हो जा, मेरेमें मनवाला हो जा, मेरा पूजन करनेवाला हो जा और मेरेको नमस्कार कर। इस प्रकार मेरे साथ अपने-आपको लगाकर, मेरे परायण हुआ तू मेरेको ही प्राप्त होगा। ,
english_meaning: Having your mind fixed on Me, be devoted to Me, sacrifice to Me, and bow down to Me. By concentrating your mind and accepting Me as the supreme Goal, you shall surely attain Me who am thus the Self.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: भूय एव महाबाहो श्रृणु मे परमं वचः। यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया
transliteration: bhūya eva mahābāho śrṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ, yatte'haṃ prīyamāṇāya vakṣyāmi hitakāmyayā
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले -- हे महाबाहो अर्जुन ! मेरे परम वचनको तुम फिर भी सुनो, जिसे मैं तुम्हारे हितकी कामनासे कहूँगा; क्योंकि तुम मेरेमें अत्यन्त प्रेम रखते हो।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said O mighty-armed one, listen over again ot My supreme utterance, which I, wishing your welfare, shall speak to you who take delight (in it).
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः। अहमादिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः
transliteration: na me viduḥ suragaṇāḥ prabhavaṃ na maharṣayaḥ, ahamādirhi devānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
hindi_meaning: मेरे प्रकट होनेको न देवता जानते हैं और न महर्षि; क्योंकि मैं सब प्रकारसे देवताओं और महर्षियोंका आदि हूँ।
english_meaning: Neither the gods nor the great sages know My majesty. For, in all respects, I am the source of the gods and the great sages.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: यो मामजमनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम्। असम्मूढः स मर्त्येषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
transliteration: yo māmajamanādiṃ ca vetti lokamaheśvaram, asammūḍhaḥ sa martyeṣu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
hindi_meaning: जो मनुष्य मुझे अजन्मा, अनादि और सम्पूर्ण लोकोंका महान् ईश्वर जानता है अर्थात् दृढ़तासे मानता है, वह मनुष्योंमें असम्मूढ़ (जानकार) है और वह सम्पूर्ण पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है।
english_meaning: He who knows Me-the birthless, the beginningless, and the great Lord of the worlds, he, the undeluded one among mortals, becomes freed from all sins.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसंमोहः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः। सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च
transliteration: buddhirjñānamasaṃmohaḥ kṣamā satyaṃ damaḥ śamaḥ, sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhavo'bhāvo bhayaṃ cābhayameva ca
hindi_meaning: -- 10.5।। बुद्धि, ज्ञान, असम्मोह, क्षमा, सत्य, दम, शम, सुख, दुःख, भव, अभाव, भय, अभय, अहिंसा, समता, तुष्टि, तप, दान, यश और अपयश -- प्राणियोंके ये अनेक प्रकारके और अलग-अलग (बीस) भाव मेरेसे ही होते हैं।
english_meaning: Intelligence, wisdom, non-delusion, forgiveness, truth, control of the external organs, control of the internal organs, happiness, sorrow, birth, death and fear as also fearlessness;
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः। भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः
transliteration: ahiṃsā samatā tuṣṭistapo dānaṃ yaśo'yaśaḥ, bhavanti bhāvā bhūtānāṃ matta eva pṛthagvidhāḥ
hindi_meaning: -- 10.5।। बुद्धि, ज्ञान, असम्मोह, क्षमा, सत्य, दम, शम, सुख, दुःख, भव, अभाव, भय, अभय, अहिंसा, समता, तुष्टि, तप, दान, यश और अपयश -- प्राणियोंके ये अनेक प्रकारके और अलग-अलग (बीस) भाव मेरेसे ही होते हैं।
english_meaning: Non-injury, eanimity, satisfaction, austerity, charity, fame, infamy-(these) different dispositions of beings spring from Me alone.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा। मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः
transliteration: maharṣayaḥ sapta pūrve catvāro manavastathā, madbhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣāṃ loka imāḥ prajāḥ
hindi_meaning: सात महर्षि और उनसे भी पूर्वमें होनेवाले चार सनकादि तथा चौदह मनु -- ये सब-के-सब मेरे मनसे पैदा हुए हैं और मेरेमें भाव (श्रद्धाभक्ति) रखनेवाले हैं, जिनकी संसारमें यह सम्पूर्ण प्रजा है।
english_meaning: The seven great sages as also the four Manus of anceint days, of whom are these creatures in the world, had their thoughts fixed on Me, and they were born from My mind.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः। सोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः
transliteration: etāṃ vibhūtiṃ yogaṃ ca mama yo vetti tattvataḥ, so'vikampena yogena yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
hindi_meaning: जो मनुष्य मेरी इस विभूतिको और योगको तत्त्वसे जानता है अर्थात् दृढ़तापूर्वक मानता है, वह अविचल भक्तियोगसे युक्त हो जाता है; इसमें कुछ भी संशय नहीं है।
english_meaning: One who knows truly this majesty and yoga of Mine, he becomes imbued with unwavering Yoga. There is no doubt about this.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते। इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः
transliteration: ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate, iti matvā bhajante māṃ budhā bhāvasamanvitāḥ
hindi_meaning: मैं संसारमात्रका प्रभव (मूलकारण) हूँ, और मुझसे ही सारा संसार प्रवृत्त हो रहा है अर्थात् चेष्टा कर रहा है -- ऐसा मेरेको मानकर मेरेमें ही श्रद्धा-प्रेम रखते हुए बुद्धिमान् भक्त मेरा ही भजन करते हैं -- सब प्रकारसे मेरे ही शरण होते हैं।
english_meaning: I am the origin of all; everything moves on owing to Me. Realizing thus, the wise ones, filled with fervour, adore Me.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम्। कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च
transliteration: maccittā madgataprāṇā bodhayantaḥ parasparam, kathayantaśca māṃ nityaṃ tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca
hindi_meaning: । मेरेमें चित्तवाले, मेरेमें प्राणोंको अर्पण करनेवाले भक्तजन आपसमें मेरे गुण, प्रभाव आदिको जानते हुए और उनका कथन करते हुए ही नित्य-निरन्तर सन्तुष्ट रहते हैं और मेरेमें प्रेम करते हैं।
english_meaning: With minds fixed on Me, with lives dedicated to Me, enlightening each other, and always speaking of Me, they derive satisfaction and rejoice.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम्। ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते
transliteration: teṣāṃ satatayuktānāṃ bhajatāṃ prītipūrvakam, dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena māmupayānti te
hindi_meaning: उन नित्य-निरन्तर मेरेमें लगे हुए और प्रेमपूर्वक मेरा भजन करनेवाले भक्तोंको मैं वह बुद्धियोग देता हूँ, जिससे उनको मेरी प्राप्ति हो जाती है।
english_meaning: To them who are ever devoted and worship Me with love, I grant that possession of wisdom by which they reach Me.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः। नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता
transliteration: teṣāmevānukampārthamahamajñānajaṃ tamaḥ, nāśayāmyātmabhāvastho jñānadīpena bhāsvatā
hindi_meaning: उन भक्तोंपर कृपा करनेके लिये ही उनके स्वरूप (होनेपन) में रहनेवाला मैं उनके अज्ञानजन्य अन्धकारको देदीप्यमान ज्ञानरूप दीपकके द्वारा सर्वथा नष्ट कर देता हूँ।
english_meaning: Out of compassion for them alone, I, residing in their hearts, destroy the darkness born of ignorance with the luminous lamp of Knowledge.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान्। पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम्
transliteration: paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma pavitraṃ paramaṃ bhavān, puruṣaṃ śāśvataṃ divyamādidevamajaṃ vibhum
hindi_meaning: -- 10.12।। अर्जुन बोले -- परम ब्रह्म, परम धाम और महान् पवित्र आप ही हैं। आप शाश्वत, दिव्य पुरुष, आदिदेव, अजन्मा और विभु (व्यापक) हैं -- ऐसा सब-के-सब ऋषि, देवर्षि नारद, असित, देवल तथा व्यास कहते हैं और स्वयं आप भी मेरे प्रति कहते हैं।
english_meaning: -10.13 Arjuna said You are the supreme Brahman, the supreme Light, the supreme Sanctifier. All the sages as also the divine sage Narada, Asita, Devala and Vyasa [Although Narada and the other sages are already mentioned by the words 'all the sages', still they are named separately because of their eminence. Asita is the father of Devala.] call You the eternal divine Person, the Primal God, the Birthless, the Omnipresent; and You Yourself verily tell me (so).
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: आहुस्त्वामृषयः सर्वे देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा। असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे
transliteration: āhustvāmṛṣayaḥ sarve devarṣirnāradastathā, asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṃ caiva bravīṣi me
hindi_meaning: -- 10.13।। अर्जुन बोले -- परम ब्रह्म, परम धाम और महान् पवित्र आप ही हैं। आप शाश्वत, दिव्य पुरुष, आदिदेव, अजन्मा और विभु (व्यापक) हैं -- ऐसा सब-के-सब ऋषि, देवर्षि नारद, असित, देवल तथा व्यास कहते हैं और स्वयं आप भी मेरे प्रति कहते हैं।
english_meaning: -10.13 Arjuna said You are the supreme Brahman, the supreme Light, the supreme Sanctifier. All the sages as also the divine sage Narada, Asita, Devala and Vyasa [Although Narada and the other sages are already mentioned by the words 'all the sages', still they are named separately because of their eminence. Asita is the father of Devala.] call You the eternal divine Person, the Primal God, the Birthless, the Omnipresent; and You Yourself verily tell me (so).
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव। न हि ते भगवन् व्यक्ितं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः
transliteration: sarvametadṛtaṃ manye yanmāṃ vadasi keśava, na hi te bhagavan vyakिtaṃ vidurdevā na dānavāḥ
hindi_meaning: हे केशव ! मेरेसे आप जो कुछ कह रहे हैं, यह सब मैं सत्य मानता हूँ। हे भगवन् ! आपके प्रकट होनेको न तो देवता जानते हैं और न दानव ही जानते हैं।
english_meaning: O Kesava, I accept to be true all this which You tell me. Certainly, O Lord, neither the gods nor the demons comprehend Your glory.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: स्वयमेवात्मनाऽत्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम। भूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते
transliteration: svayamevātmanā'tmānaṃ vettha tvaṃ puruṣottama, bhūtabhāvana bhūteśa devadeva jagatpate
hindi_meaning: हे भूतभावन ! हे भूतेश ! हे देवदेव ! हे जगत्पते ! हे पुरुषोत्तम ! आप स्वयं ही अपने-आपसे अपने-आपको जानते हैं।
english_meaning: O supreme Person, the Creator of beings, the Lord of beings, God of gods, the Lord of the worlds, You Yourself alone know Yourself by Yourself.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषेण दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः। याभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकानिमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठसि
transliteration: vaktumarhasyaśeṣeṇa divyā hyātmavibhūtayaḥ, yābhirvibhūtibhirlokānimāṃstvaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhasi
hindi_meaning: जिन विभूतियोंसे आप इन सम्पूर्ण लोकोंको व्याप्त करके स्थित हैं, उन सभी अपनी दिव्य विभूतियोंका सम्पूर्णतासे वर्णन करनेमें आप ही समर्थ हैं।
english_meaning: Be pleased to speak in full of Your own manifestations which are indeed divine, through which manifestations You exist pervading these worlds.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: कथं विद्यामहं योगिंस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन्। केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया
transliteration: kathaṃ vidyāmahaṃ yogiṃstvāṃ sadā paricintayan, keṣu keṣu ca bhāveṣu cintyo'si bhagavanmayā
hindi_meaning: हे योगिन् ! हरदम साङ्गोपाङ्ग चिन्तन करता हुआ मैं आपको कैसे जानूँ ? और हे भगवन् ! किन-किन भावोंमें आप मेरे द्वारा चिन्तन किये जा सकते हैं अर्थात् किन-किन भावोंमें मैं आपका चिन्तन करूँ ?
english_meaning: O Yogi, [Here yoga stands for the results of yoga, viz omniscience, omnipotence, etc.; one possessed of these is a yogi. (See Comm. on 10.7)] how shall I know You by remaining ever-engaged in meditation? And through what objects, O Lord, are You to be meditated on by me?
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: विस्तरेणात्मनो योगं विभूतिं च जनार्दन। भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि श्रृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम्
transliteration: vistareṇātmano yogaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca janārdana, bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛptirhi śrṛṇvato nāsti me'mṛtam
hindi_meaning: हे जनार्दन ! आप अपने योग (सामर्थ्य) को और विभूतियोंको विस्तारसे फिर कहिये; क्योंकि आपके अमृतमय वचन सुनते-सुनते मेरी तृप्ति नहीं हो रही है।
english_meaning: O Janardana, narrate to me again [In addition to what has been said in the seventh and ninth chapters.] Your onw yoga and (divine) manifestations elaborately. For, while hearing (Your) nectar-like (words), there is no satiety in me.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः। प्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्यन्तो विस्तरस्य मे
transliteration: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi divyā hyātmavibhūtayaḥ, prādhānyataḥ kuruśreṣṭha nāstyanto vistarasya me
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले -- हाँ, ठीक है। मैं अपनी दिव्य विभूतियोंको तेरे लिये प्रधानतासे (संक्षेपसे) कहूँगा; क्योंकि हे कुरुश्रेष्ठ ! मेरी विभूतियोंके विस्तारका अन्त नहीं है।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said O best of the Kurus, now, according to their importance, I shall described to you My onw glories, which are indeed divine. There is no end to my manifestations.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः। अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च॥
transliteration: aham atma gudakesa sarva-bhutasaya-sthitah, aham adis ca madhyam ca bhutanam anta eva ca
hindi_meaning: हे गुडाकेश, मैं सभी प्राणियों के हृदय में स्थित आत्मा हूं। मैं ही सभी प्राणियों का आदि, मध्य और अंत हूं।
english_meaning: I am the Self, O Gudakesa, seated in the hearts of all creatures. I am the beginning, the middle and the end of all beings.
practical_guidance: The divine is not somewhere far away requiring you to travel or perform — it is seated within your own heart right now. Sit quietly for 5 minutes today, place your hand on your heart, and simply feel the presence there. This is the beginning of real connection.

sanskrit_text: आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान्। मरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी
transliteration: ādityānāmahaṃ viṣṇurjyotiṣāṃ raviraṃśumān, marīcirmarutāmasmi nakṣatrāṇāmahaṃ śaśī
hindi_meaning: मैं अदितिके पुत्रोंमें विष्णु (वामन) और प्रकाशमान वस्तुओंमें किरणोंवाला सूर्य हूँ। मैं मरुतोंका तेज और नक्षत्रोंका अधिपति चन्द्रमा हूँ।
english_meaning: Among the Adityas [viz Dhata, Mitra, aryama, Rudra, Varuna, Surya, Bhaga, Vivasvan, Pusa, Savita, Tvasta and Visnu.-Tr.] I am Visnu; among the luminaries, the radiant sun; among the (forty-nine) Maruts [The seven groups of Maruts are Avaha, Pravaha, Vivaha, Paravaha, Udvaha, Samvaha and parivaha.-Tr.] I am Marici; among the stars I am the moon.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः। इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना
transliteration: vedānāṃ sāmavedo'smi devānāmasmi vāsavaḥ, indriyāṇāṃ manaścāsmi bhūtānāmasmi cetanā
hindi_meaning: मैं वेदोंमें सामवेद हूँ, देवताओंमें इन्द्र हूँ, इन्द्रियोंमें मन हूँ और प्राणियोंकी चेतना हूँ।
english_meaning: Among the Vedas I am Sama-veda; among the gods I am Indra. Among the organs I am the mind, and I am the intelligence in creatures.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: रुद्राणां शङ्करश्चास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम्। वसूनां पावकश्चास्मि मेरुः शिखरिणामहम्
transliteration: rudrāṇāṃ śaṅkaraścāsmi vitteśo yakṣarakṣasām, vasūnāṃ pāvakaścāsmi meruḥ śikhariṇāmaham
hindi_meaning: रुद्रोंमें शंकर और यक्ष-राक्षसोंमें कुबेर मैं हूँ।वसुओंमें पावक (अग्नि) और शिखरवाले पर्वतोंमें सुमेरु मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: Among the Rudras [Aja, Ekapada, Ahirbudhnya, Pinaki, Aparajita, Tryam-baka, Mahesvara, Vrsakapi, Sambhu, Harana and Isvara. Different Puranas give different lists of eleven names.-Tr,] I am Sankara, and among the Yaksas and goblins I am Kubera [God of wealth. Yaksas are a class of demigods who attend on him and guard his wealth.]. Among the Vasus [According to the V.P. they are: Apa, dhruva, Soma, Dharma, Anila, Anala (Fire), Pratyusa and Prabhasa. The Mbh. and the Bh. given a different list.-Tr.] I am Fire, and among the mountains I am Meru.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम्। सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः
transliteration: purodhasāṃ ca mukhyaṃ māṃ viddhi pārtha bṛhaspatim, senānīnāmahaṃ skandaḥ sarasāmasmi sāgaraḥ
hindi_meaning: हे पार्थ ! पुरोहितोंमें मुख्य बृहस्पतिको मेरा स्वरूप समझो। सेनापतियोंमें स्कन्द और जलाशयोंमें समुद्र मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: O son of Prtha, know me to be Brhaspati, the foremost among the priests of kings. Among comanders of armies I am Skanda; among large expanses of water I am the sea.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम्। यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः
transliteration: maharṣīṇāṃ bhṛgurahaṃ girāmasmyekamakṣaram, yajñānāṃ japayajño'smi sthāvarāṇāṃ himālayaḥ
hindi_meaning: महर्षियोंमें भृगु और वाणियों-(शब्दों-) में एक अक्षर अर्थात् प्रणव मैं हूँ। सम्पूर्ण यज्ञोंमें जपयज्ञ और स्थिर रहनेवालोंमें हिमालय मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: Among the great sages I am Bhrgu; of words I am the single syllable (Om) [Om is the best because it is the name as well as the symbol of Brahman.]. Among rituals I am the ritual of Japa [Japa, muttering prayers-repeating passages from the Vedas, silently repeating names of deities, etc. Rituals often involve killing of animals. But Japa is free from such injury, and hence the best.] of the immovables, the Himalaya.
practical_guidance: You cannot undo the past, only respond to it now. Forgive yourself as you would a dear friend who made a mistake. Then take one right action today.

sanskrit_text: अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः। गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः
transliteration: aśvatthaḥ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ, gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo muniḥ
hindi_meaning: सम्पूर्ण वृक्षोंमें पीपल, देवर्षियोंमें नारद, गन्धर्वोंमें चित्ररथ और सिद्धोंमें कपिल मुनि मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: Among all trees (I am) the Asvatha (peepul), and Narada among the divine sages. Among the dandharvas [A class of demigods regarded as the musicians of gods.] (I am) Citraratha; among the perfected ones, the sage Kapila.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम्। ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम्
transliteration: uccaiḥśravasamaśvānāṃ viddhi māmamṛtodbhavam, airāvataṃ gajendrāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca narādhipam
hindi_meaning: घोड़ोंमें अमृतके साथ समुद्रसे प्रकट होनेवाले उच्चैःश्रवा नामक घोड़ेको, श्रेष्ठ हाथियोंमें ऐरावत नामक हाथीको और मनुष्योंमें राजाको मेरी विभूति मानो।
english_meaning: Among horses, know Me to be Uccaihsravas, born of nectar; Airavata among the lordly elephants; and among men, the Kind of men. [Uccaihsravas and Airavata are respectively the divine horse and elephant of Indra.]
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक्। प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः
transliteration: āyudhānāmahaṃ vajraṃ dhenūnāmasmi kāmadhuk, prajanaścāsmi kandarpaḥ sarpāṇāmasmi vāsukiḥ
hindi_meaning: आयुधोंमें वज्र और धेनुओंमें कामधेनु मैं हूँ। सन्तान-उत्पत्तिका हेतु कामदेव मैं हूँ और सर्पोंमें वासुकि मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: Among weapons I am the thunderbolt; among cows I am kamadhenu. I am Kandarpa, the Progenitor, and among serpents I am Vasuki.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम्। पितृ़णामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम्
transliteration: anantaścāsmi nāgānāṃ varuṇo yādasāmaham, pitṛ़ṇāmaryamā cāsmi yamaḥ saṃyamatāmaham
hindi_meaning: नागोंमें अनन्त (शेषनाग) और जल-जन्तुओंका अधिपति वरुण मैं हूँ। पितरोंमें अर्यमा और शासन करनेवालोंमें यमराज मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: Among snakes I am Ananta, and Varuna among gods of the waters. Among the manes I am Aryama, and among the maintainers of law and order I am Yama (King of death).
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम्। मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम्
transliteration: prahlādaścāsmi daityānāṃ kālaḥ kalayatāmaham, mṛgāṇāṃ ca mṛgendro'haṃ vainateyaśca pakṣiṇām
hindi_meaning: दैत्योंमें प्रह्लाद और गणना करनेवालोंमें काल मैं हूँ । पशुओंमें सिंह और पक्षियोंमें गरुड मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: Among demons I am Prahlada, and I am Time among reckoners of time. And among animals I am the loin, and among birds I am Garuda.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: पवनः पवतामस्मि रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम्। झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी
transliteration: pavanaḥ pavatāmasmi rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāmaham, jhaṣāṇāṃ makaraścāsmi srotasāmasmi jāhnavī
hindi_meaning: पवित्र करनेवालोंमें वायु और शास्त्रधारियोंमें राम मैं हूँ। जल-जन्तुओंमें मगर मैं हूँ। बहनेवाले स्त्रोतोंमें गङ्गाजी मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: Of the purifiers I am air; among the wielders of weapons I am Rama. Among fishes, too, I am the shark; I am Ganga among rivers.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन। अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम्
transliteration: sargāṇāmādirantaśca madhyaṃ caivāhamarjuna, adhyātmavidyā vidyānāṃ vādaḥ pravadatāmaham
hindi_meaning: हे अर्जुन ! सम्पूर्ण सर्गोंके आदि, मध्य तथा अन्तमें मैं ही हूँ। विद्याओंमें अध्यात्मविद्या और परस्पर शास्त्रार्थ करनेवालोंका(तत्त्व-निर्णयके लिये किया जानेवाला) वाद मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: O Arjuna, of creations I am the beginning and the end as also the middle, I am the knowledge of the Self among knowledge; of those who d ate I am vada.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च। अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताऽहं विश्वतोमुखः
transliteration: akṣarāṇāmakāro'smi dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya ca, ahamevākṣayaḥ kālo dhātā'haṃ viśvatomukhaḥ
hindi_meaning: अक्षरोंमें अकार और समासोंमें द्वन्द्व समास मैं हूँ। अक्षयकाल अर्थात् कालका भी महाकाल तथा सब ओर मुखवाला धाता भी मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: Of the letters I am the letter a, and of the group of compund words I am (the compound called) Dvandva. [Dvandva: A compound of two or more words which, if not compounded, would stand in the same case and be connected by the conjunction 'and'.-Tr.] I Mayself am the infinite time; I am the Dispenser with faces everywhere.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम्। कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा
transliteration: mṛtyuḥ sarvaharaścāhamudbhavaśca bhaviṣyatām, kīrtiḥ śrīrvākca nārīṇāṃ smṛtirmedhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā
hindi_meaning: सबका हरण करनेवाली मृत्यु और उत्पन्न होनेवालोंका उभ्दव मैं हूँ तथा स्त्री-जातिमें कीर्ति, श्री, वाक्, स्मृति, मेधा, धृति और क्षमा मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: And I am Death, the destroyer of all; and the prosperity of those destined to be prosperous. Of the feminine [Narinam may mean 'of the feminine alities'. According to Sridhara Swami and S., the words fame etc. signify the goddesses of the respective alities. According to M.S. these seven goddesses are the wives of the god Dharma.-Tr.] (I am) fame, beauty, speech, memory, intelligence, fortitude and forbearance.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम्। मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः
transliteration: bṛhatsāma tathā sāmnāṃ gāyatrī chandasāmaham, māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣo'hamṛtūnāṃ kusumākaraḥ
hindi_meaning: गायी जानेवाली श्रुतियोंमें बृहत्साम और वैदिक छन्दोंमें गायत्री छन्द मैं हूँ। बारह महीनोंमें मार्गशीर्ष और छः ऋतुओंमें वसन्त मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: I am also the Brhat-sama of the Sama (-mantras); of the metres, Gayatri. Of the months I am Marga-sirsa, and of the seasons, spring.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्। जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम्
transliteration: dyūtaṃ chalayatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham, jayo'smi vyavasāyo'smi sattvaṃ sattvavatāmaham
hindi_meaning: छल करनेवालोंमें जूआ और तेजस्वियोंमें तेज मैं हूँ। जीतनेवालोंकी विजय, निश्चय करनेवालोंका निश्चय और सात्त्विक मनुष्योंका सात्त्विक भाव मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: Of the fraudulent I am the gambling; I am the irresistible ?nd of the mighty. I am excellene, I am effort, I am the sattva ality of those possessed of sattva.
practical_guidance: Fear and courage live side by side. The Gita doesn't ask you to be fearless — only to act rightly despite the fear. Take one brave step today.

sanskrit_text: वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनंजयः। मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः
transliteration: vṛṣṇīnāṃ vāsudevo'smi pāṇḍavānāṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ, munīnāmapyahaṃ vyāsaḥ kavīnāmuśanā kaviḥ
hindi_meaning: वृष्णिवंशियोंमें वासुदेव और पाण्डवोंमें धनञ्जय मैं हूँ। मुनियोंमें वेदव्यास और कवियोंमें कवि शुक्राचार्य भी मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: Of the vrsnis [The clan to which Sri krsna belonged, known otherwise as the Yadavas.] I am Vasudeva; of the Pandavas, Dhananjaya (Arjuna). And of the wise, I am Vyasa; of the omniscient, the omniscient Usanas.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम्। मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम्
transliteration: daṇḍo damayatāmasmi nītirasmi jigīṣatām, maunaṃ caivāsmi guhyānāṃ jñānaṃ jñānavatāmaham
hindi_meaning: दमन करनेवालोंमें दण्डनीति और विजय चाहनेवालोंमें नीति मैं हूँ। गोपनीय भावोंमें मौन और ज्ञानवानोंमें ज्ञान मैं हूँ।
english_meaning: Of the punishers I am the rod; I am the righteous policy of those who desire to coner. And of things secret, I am verily silence; I am knowledge of the men of knowledge৷৷
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन। न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम्
transliteration: yaccāpi sarvabhūtānāṃ bījaṃ tadahamarjuna, na tadasti vinā yatsyānmayā bhūtaṃ carācaram
hindi_meaning: हे अर्जुन! सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंका जो बीज है, वह बीज मैं ही हूँ; क्योंकि मेरे बिना कोई भी चर-अचर प्राणी नहीं है अर्थात् चर-अचर सब कुछ मैं ही हूँ।
english_meaning: Moreover, O Arjuna, whatsoever is the seed of all beings, that I am. There is no thing moving or non-moving which can exist without Me.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परंतप। एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया
transliteration: nānto'sti mama divyānāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ paraṃtapa, eṣa tūddeśataḥ prokto vibhūtervistaro mayā
hindi_meaning: हे परंतप अर्जुन ! मेरी दिव्य विभूतियोंका अन्त नहीं है। मैंने तुम्हारे सामने अपनी विभूतियोंका जो विस्तार कहा है, यह तो केवल संक्षेपसे कहा है।
english_meaning: O destroyer of enemies, there is no limit to My divine manifestations. This description of (My) manifestations, however, has been stated by Me by way illustration.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा। तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसंभवम्
transliteration: yadyadvibhūtimatsattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā, tattadevāvagaccha tvaṃ mama tejoṃ'śasaṃbhavam
hindi_meaning: जो-जो ऐश्वर्ययुक्त, शोभायुक्त और बलयुक्त प्राणी तथा वस्तु है, उस-उसको तुम मेरे ही तेज-(योग-) के अंशसे उत्पन्न हुई समझो।
english_meaning: Whatever object [All living beings] is verily endowed with majesty, possessed of prosperity, or is energetic, you know for certain each of them as having a part of My power as its source.
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन। विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत्
transliteration: athavā bahunaitena kiṃ jñātena tavārjuna, viṣṭabhyāhamidaṃ kṛtsnamekāṃśena sthito jagat
hindi_meaning: अथवा हे अर्जुन ! तुम्हें इस प्रकार बहुत-सी बातें जाननेकी क्या आवश्यकता है? मैं अपने किसी एक अंशसे सम्पूर्ण जगत् को व्याप्त करके स्थित हूँ।
english_meaning: Or, on the other hand, what is the need of your knowing this extensively, O Arjuna? I remain sustaning this whole creation in a special way with a part (of Myself).
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम्। यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम
transliteration: madanugrahāya paramaṃ guhyamadhyātmasaṃjñitam, yattvayoktaṃ vacastena moho'yaṃ vigato mama
hindi_meaning: अर्जुन बोले -- केवल मेरेपर कृपा करनेके लिये ही आपने जो परम गोपनीय अध्यात्मतत्तव जाननेका वचन कहा, उससे मेरा यह मोह नष्ट हो गया है।
english_meaning: Arjuna said This delusion of mine has departed as a result of that speech which is most secret and known as pertaining to the Self, and which was uttered by You for my benefit.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया। त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम्
transliteration: bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṃ śrutau vistaraśo mayā, tvattaḥ kamalapatrākṣa māhātmyamapi cāvyayam
hindi_meaning: हे कमलनयन ! सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंकी उत्पत्ति और प्रलय मैंने विस्तारपूर्वक आपसे ही सुना है और आपका अविनाशी माहात्म्य भी सुना है।
english_meaning: O you with eyes like lotus leaves, the origin and dissolution of beings have been heard by me in detail from You. ['From You have been heard the origin and dissolution of beings in You.'] And (Your) undecaying glory, too, (has been heard).
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वमात्मानं परमेश्वर। द्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपमैश्वरं पुरुषोत्तम
transliteration: evametadyathāttha tvamātmānaṃ parameśvara, draṣṭumicchāmi te rūpamaiśvaraṃ puruṣottama
hindi_meaning: हे पुरुषोत्तम ! आप अपने-आपको जैसा कहते हैं, यह वास्तवमें ऐसा ही है। हे परमेश्वर ! आपके ईश्वर-सम्बन्धी रूपको मैं देखना चाहता हूँ।
english_meaning: O supreme Lord, so it is, as You speak about Yourself. O supreme Person, I wish to see the divine form of Yours.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो। योगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयाऽत्मानमव्ययम्
transliteration: manyase yadi tacchakyaṃ mayā draṣṭumiti prabho, yogeśvara tato me tvaṃ darśayā'tmānamavyayam
hindi_meaning: हे प्रभो ! मेरे द्वारा आपका वह परम ऐश्वर रूप देखा जा सकता है -- ऐसा अगर आप मानते हैं, तो हे योगेश्वर ! आप अपने उस अविनाशी स्वरूपको मुझे दिखा दीजिये।
english_meaning: O Lord, if You think that it is possible to be seen by me, then, O Lord of Yoga, You show me Your eternal Self.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। नानाविधानि दिव्यानि नानावर्णाकृतीनि च
transliteration: paśya me pārtha rūpāṇi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ, nānāvidhāni divyāni nānāvarṇākṛtīni ca
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले -- हे पृथानन्दन ! अब मेरे अनेक तरहके, अनेक अनेक वर्णों और आकृतियोंवाले सैकड़ों-हजारों दिव्यरूपोंको तू देख।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said O son of Prtha, behold My forms in (their) hundreds and in thousands, of different kinds, celestial, and of various colours and shapes.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्िवनौ मरुतस्तथा। बहून्यदृष्टपूर्वाणि पश्याऽश्चर्याणि भारत
transliteration: paśyādityānvasūnrudrānaśिvanau marutastathā, bahūnyadṛṣṭapūrvāṇi paśyā'ścaryāṇi bhārata
