transliteration: anāditvānnirguṇatvātparamātmāyamavyayaḥ, śarīrastho'pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate
hindi_meaning: हे कुन्तीनन्दन ! यह पुरुष स्वयं अनादि और गुणोंसे रहित होनेसे अविनाशी परमात्मस्वरूप ही है। यह शरीरमें रहता हुआ भी न करता है और न लिप्त होता है।
english_meaning: Being without beginning and without alities, O son of Kunti, this immutable, supreme Self does not act. nor is It affected [Also translated as tainted.-Tr.], although existing in the body.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्म्यादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते। सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथाऽऽत्मा नोपलिप्यते
transliteration: yathā sarvagataṃ saukṣmyādākāśaṃ nopalipyate, sarvatrāvasthito dehe tathā''tmā nopalipyate
hindi_meaning: जैसे सब जगह व्याप्त आकाश अत्यन्त सूक्ष्म होनेसे कहीं भी लिप्त नहीं होता, ऐसे ही सब जगह परिपूर्ण आत्मा किसी भी देहमें लिप्त नहीं होता।
english_meaning: As the all-pervading space is not defiled, because of its subtlety, similarly the Self, present everywhere in the body [The singular number is used to denote a class, i.e. all bodies. See S.-Tr.], is not defiled.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः। क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत
transliteration: yathā prakāśayatyekaḥ kṛtsnaṃ lokamimaṃ raviḥ, kṣetraṃ kṣetrī tathā kṛtsnaṃ prakāśayati bhārata
hindi_meaning: हे भरतवंशोद्भव अर्जुन ! जैसे एक ही सूर्य सम्पूर्ण संसारको प्रकाशित करता है, ऐसे ही क्षेत्री (क्षेत्रज्ञ, आत्मा) सम्पूर्ण क्षेत्रको प्रकाशित करता है।
english_meaning: As the single sun illumines this whole world, similarly, O descendant of the Bharata dynasty, the Knower of the field illumines the whole field.
practical_guidance: You cannot undo the past, only respond to it now. Forgive yourself as you would a dear friend who made a mistake. Then take one right action today.

sanskrit_text: क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा। भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम्
transliteration: kṣetrakṣetrajñayorevamantaraṃ jñānacakṣuṣā, bhūtaprakṛtimokṣaṃ ca ye viduryānti te param
hindi_meaning: इस प्रकार जो ज्ञानरूपी नेत्रसे क्षेत्र और क्षेत्रज्ञके अन्तर-(विभाग-) को तथा कार्य-कारणसहित प्रकृतिसे स्वयंको अलग जानते हैं, वे परमात्माको प्राप्त हो जाते हैं।
english_meaning: Those who know thus through the eye of wisdom the distinction between the field and the Knower of the field, and the annihilation of the Matrix of beings,-they reach the Supreme.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: परं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम्। यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः
transliteration: paraṃ bhūyaḥ pravakṣyāmi jñānānāṃ jñānamuttamam, yajjñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṃ siddhimito gatāḥ
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले -- सम्पूर्ण ज्ञानोंमें उत्तम और पर ज्ञानको मैं फिर कहूँगा, जिसको जानकर सब-के-सब मुनिलोग इस संसारसे मुक्त होकर परमसिद्धिको प्राप्त हो गये हैं।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said I shall speak again of the supreme Knowledge, the best of all knowledges, by realizing which all the contemplatives reached the highest Perfection from here.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः। सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च
transliteration: idaṃ jñānamupāśritya mama sādharmyamāgatāḥ, sarge'pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti ca
hindi_meaning: इस ज्ञानका आश्रय लेकर जो मनुष्य मेरी सधर्मताको प्राप्त हो गये हैं, वे महासर्गमें भी पैदा नहीं होते और महाप्रलयमें भी व्यथित नहीं होते।
english_meaning: Those who attain identity with Me by resorting of this Knowledge are not born even during creation, nor do they suffer pain during dissolution.
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: मम योनिर्महद्ब्रह्म तस्मिन् गर्भं दधाम्यहम्। संभवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत
transliteration: mama yonirmahadbrahma tasmin garbhaṃ dadhāmyaham, saṃbhavaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tato bhavati bhārata
hindi_meaning: हे भरतवंशोद्भव अर्जुन ! मेरी मूल प्रकृति तो उत्पत्ति-स्थान है और मैं उसमें जीवरूप गर्भका स्थापन करता हूँ। उससे सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंकी उत्पत्ति होती है।
english_meaning: My womb is the great-sustainer. In that I place the seed. From that, O scion of the Bharata dynasty, occurs the birth of all things.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः। तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता
transliteration: sarvayoniṣu kaunteya mūrtayaḥ sambhavanti yāḥ, tāsāṃ brahma mahadyonirahaṃ bījapradaḥ pitā
hindi_meaning: हे कुन्तीनन्दन ! सम्पूर्ण योनियोंमें प्राणियोंके जितने शरीर पैदा होते हैं, उन सबकी मूल प्रकृति तो माता है और मैं बीज-स्थापन करनेवाला पिता हूँ।
english_meaning: O son of Kunti, whatever forms are born from all the wombs, of them the great-sustainer is the womb; I am the father who deposits the seed.
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसम्भवाः। निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम्॥
transliteration: sattvam rajas tama iti gunah prakrti-sambhavah, nibadhnanti maha-baho dehe dehinam avyayam
hindi_meaning: हे महाबाहो, प्रकृति से उत्पन्न सत्त्व, रज और तम — ये तीन गुण अविनाशी देही को शरीर में बांधते हैं।
english_meaning: Material nature consists of three modes — goodness, passion and ignorance. When the eternal living entity comes in contact with nature, O mighty-armed Arjuna, he becomes conditioned by these modes.
practical_guidance: Observe your current dominant state today. Are you clear, calm, and light (sattvic)? Active, driven, and restless (rajasic)? Or dull, sluggish, and confused (tamasic)? Knowing your state is the first step to elevating it — eat lightly, rest well, and seek uplifting company to move toward sattva.

sanskrit_text: तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम्। सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ
transliteration: tatra sattvaṃ nirmalatvātprakāśakamanāmayam, sukhasaṅgena badhnāti jñānasaṅgena cānagha
hindi_meaning: हे पापरहित अर्जुन ! उन गुणोंमें सत्त्वगुण निर्मल (स्वच्छ) होनेके कारण प्रकाशक और निर्विकार है। वह सुख और ज्ञानकी आसक्तिसे (देहीको) बाँधता है।
english_meaning: Among them, sattva, being pure, [Nirmala, pure-transparent, i.e., capable of resisting any form of ignorance, and hence as illuminator, i.e.a revealer of Consciousness.] is an illuminator and is harmless. O sinless one, it binds through attachment to happiness and attachment to knowledge.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम्। तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम्
transliteration: rajo rāgātmakaṃ viddhi tṛṣṇāsaṅgasamudbhavam, tannibadhnāti kaunteya karmasaṅgena dehinam
hindi_meaning: हे कुन्तीनन्दन ! तृष्णा और आसक्तिको पैदा करनेवाले रजोगुणको तुम रागस्वरूप समझो। वह कर्मोंकी आसक्तिसे शरीरधारीको बाँधता है।
english_meaning: Know rajas to be of the nature of passion, born of hankering and attachment. O son of Kunti, that binds the embodied one through attachment to action.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम्। प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत
transliteration: tamastvajñānajaṃ viddhi mohanaṃ sarvadehinām, pramādālasyanidrābhistannibadhnāti bhārata
hindi_meaning: हे भरतवंशी अर्जुन ! सम्पूर्ण देहधारियोंको मोहित करनेवाले तमोगुणको तुम अज्ञानसे उत्पन्न होनेवाला समझो। वह प्रमाद, आलस्य और निद्राके द्वारा देहधारियोंको बाँधता है।
english_meaning: On the other hand, know tamas, which deludes all embodied beings, to be born of ignorance. O scion of the Bharata dynasty, that binds through inadvertence, laziness and sleep.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत। ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत
transliteration: sattvaṃ sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata, jñānamāvṛtya tu tamaḥ pramāde sañjayatyuta
hindi_meaning: हे भरतवंशोद्भव अर्जुन ! सत्त्वगुण सुखमें और रजोगुण कर्ममें लगाकर मनुष्यपर विजय करता है तथा तमोगुण ज्ञानको ढककर एवं प्रमादमें भी लगाकर मनुष्यपर विजंय करता है।
english_meaning: O scion of the Bharata dynasty, sattva attaches one to happiness, rajas to action, while tamas, covering up knowledge, leads to inadvertence also.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत। रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा
transliteration: rajastamaścābhibhūya sattvaṃ bhavati bhārata, rajaḥ sattvaṃ tamaścaiva tamaḥ sattvaṃ rajastathā
hindi_meaning: हे भरतवंशोद्भव अर्जुन ! रजोगुण और तमोगुणको दबाकर सत्त्वगुण सत्त्वगुण, और तमोगुणको दबाकर रजोगुण, वैसे ही सत्त्वगुण और रजोगुणको दबाकर तमोगुण बढ़ता है।
english_meaning: O scion of the Bharata dynasty, sattva increases by subduing rajas and tamas, rajas by overpowering sattva and tamas, and tamas by dominating over sattva and rajas.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते। ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत
transliteration: sarvadvāreṣu dehe'sminprakāśa upajāyate, jñānaṃ yadā tadā vidyādvivṛddhaṃ sattvamityuta
hindi_meaning: जब इस मनुष्यशरीरमें सब द्वारों-(इन्द्रियों और अन्तःकरण-) में प्रकाश (स्वच्छता) और ज्ञान (विवेक) प्रकट हो जाता है, तब जानना चाहिये कि सत्त्वगुण बढ़ा हुआ है।
english_meaning: When the illumination that is knowledge radiates in this body through all the doors (of the senses), then one should know that sattva has increased greatly.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा। रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ
transliteration: lobhaḥ pravṛttirārambhaḥ karmaṇāmaśamaḥ spṛhā, rajasyetāni jāyante vivṛddhe bharatarṣabha
hindi_meaning: हे भरतवंशमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुन ! रजोगुणके बढ़नेपर लोभ, प्रवृत्ति, कर्मोंका आरम्भ, अशान्ति और स्पृहा -- ये वृत्तियाँ पैदा होती हैं।
english_meaning: O best of the Bharata dynasty, when rajas becomes predominant, these come into being: avarice, movement, undertaking of actions, unrest and hankering.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च। तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन
transliteration: aprakāśo'pravṛttiśca pramādo moha eva ca, tamasyetāni jāyante vivṛddhe kurunandana
hindi_meaning: हे कुरुनन्दन ! तमोगुणके बढ़नेपर अप्रकाश, अप्रवृत्ति, प्रमाद और मोह -- ये वृत्तियाँ भी पैदा होती हैं।
english_meaning: O descendant of the Kuru dynasty, when tamas predominates these surely [i.e. without exception.-M.S.] come into being: non-discrimination and inactivity, inadvertence and delusion.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत्। तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते
transliteration: yadā sattve pravṛddhe tu pralayaṃ yāti dehabhṛt, tadottamavidāṃ lokānamalānpratipadyate
hindi_meaning: जिस समय सत्त्वगुण बढ़ा हो, उस समय यदि देहधारी मनुष्य मर जाता है, तो वह,उत्तमवेत्ताओंके निर्मल लोकोंमें जाता है।
english_meaning: When an embodied one undergoes death while sattva is exclusively prodominant, then he attains the taintless worlds of those who know the highest (entities).
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते। तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते
transliteration: rajasi pralayaṃ gatvā karmasaṅgiṣu jāyate, tathā pralīnastamasi mūḍhayoniṣu jāyate
hindi_meaning: रजोगुणके बढ़नेपर मरनेवाला प्राणी मनुष्ययोनिमें जन्म लेता है तथा तमोगुणके बढ़नेपर मरनेवाला मूढ़योनियोंमें जन्म लेता है।
english_meaning: When one dies while rajas predominates, he is born among people attached to activity. Similarly, when one dies while tamas predominates, he takes birth among the stupid species.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम्। रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम्
transliteration: karmaṇaḥ sukṛtasyāhuḥ sāttvikaṃ nirmalaṃ phalam, rajasastu phalaṃ duḥkhamajñānaṃ tamasaḥ phalam
hindi_meaning: (विवेकी पुरुषोंने) शुभ-कर्मका तो सात्त्विक निर्मल फल कहा है, राजस कर्मका फल दुःख कहा है और तामस कर्मका फल अज्ञान (मूढ़ता) कहा है।
english_meaning: They say that the result of good work is pure and is born of sattva. But the result of rajas is sorrow; the result of tamas is ignorance.
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च। प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च
transliteration: sattvātsañjāyate jñānaṃ rajaso lobha eva ca, pramādamohau tamaso bhavato'jñānameva ca
hindi_meaning: सत्त्वगुणसे ज्ञान और रजोगुणसे लोभ आदि ही उत्पन्न होते हैं; तमोगुणसे प्रमाद, मोह एवं अज्ञान भी उत्पन्न होता है।
english_meaning: From sattva is born knowledge [Knowledge acired through the sense-organs.], and from rajas, verily, avarice. From tamas are born inadvertence and delusion as also ignorance, to be sure.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः। जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः
transliteration: ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti sattvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ, jaghanyaguṇavṛttisthā adho gacchanti tāmasāḥ
hindi_meaning: सत्त्वगुणमें स्थित मनुष्य ऊर्ध्वलोकोंमें जाते हैं, रजोगुणमें स्थित मनुष्य मृत्युलोकमें जन्म लेते हैं और निन्दनीय तमोगुणकी वृत्तिमें स्थित मनुष्य अधोगतिमें जाते हैं।
english_meaning: People who conform to sattva go higher up; those who conform to rajas stay in the middle; those who conform to tamas, who conform to the actions of the lowest ality, go down.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति। गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति
transliteration: nānyaṃ guṇebhyaḥ kartāraṃ yadā draṣṭānupaśyati, guṇebhyaśca paraṃ vetti madbhāvaṃ so'dhigacchati
hindi_meaning: जब विवेकी (विचारकुशल) मनुष्य तीनों गुणोंके सिवाय अन्य किसीको कर्ता नहीं देखता और अपनेको गुणोंसे पर अनुभव करता है, तब वह मेरे स्वरूपको प्राप्त हो जाता है।
english_meaning: When the witness sees none other than the alities as the agent, and knows that which is superior [i.e. different from.] to the alities, he attains My nature.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन्देही देहसमुद्भवान्। जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्विमुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते
transliteration: guṇānetānatītya trīndehī dehasamudbhavān, janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhairvimukto'mṛtamaśnute
hindi_meaning: देहधारी (विवेकी मनुष्य) देहको उत्पन्न करनेवाले इन तीनों गुणोंका अतिक्रमण करके जन्म, मृत्यु और वृद्धावस्थारूप दुःखोंसे रहित हुआ अमरताका अनुभव करता है।
english_meaning: Having transcended these three alities which are the origin of the body, the embodied one, becoming free from birth, death, old age and sorrows, experiences Immortality.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: कैर्लिंगैस्त्रीन्गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो। किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणानतिवर्तते
transliteration: kairliṃgaistrīnguṇānetānatīto bhavati prabho, kimācāraḥ kathaṃ caitāṃstrīnguṇānativartate
hindi_meaning: अर्जुन बोले -- हे प्रभो ! इन तीनों गुणोंसे अतीत हुआ मनुष्य किन लक्षणोंसे युक्त होता है? उसके आचरण कैसे होते हैं? और इन तीनों गुणोंका अतिक्रमण कैसे किया जा सकता है?
english_meaning: Arjuna said O Lord, by what signs is one (known) who has gone beyond these three alities? What is his behaviour, and how does he transcend these three alities?
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव। न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति
transliteration: prakāśaṃ ca pravṛttiṃ ca mohameva ca pāṇḍava, na dveṣṭi sampravṛttāni na nivṛttāni kāṅkṣati
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले -- हे पाण्डव ! प्रकाश, प्रवृत्ति तथा मोह -- ये सभी अच्छी तरहसे प्रवृत्त हो जायँ तो भी गुणातीत मनुष्य इनसे द्वेष नहीं करता, और ये सभी निवृत्त हो जायँ तो इनकी इच्छा नहीं करता।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said O son of Pandu, he neither dislikes illumination (knowledge), activity and delusion when they appear, nor does he long for them when they disappear.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते। गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येव योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते
transliteration: udāsīnavadāsīno guṇairyo na vicālyate, guṇā vartanta ityeva yo'vatiṣṭhati neṅgate
hindi_meaning: जो उदासीनकी तरह स्थित है और जो गुणोंके द्वारा विचलित नहीं किया जा सकता तथा गुण ही (गुणोंमें) बरत रहे हैं -- इस भावसे जो अपने स्वरूपमें ही स्थित रहता है और स्वयं कोई भी चेष्टा नहीं करता।
english_meaning: He who, sitting like one indifferent, is not distracted by the three alities; he who, thinking that the alities alone act, remains firm and surely does not move;
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः। तुल्यप्रियाप्रियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः
transliteration: samaduḥkhasukhaḥ svasthaḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ, tulyapriyāpriyo dhīrastulyanindātmasaṃstutiḥ
hindi_meaning: जो धीर मनुष्य सुख-दुःखमें सम तथा अपने स्वरूपमें स्थित रहता है; जो मिट्टीके ढेले, पत्थर और सोनेमें सम रहता है जो प्रिय-अप्रियमें तथा अपनी निन्दा-स्तुतिमें सम रहता है; जो मान-अपमानमें तथा मित्र-शत्रुके पक्षमें सम रहता है जो सम्पूर्ण कर्मोंके आरम्भका त्यागी है, वह मनुष्य गुणातीत कहा जाता है।
english_meaning: He to whom sorrow and happiness are alike, who is established in his own Self, to whom a lump of earth, iron and gold are the same, to whom the agreeable and the disagreeable are the same, who is wise, to whom censure and his own praise are the same;
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः। सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते
transliteration: mānāpamānayostulyastulyo mitrāripakṣayoḥ, sarvārambhaparityāgī guṇātītaḥ sa ucyate
hindi_meaning: जो धीर मनुष्य सुख-दुःखमें सम तथा अपने स्वरूपमें स्थित रहता है; जो मिट्टीके ढेले, पत्थर और सोनेमें सम रहता है जो प्रिय-अप्रियमें तथा अपनी निन्दा-स्तुतिमें सम रहता है जो मान-अपमानमें तथा मित्र-शत्रुके पक्षमें सम रहता है; जो सम्पूर्ण कर्मोंके आरम्भका त्यागी है, वह मनुष्य गुणातीत कहा जाता है।
english_meaning: He who is the same under honour and dishonour, who is eally disposed both towards the side of the friend and of the foe, who has renounced all enterprise,-he is said to have gone beyond the alities.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्ितयोगेन सेवते। स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान् ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते
transliteration: māṃ ca yo'vyabhicāreṇa bhakिtayogena sevate, sa guṇānsamatītyaitān brahmabhūyāya kalpate
hindi_meaning: जो मनुष्य अव्यभिचारी भक्तियोगके द्वारा मेरा सेवन करता है, वह इन गुणोंका अतिक्रमण करके ब्रह्मप्राप्तिका पात्र हो जाता है।
english_meaning: And he who serves Me through the unswerving Yoga of Devotion, he, having gone beyond these alities, alifies for becoming Brahman.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाऽहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च। शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च
transliteration: brahmaṇo hi pratiṣṭhā'hamamṛtasyāvyayasya ca, śāśvatasya ca dharmasya sukhasyaikāntikasya ca
hindi_meaning: क्योंकि ब्रह्म, अविनाशी अमृत, शाश्वत धर्म और ऐकान्तिक सुखका आश्रय मैं ही हूँ।
english_meaning: For I am the Abode of Brahman-the indestructible and immutable, the eternal, the Dharma and absolute Bliss.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: ऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम्। छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित्
transliteration: ūrdhvamūlamadhaḥśākhamaśvatthaṃ prāhuravyayam, chandāṃsi yasya parṇāni yastaṃ veda sa vedavit
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले -- ऊपरकी ओर मूलवाले तथा नीचेकी ओर शाखावाले जिस संसाररूप अश्वत्थवृक्षको अव्यय कहते हैं और वेद जिसके पत्ते हैं, उस संसारवृक्षको जो जानता है, वह सम्पूर्ण वेदोंको जाननेवाला है।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said They say that the peepul Tree, which has its roots upward and the branches downward, and of which the Vedas are the leaves, is imperishable. He who realizes it is knower of the Vedas.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखा गुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः। अधश्च मूलान्यनुसन्ततानि कर्मानुबन्धीनि मनुष्यलोके
transliteration: adhaścordhvaṃ prasṛtāstasya śākhā guṇapravṛddhā viṣayapravālāḥ, adhaśca mūlānyanusantatāni karmānubandhīni manuṣyaloke
hindi_meaning: उस संसारवृक्षकी गुणों-(सत्त्व, रज और तम-) के द्वारा बढ़ी हुई तथा विषयरूप कोंपलोंवाली शाखाएँ नीचे, मध्यमें और ऊपर सब जगह फैली हुई हैं। मनुष्यलोकमें कर्मोंके अनुसार बाँधनेवाले मूल भी नीचे और ऊपर (सभी लोकोंमें) व्याप्त हो रहे हैं।
english_meaning: The branches of that (Tree), extending down-wards and upwards, are strengthened by the alities and have sense-objects as their shoots. And the roots, which are followed by actions, spread down-wards in the human world [According to A.G. and M.S. manusya-loke means a body distinguished by Brahminhood etc.].
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यते नान्तो न चादिर्न च संप्रतिष्ठा। अश्वत्थमेनं सुविरूढमूल मसङ्गशस्त्रेण दृढेन छित्त्वा
transliteration: na rūpamasyeha tathopalabhyate nānto na cādirna ca saṃpratiṣṭhā, aśvatthamenaṃ suvirūḍhamūla masaṅgaśastreṇa dṛḍhena chittvā
hindi_meaning: इस संसारवृक्षका जैसा रूप देखनेमें आता है, वैसा यहाँ (विचार करनेपर) मिलता नहीं; क्योंकि इसका न तो आदि है, न अन्त है और न स्थिति ही है। इसलिये इस दृढ़ मूलोंवाले संसाररूप अश्वत्थवृक्षको दृढ़ असङ्गतारूप शस्त्रके द्वारा काटकर --
english_meaning: Its form is not perceived here in that way; nor its end, nor beginning, nor continuance, After felling this Peepul whose roots are well developed, with the strong sword of detachment-;
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: ततः पदं तत्परिमार्गितव्यम् यस्मिन्गता न निवर्तन्ति भूयः। तमेव चाद्यं पुरुषं प्रपद्ये यतः प्रवृत्तिः प्रसृता पुराणी
transliteration: tataḥ padaṃ tatparimārgitavyam yasmingatā na nivartanti bhūyaḥ, tameva cādyaṃ puruṣaṃ prapadye yataḥ pravṛttiḥ prasṛtā purāṇī
hindi_meaning: उसके बाद उस परमपद-(परमात्मा-) की खोज करनी चाहिये जिसको प्राप्त होनेपर मनुष्य फिर लौटकर संसारमें नहीं आते और जिससे अनादिकालसे चली आनेवाली यह सृष्टि विस्तारको प्राप्त हुई है, उस आदिपुरुष परमात्माके ही मैं शरण हूँ।
english_meaning: Thereafter, that State has to be sought for, going where they do not return again: I take refuge in that Primeval Person Himself, from whom has ensued the eternal Manifestation.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषा अध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः। द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञै र्गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत्
transliteration: nirmānamohā jitasaṅgadoṣā adhyātmanityā vinivṛttakāmāḥ, dvandvairvimuktāḥ sukhaduḥkhasaṃjñai rgacchantyamūḍhāḥ padamavyayaṃ tat
hindi_meaning: जो मान और मोहसे रहित हो गये हैं, जिन्होंने आसक्तिसे होनेवाले दोषोंको जीत लिया है, जो नित्य-निरन्तर परमात्मामें ही लगे हुए हैं, जो (अपनी दृष्टिसे) सम्पूर्ण कामनाओंसे रहित हो गये हैं, जो सुख-दुःखरूप द्वन्द्वोंसे मुक्त हो गये हैं, ऐसे (ऊँची स्थितिवाले) मोहरहित साधक भक्त उस अविनाशी परमपद-(परमात्मा-) को प्राप्त होते हैं।
english_meaning: The wise ones who are free from pride and non-discrimination, who have conered the evil of association, [Hatred and love arising from association with foes and friends.] who are ever devoted to spirituality, completely free from desires, free from the dualities called happiness and sorrow, reach that undecaying State.
practical_guidance: You cannot undo the past, only respond to it now. Forgive yourself as you would a dear friend who made a mistake. Then take one right action today.

sanskrit_text: न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः। यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम
transliteration: na tadbhāsayate sūryo na śaśāṅko na pāvakaḥ, yadgatvā na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama
hindi_meaning: उस-(परमपद-) को न सूर्य, न चन्द्र और न अग्नि ही प्रकाशित कर सकती है; और जिसको प्राप्त होकर जीव लौटकर (संसारमें) नहीं आते, वही मेरा परमधाम है।
english_meaning: Neither the sun nor the moon nor fire illumines That. That is My supreme Abode, reaching which they do not return.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः। मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति॥
transliteration: mamaivamso jiva-loke jiva-bhutah sanatanah, manah-sasthani indriyani prakrti-sthani karsati
hindi_meaning: इस जीवलोक में मेरा ही सनातन अंश जीव बनकर मन सहित छह इन्द्रियों को प्रकृति में रहते हुए आकर्षित करता है।
english_meaning: The living entities in this conditioned world are My eternal fragmental parts. Due to conditioned life, they are struggling very hard with the six senses, which include the mind.
practical_guidance: You are not an accident of biology — you are an eternal fragment of the divine, temporarily clothed in a body. When you feel worthless, lost, or insignificant, return to this truth. You carry the divine spark within you. Let that truth shape how you treat yourself and others today.

sanskrit_text: शरीरं यदवाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः। गृहीत्वैतानि संयाति वायुर्गन्धानिवाशयात्
transliteration: śarīraṃ yadavāpnoti yaccāpyutkrāmatīśvaraḥ, gṛhītvaitāni saṃyāti vāyurgandhānivāśayāt
hindi_meaning: जैसे वायु गन्धके स्थानसे गन्धको ग्रहण करके ले जाती है, ऐसे ही शरीरादिका स्वामी बना हुआ जीवात्मा भी जिस शरीरको छोड़ता है, वहाँसे मनसहित इन्द्रियोंको ग्रहण करके फिर जिस शरीरको प्राप्त होता है, उसमें चला जाता है।
english_meaning: When the master leaves it and even when he assumes a body, he departs taking these, as wind (carries away) odours from their receptacles.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च। अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते
transliteration: śrotraṃ cakṣuḥ sparśanaṃ ca rasanaṃ ghrāṇameva ca, adhiṣṭhāya manaścāyaṃ viṣayānupasevate
hindi_meaning: यह जीवात्मा मनका आश्रय लेकर श्रोत्र, नेत्र, त्वचा, रसना और घ्राण -- इन पाँचों इन्द्रियोंके द्वारा विषयोंका सेवन करता है।
english_meaning: This one enjoys the objects by presiding over the ear, eyes, skin and tongue as also the nose and the mind.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम्। विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः
transliteration: utkrāmantaṃ sthitaṃ vāpi bhuñjānaṃ vā guṇānvitam, vimūḍhā nānupaśyanti paśyanti jñānacakṣuṣaḥ
hindi_meaning: शरीरको छोड़कर जाते हुए या दूसरे शरीरमें स्थित हुए अथवा विषयोंको भोगते हुए भी गुणोंसे युक्त जीवात्माके स्वरूपको मूढ़ मनुष्य नहीं जानते, ज्ञानरूपी नेत्रोंवाले ज्ञानी मनुष्य ही जानते हैं।
english_meaning: Persons who are diversely deluded do not see it even when it is leaving or residing (in this body), or experiencing, or in association with the alities. Those with the eye of knowledge see.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम्। यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्यचेतसः
transliteration: yatanto yoginaścainaṃ paśyantyātmanyavasthitam, yatanto'pyakṛtātmāno nainaṃ paśyantyacetasaḥ
hindi_meaning: यत्न करनेवाले योगीलोग अपने-आपमें स्थित इस परमात्मतत्त्वका अनुभव करते हैं। परन्तु जिन्होंने अपना अन्तःकरण शुद्ध नहीं किया है, ऐसे अविवेकी मनुष्य यत्न करनेपर भी इस तत्त्वका अनुभव नहीं करते।
english_meaning: And the yogis who are diligent see this one as existing in themselves. The non-discriminating ones who lack self-control do not see this one-though (they be) diligent.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयतेऽखिलम्। यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम्
transliteration: yadādityagataṃ tejo jagadbhāsayate'khilam, yaccandramasi yaccāgnau tattejo viddhi māmakam
hindi_meaning: सूर्यमें आया हुआ जो तेज सम्पूर्ण जगत् को प्रकाशित करता है और जो तेज चन्द्रमामें है तथा जो तेज अग्निमें है, उस तेजको मेरा ही जान।
english_meaning: That light in the sun which illumines the whole world, that which is in the moon, and that which is in fire,-know that light to be Mine.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा। पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः
transliteration: gāmāviśya ca bhūtāni dhārayāmyahamojasā, puṣṇāmi cauṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ
hindi_meaning: मैं ही पृथ्वीमें प्रविष्ट होकर अपनी शक्तिसे समस्त प्राणियोंको धारण करता हूँ; और मैं ही रसमय चन्द्रमाके रूपमें समस्त ओषधियों-(वनस्पतियों-) को पुष्ट करता हूँ।
english_meaning: And entering the earth I sustain the beings through (My) power; and nourish all the plants by becoming Soma [According to S. and most other translators, Soma means the moon.-Tr.] which is of the nature of sap.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः। प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम्
transliteration: ahaṃ vaiśvānaro bhūtvā prāṇināṃ dehamāśritaḥ, prāṇāpānasamāyuktaḥ pacāmyannaṃ caturvidham
hindi_meaning: प्राणियोंके शरीरमें रहनेवाला मैं प्राण-अपानसे युक्त वैश्वानर होकर चार प्रकारके अन्नको पचाता हूँ।
english_meaning: Taking the form of Vaisvanara and residing in the bodies of creatures, I, in association with Prana and Apana, digest the four kinds of food.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च। वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो वेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम्
transliteration: sarvasya cāhaṃ hṛdi sanniviṣṭo mattaḥ smṛtirjñānamapohanaṃ ca, vedaiśca sarvairahameva vedyo vedāntakṛdvedavideva cāham
hindi_meaning: मैं सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके हृदयमें स्थित हूँ। मेरेसे ही स्मृति, ज्ञान और अपोहन (संशय आदि दोषोंका नाश) होता है। सम्पूर्ण वेदोंके द्वारा मैं ही जाननेयोग्य हूँ। वेदोंके तत्त्वका निर्णय करनेवाला और वेदोंको जाननेवाला भी मैं ही हूँ।
english_meaning: And I am seated in the hearts of all. From Me are memory, knowledge and their loss. I alone am the object to be known through all the Vedas; I am also the originator of the Vedanta, and I Myself am the knower of the Vedas.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च। क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते
transliteration: dvāvimau puruṣau loke kṣaraścākṣara eva ca, kṣaraḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni kūṭastho'kṣara ucyate
hindi_meaning: इस संसारमें क्षर (नाशवान्) और अक्षर (अविनाशी) -- ये दो प्रकारके पुरुष हैं। सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके शरीर नाशवान् और कूटस्थ (जीवात्मा) अविनाशी कहा जाता है।
english_meaning: There are these two persons in the world-the mutable and the immutable. The mutable consists of all things; the one existing as Maya is called the immutable.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युदाहृतः। यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः
transliteration: uttamaḥ puruṣastvanyaḥ paramātmetyudāhṛtaḥ, yo lokatrayamāviśya bibhartyavyaya īśvaraḥ
hindi_meaning: उत्तम पुरुष तो अन्य ही है, जो परमात्मा नामसे कहा गया है। वही अविनाशी ईश्वर तीनों लोकोंमें प्रविष्ट होकर सबका भरण-पोषण करता है।
english_meaning: But different is th supreme Person who is spoken of as the transcendental Self, who, permeating the three worlds, upholds (them), and is the imperisahble God.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: यस्मात्क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः। अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः
transliteration: yasmātkṣaramatīto'hamakṣarādapi cottamaḥ, ato'smi loke vede ca prathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
hindi_meaning: मैं क्षरसे अतीत हूँ और अक्षरसे भी उत्तम हूँ, इसलिये लोकमें और वेदमें पुरुषोत्तम नामसे प्रसिद्ध हूँ।
english_meaning: Since I am transcendental to the mutable and above even the immutable, hence I am well known in the world and in the Vedas as the supreme Person.
practical_guidance: You cannot undo the past, only respond to it now. Forgive yourself as you would a dear friend who made a mistake. Then take one right action today.

sanskrit_text: यो मामेवमसम्मूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम्। स सर्वविद्भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत
transliteration: yo māmevamasammūḍho jānāti puruṣottamam, sa sarvavidbhajati māṃ sarvabhāvena bhārata
hindi_meaning: हे भरतवंशी अर्जुन ! इस प्रकार जो मोहरहित मनुष्य मुझे पुरुषोत्तम जानता है, वह सर्वज्ञ सब प्रकारसे मेरा ही भजन करता है।
english_meaning: O scion of the Bharata dynasty, he who, being free from delusion, knows Me the supreme Person thus, he is all-knowing and adores Me with his whole being.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयाऽनघ। एतद्बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भारत
transliteration: iti guhyatamaṃ śāstramidamuktaṃ mayā'nagha, etadbuddhvā buddhimānsyātkṛtakṛtyaśca bhārata
hindi_meaning: हे निष्पाप अर्जुन ! इस प्रकार यह अत्यन्त गोपनीय शास्त्र मेरे द्वारा कहा गया है। हे भरतवंशी अर्जुन ! इसको जानकर मनुष्य ज्ञानवान् (तथा प्राप्त-प्राप्तव्य) और कृतकृत्य हो जाता है।
english_meaning: O sinless one, this most secret scripture has thus been uttered by Me. Understanding this, one becomes wise and has his duties fulfilled, O scion of the Bharata dynasty.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिः ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः। दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम्
transliteration: abhayaṃ sattvasaṃśuddhiḥ jñānayogavyavasthitiḥ, dānaṃ damaśca yajñaśca svādhyāyastapa ārjavam
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले -- भयका सर्वथा अभाव; अन्तःकरणकी शुद्धि; ज्ञानके लिये योगमें दृढ़ स्थिति; सात्त्विक दान; इन्द्रियोंका दमन; यज्ञ; स्वाध्याय; कर्तव्य-पालनके लिये कष्ट सहना; शरीर-मन-वाणीकी सरलता।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said Fearlessness, purity of mind, persistence in knowledge and yoga, charity and control of the external organs, sacrifice, (scriptural) study, austerity and recititude;
practical_guidance: Notice where your attention is — on outcomes you cannot control? Gently bring it back to this moment, and to the one action you can take right now.

sanskrit_text: अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम्। दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम्
transliteration: ahiṃsā satyamakrodhastyāgaḥ śāntirapaiśunam, dayā bhūteṣvaloluptvaṃ mārdavaṃ hrīracāpalam
hindi_meaning: अहिंसा, सत्यभाषण; क्रोध न करना; संसारकी कामनाका त्याग; अन्तःकरणमें राग-द्वेषजनित हलचलका न होना; चुगली न करना; प्राणियोंपर दया करना सांसारिक विषयोंमें न ललचाना; अन्तःकरणकी कोमलता; अकर्तव्य करनेमें लज्जा; चपलताका अभाव।
english_meaning: Non-injury, truthfulness, absence of anger, renunciation, control of the internal organ, absence of vilification, kindness to creatures, non-covetousness, gentleness, modesty, freedom from restlessness;
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता। भवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत॥
transliteration: tejah ksama dhrtih saucam adroho natimanita, bhavanti sampadam daivim abhijatasya bharata
hindi_meaning: तेज, क्षमा, धैर्य, शुद्धता, द्रोह का अभाव और अभिमान का न होना — ये सब हे भारत, दैवी सम्पदा में जन्मे पुरुष के गुण हैं।
english_meaning: Splendor, forgiveness, fortitude, cleanliness, freedom from envy and the passion for honor — these qualities belong to godly people.
practical_guidance: Of all the divine qualities listed here, choose one to consciously practice today. If forgiveness is your challenge, forgive one small slight. If fortitude is needed, hold your ground with calm strength in a difficult situation. Character is built one virtue at a time.

sanskrit_text: दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च। अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ सम्पदमासुरीम्
transliteration: dambho darpo'bhimānaśca krodhaḥ pāruṣyameva ca, ajñānaṃ cābhijātasya pārtha sampadamāsurīm
hindi_meaning: हे पृथानन्दन ! दम्भ करना, घमण्ड करना, अभिमान करना, क्रोध करना, कठोरता रखना और अविवेकका होना भी -- ये सभी आसुरीसम्पदाको प्राप्त हुए मनुष्यके लक्षण हैं।
english_meaning: O son of Prtha, (the attributes) of one destined to have the demoniacal nature are religious ostentation, pride and haughtiness, [Another reading is abhimanah, self-conceit.-Tr.], anger as also rudeness and ignorance.
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: दैवी सम्पद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता। मा शुचः सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव
transliteration: daivī sampadvimokṣāya nibandhāyāsurī matā, mā śucaḥ sampadaṃ daivīmabhijāto'si pāṇḍava
hindi_meaning: दैवी-सम्पत्ति मुक्तिके लिये और आसुरी-सम्पत्ति बन्धनके लिये है। हे पाण्डव तुम दैवी-सम्पत्तिको प्राप्त हुए हो, इसलिये तुम्हें शोक (चिन्ता) नहीं करना चाहिये।
english_meaning: The divine nature is the Liberation, the demoniacal is considered to be for inevitable bondage. Do not grieve, O son of Pandu! You are destined to have the divine nature.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन् दैव आसुर एव च। दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे श्रृणु
transliteration: dvau bhūtasargau loke'smin daiva āsura eva ca, daivo vistaraśaḥ prokta āsuraṃ pārtha me śrṛṇu
hindi_meaning: इस लोकमें दो तरहके प्राणियोंकी सृष्टि है -- दैवी और आसुरी। दैवीका तो मैंने विस्तारसे वर्णन कर दिया, अब हे पार्थ ! तुम मेरेसे आसुरीका विस्तार सुनो।
english_meaning: In this world there are are two (kinds of) creation of beings: the divine and the demoniacal. The divine has been spoken of elaborately. Hear about the demoniacal from Me, O son of Prtha.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः। न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते
transliteration: pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca janā na vidurāsurāḥ, na śaucaṃ nāpi cācāro na satyaṃ teṣu vidyate
hindi_meaning: आसुरी प्रकृतिवाले मनुष्य प्रवृत्ति और निवृत्तिको नहीं जानते और उनमें न बाह्यशुद्धि, न श्रेष्ठ आचरण तथा न सत्य-पालन ही होता है।
english_meaning: Neither do the demoniacal persons under-stand what is to be done and what is not to be done; nor does purity, or even good conduct or truthfulness exist in them.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं ते जगदाहुरनीश्वरम्। अपरस्परसम्भूतं किमन्यत्कामहैतुकम्
transliteration: asatyamapratiṣṭhaṃ te jagadāhuranīśvaram, aparasparasambhūtaṃ kimanyatkāmahaitukam
hindi_meaning: वे कहा करते हैं कि संसार असत्य, अप्रतिष्ठित और बिना ईश्वरके अपने-आप केवल स्त्री-पुरुषके संयोगसे पैदा हुआ है। इसलिये काम ही इसका कारण है, और कोई कारण नहीं है।
english_meaning: They say that the world is unreal, it has no basis, it is without a God. It is born of mutual union brought about by passion! What other (cause can there be)?
practical_guidance: Cravings are temporary visitors — they will pass. When an urge arises, pause for three slow breaths before responding. The gap is where freedom lives.

sanskrit_text: एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः। प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतोऽहिताः
transliteration: etāṃ dṛṣṭimavaṣṭabhya naṣṭātmāno'lpabuddhayaḥ, prabhavantyugrakarmāṇaḥ kṣayāya jagato'hitāḥ
hindi_meaning: उपर्युक्त (नास्तिक) दृष्टिका आश्रय लेनेवाले जो मनुष्य अपने नित्य स्वरूपको नहीं मानते, जिनकी बुद्धि तुच्छ है, जो उग्रकर्मा और संसारके शत्रु हैं, उन मनुष्योंकी सामर्थ्यका उपयोग जगत्का नाश करनेके लिये ही होता है।
english_meaning: Holding on to this view, (these people) who are of depraved character, of poor intellect, given to fearful actions and harmful, wax strong for the ruin of the world.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: काममाश्रित्य दुष्पूरं दम्भमानमदान्विताः। मोहाद्गृहीत्वासद्ग्राहान्प्रवर्तन्तेऽशुचिव्रताः
transliteration: kāmamāśritya duṣpūraṃ dambhamānamadānvitāḥ, mohādgṛhītvāsadgrāhānpravartante'śucivratāḥ
hindi_meaning: कभी पूरी न होनेवाली कामनाओंका आश्रय लेकर दम्भ, अभिमान और मदमें चूर रहनेवाले तथा अपवित्र व्रत धारण करनेवाले मनुष्य मोहके कारण दुराग्रहोंको धारण करके संसारमें विचरते रहते हैं।
english_meaning: Giving themselves up to insatiable passion, filled with vanity, pride and arrogance, adopting bad abjectives due to delusion, and having impure resolves, they engage in actions.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: चिन्तामपरिमेयां च प्रलयान्तामुपाश्रिताः। कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्िचताः
transliteration: cintāmaparimeyāṃ ca pralayāntāmupāśritāḥ, kāmopabhogaparamā etāvaditi niśिcatāḥ
hindi_meaning: वे मृत्युपर्यन्त रहनेवाली अपार चिन्ताओंका आश्रय लेनेवाले, पदार्थोंका संग्रह और उनका भोग करनेमें ही लगे रहनेवाले और 'जो कुछ है, वह इतना ही है' -- ऐसा निश्चय करनेवाले होते हैं।
english_meaning: Beset with innumerable cares which end (only) with death, holding that the enjoyment of desirable objects is the highest goal, feeling sure that this is all.
practical_guidance: Sit quietly for five minutes. Ask: 'What is the most meaningful thing I can contribute?' Let the answer arise naturally, without forcing it.

sanskrit_text: आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः कामक्रोधपरायणाः। ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थसञ्चयान्
transliteration: āśāpāśaśatairbaddhāḥ kāmakrodhaparāyaṇāḥ, īhante kāmabhogārthamanyāyenārthasañcayān
hindi_meaning: वे आशाकी सैकड़ों फाँसियोंसे बँधे हुए मनुष्य काम-क्रोधके परायण होकर पदार्थोंका भोग करनेके लिये अन्यायपूर्वक धन-संचय करनेकी चेष्टा करते रहते हैं।
english_meaning: Bound by hundreds of shackles in the form of hope, giving themselves wholly to passion and anger, they endeavour to amass wealth through foul means for the enjoyment of desirable objects.
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: इदमद्य मया लब्धमिमं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम्। इदमस्तीदमपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम्
transliteration: idamadya mayā labdhamimaṃ prāpsye manoratham, idamastīdamapi me bhaviṣyati punardhanam
hindi_meaning: इतनी वस्तुएँ तो हमने आज प्राप्त कर लीं और अब इस मनोरथको प्राप्त (पूरा) कर लेंगे।,इतना धन तो हमारे पास है ही, इतना धन फिर हो जायगा।
english_meaning: 'This has been gained by me today; I shall acire this desired object. This is in hand; again, this wealth also will come to me.'
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरानपि। ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान्सुखी
transliteration: asau mayā hataḥ śatrurhaniṣye cāparānapi, īśvaro'hamahaṃ bhogī siddho'haṃ balavānsukhī
hindi_meaning: वह शत्रु तो हमारे द्वारा मारा गया और उन दूसरे शत्रुओंको भी हम मार डालेंगे। हम सर्वसमर्थ हैं। हमारे पास भोग-सामग्री बहुत है। हम सिद्ध हैं। हम बड़े बलवान् और सुखी हैं।
english_meaning: 'That enemy has been killed by me, and I shall kill others as well. I am the lord, I am the enjoyer, I am well-established, mighty and happy.'
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: आढ्योऽभिजनवानस्मि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सदृशो मया। यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः
transliteration: āḍhyo'bhijanavānasmi ko'nyo'sti sadṛśo mayā, yakṣye dāsyāmi modiṣya ityajñānavimohitāḥ
hindi_meaning: हम धनवान् हैं, बहुत-से मनुष्य हमारे पास हैं, हमारे समान और कौन है? हम खूब यज्ञ करेंगे, दान देंगे और मौज करेंगे -- इस तरह वे अज्ञानसे मोहित रहते हैं।
english_meaning: 'I am rich and high-born; who else is there similar to me? I shall perform sacrifices; I shall give, I shall rejoice,'-thus they are diversely deluded by non-discrimination.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजालसमावृताः। प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ
transliteration: anekacittavibhrāntā mohajālasamāvṛtāḥ, prasaktāḥ kāmabhogeṣu patanti narake'śucau
hindi_meaning: कामनाओंके कारण तरह-तरहसे भ्रमित चित्तवाले, मोह-जालमें अच्छी तरहसे फँसे हुए तथा पदार्थों और भोगोंमें अत्यन्त आसक्त रहनेवाले मनुष्य भयङ्कर नरकोंमें गिरते हैं।
english_meaning: Bewildered by numerous thoughts, caught in the net of delusion, (and) engrossed in the enjoyment of desirable objects, they fall into a foul hell.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: आत्मसम्भाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः। यजन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम्
transliteration: ātmasambhāvitāḥ stabdhā dhanamānamadānvitāḥ, yajante nāmayajñaiste dambhenāvidhipūrvakam
hindi_meaning: अपनेको सबसे अधिक पूज्य माननेवाले, अकड़ रखनेवाले तथा धन और मानके मदमें चूर रहनेवाले वे मनुष्य दम्भसे अविधिपूर्वक नाममात्रके यज्ञोंसे यजन करते हैं।
english_meaning: Self-conceited, haughty, filled with pride and intoxication of wealth, they perform sacrifices which are so in name only, with ostentation and regardless of the injunctions.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः। मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः
transliteration: ahaṅkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca saṃśritāḥ, māmātmaparadeheṣu pradviṣanto'bhyasūyakāḥ
hindi_meaning: वे अहङ्कार, हठ, घमण्ड, कामना और क्रोधका आश्रय लेनेवाले मनुष्य अपने और दूसरोंके शरीरमें रहनेवाले मुझ अन्तर्यामीके साथ द्वेष करते हैं तथा (मेरे और दूसरोंके गुणोंमें) दोष-दृष्टि रखते हैं।
english_meaning: Resorting to egotism, power, arrogance, passion and anger, hating Me in their own and others' bodies, (they become) [As the finite verb is missing in the verse, we have supplied 'they become'. S. adds the verb prabhavanti, wax strong, from verse 9, and constructs the last portion thus: '৷৷.the envious ones wax strond.' Following S. S., however, one may combine this verse with the preceding verse by taking 'perform sacrifices' as the finite verb.-Tr.'] envious by nature.
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: तानहं द्विषतः क्रूरान्संसारेषु नराधमान्। क्षिपाम्यजस्रमशुभानासुरीष्वेव योनिषु
transliteration: tānahaṃ dviṣataḥ krūrānsaṃsāreṣu narādhamān, kṣipāmyajasramaśubhānāsurīṣveva yoniṣu
hindi_meaning: उन द्वेष करनेवाले, क्रूर स्वभाववाले और संसारमें महान् नीच, अपवित्र मनुष्योंको मैं बार-बार आसुरी योनियोंमें गिराता ही रहता हूँ।
english_meaning: I cast for ever those hateful, cruel, evil-doers in the worlds, the vilest of human beings, verily into the demoniacla classes.
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: आसुरीं योनिमापन्ना मूढा जन्मनि जन्मनि। मामप्राप्यैव कौन्तेय ततो यान्त्यधमां गतिम्
transliteration: āsurīṃ yonimāpannā mūḍhā janmani janmani, māmaprāpyaiva kaunteya tato yāntyadhamāṃ gatim
hindi_meaning: हे कुन्तीनन्दन ! वे मूढ मनुष्य मेरेको प्राप्त न करके ही जन्म-जन्मान्तरमें आसुरी योनिको प्राप्त होते हैं, फिर उससे भी अधिक अधम गतिमें अर्थात् भयङ्कर नरकोंमें चले जाते हैं।
english_meaning: Being born among the demoniacal species in births after births, the foods, without ever reaching Me, O son of Kunti, attain conditions lower than that.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः। कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत्
transliteration: trividhaṃ narakasyedaṃ dvāraṃ nāśanamātmanaḥ, kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobhastasmādetattrayaṃ tyajet
hindi_meaning: काम, क्रोध और लोभ -- ये तीन प्रकारके नरकके दरवाजे जीवात्माका पतन करनेवाले हैं, इसलिये इन तीनोंका त्याग कर देना चाहिये।
english_meaning: This door of hell, which is the destroyer of the soul, is of three kinds-passion, anger and also greed. Therefore one should forsake these three.
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: एतैर्विमुक्तः कौन्तेय तमोद्वारैस्त्रिभिर्नरः। आचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां गतिम्
transliteration: etairvimuktaḥ kaunteya tamodvāraistribhirnaraḥ, ācaratyātmanaḥ śreyastato yāti parāṃ gatim
hindi_meaning: हे कुन्तीनन्दन ! इन नरकके तीनों दरवाजोंसे रहित हुआ जो मनुष्य अपने कल्याणका आचरण करता है, वह परमगतिको प्राप्त हो जाता है।
english_meaning: O son of Kunti, a person who is free from these three doors to darkness strives for the good of the soul. Ther y he attains the highest Goal.
practical_guidance: Sit quietly for five minutes. Ask: 'What is the most meaningful thing I can contribute?' Let the answer arise naturally, without forcing it.

sanskrit_text: यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः। न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम्
transliteration: yaḥ śāstravidhimutsṛjya vartate kāmakārataḥ, na sa siddhimavāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim
hindi_meaning: जो मनुष्य शास्त्रविधिको छोड़कर अपनी इच्छासे मनमाना आचरण करता है, वह न सिद्धि-(अन्तःकरणकी शुद्धि-) को, न सुखको और न परमगतिको ही प्राप्त होता है।
english_meaning: Ignoring the precept of the scriptures, he who acts under the impulsion of passion,-he does not attain perfection, nor happiness, nor the supreme Goal.
practical_guidance: Sit quietly for five minutes. Ask: 'What is the most meaningful thing I can contribute?' Let the answer arise naturally, without forcing it.

sanskrit_text: तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ। ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि
transliteration: tasmācchāstraṃ pramāṇaṃ te kāryākāryavyavasthitau, jñātvā śāstravidhānoktaṃ karma kartumihārhasi
hindi_meaning: अतः तेरे लिये कर्तव्य-अकर्तव्यकी व्यवस्थामें शास्त्र ही प्रमाण है -- ऐसा जानकर तू इस लोकमें शास्त्र-विधिसे नियत कर्तव्य कर्म करनेयोग्य है।
english_meaning: Therefore, the scripture is your authority as regards the determination of what is to be done and what is not to be done. After understanding (your) duty as presented by scriptural injunction, you ought to perform (your duty) here.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: ये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः। तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वमाहो रजस्तमः
transliteration: ye śāstravidhimutsṛjya yajante śraddhayā'nvitāḥ, teṣāṃ niṣṭhā tu kā kṛṣṇa sattvamāho rajastamaḥ
hindi_meaning: अर्जुन बोले -- हे कृष्ण ! जो मनुष्य शास्त्र-विधिका त्याग करके श्रद्धापूर्वक देवता आदिका पूजन करते हैं, उनकी निष्ठा फिर कौन-सी है? सात्त्विकी है अथवा राजसी-तामसी?
english_meaning: Arjuna said But, ['But' is used to present a standpoint distinct from the earlier ones understand from 16.23-4.-S.] O Krsna, what is the state [i.e., where do the rites undertaken by them end?] of those who, endued with faith, adore [Adore-perform sacrifices, distribute wealth etc. in honour of gods and others.] by ignoring the injunctions of the scriptures? Is it sattva, rajas or tamas?
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: त्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा। सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति तां श्रृणु
transliteration: trividhā bhavati śraddhā dehināṃ sā svabhāvajā, sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti tāṃ śrṛṇu
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले -- मनुष्योंकी वह स्वभावसे उत्पन्न हुई श्रद्धा सात्त्विकी तथा राजसी और तामसी -- ऐसे तीन तरहकी ही होती है, उसको तुम मेरेसे सुनो।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said That faith of the embodied beings, born of their own nature, is threefold-born of sattva, rajas and tamas. Hear about it.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत। श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः॥
transliteration: sattvanurupaa sarvasya sraddha bhavati bharata, sraddha-mayo ayam puruso yo yac-chraddha sa eva sah
hindi_meaning: हे भारत, सभी मनुष्यों की श्रद्धा उनकी प्रकृति के अनुसार होती है। यह पुरुष श्रद्धामय है — जो जैसी श्रद्धा रखता है, वह वैसा ही है।
english_meaning: O scion of Bharata, according to one's existence under the various modes of nature, one evolves a particular kind of faith. The living being is said to be of a particular faith according to the modes he has acquired.
practical_guidance: What you have faith in shapes who you are. Take a moment today to examine your deepest beliefs — about yourself, about others, about the world. Are those beliefs lifting you up or pulling you down? You can consciously choose to cultivate faith in goodness, growth, and the divine.

sanskrit_text: यजन्ते सात्त्विका देवान्यक्षरक्षांसि राजसाः। प्रेतान्भूतगणांश्चान्ये यजन्ते तामसा जनाः
transliteration: yajante sāttvikā devānyakṣarakṣāṃsi rājasāḥ, pretānbhūtagaṇāṃścānye yajante tāmasā janāḥ
hindi_meaning: सात्त्विक मनुष्य देवताओंका पूजन करते हैं, राजस मनुष्य यक्षों और राक्षसोंका और दूसरे जो तामस मनुष्य हैं, वे प्रेतों और भूतगणोंका पूजन करते हैं।
english_meaning: Those having the sattva ality worship the gods; those having rajas, the demi-gods and ogres; and other people possessed of tamas worship ghosts and the hosts of spirits.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः। दम्भाहङ्कारसंयुक्ताः कामरागबलान्विताः
transliteration: aśāstravihitaṃ ghoraṃ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ, dambhāhaṅkārasaṃyuktāḥ kāmarāgabalānvitāḥ
hindi_meaning: जो मनुष्य शास्त्रविधिसे रहित घोर तप करते हैं; जो दम्भ और अहङ्कारसे अच्छी तरह युक्त हैं; जो भोग-पदार्थ, आसक्ति और हठसे युक्त हैं; जो शरीरमें स्थित पाँच भूतोंको अर्थात् पाञ्चभौतिक शरीरको तथा अन्तःकरणमें स्थित मुझ परमात्माको भी कृश करनेवाले हैं उन अज्ञानियोंको तू आसुर निश्चयवाले (आसुरी सम्पदावाले) समझ।
english_meaning: Those persons who, given to ostentation and pride, and possessed of passion, attachment and strength, undertake severe austerities not sanctioned in the scriptures;
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: कर्षयन्तः शरीरस्थं भूतग्राममचेतसः। मां चैवान्तःशरीरस्थं तान्विद्ध्यासुरनिश्चयान्
transliteration: karṣayantaḥ śarīrasthaṃ bhūtagrāmamacetasaḥ, māṃ caivāntaḥśarīrasthaṃ tānviddhyāsuraniścayān
hindi_meaning: जो मनुष्य शास्त्रविधिसे रहित घोर तप करते हैं; जो दम्भ और अहङ्कारसे अच्छी तरह युक्त हैं; जो भोग-पदार्थ, आसक्ति और हठसे युक्त हैं; जो शरीरमें स्थित पाँच भूतोंको अर्थात् पाञ्चभौतिक शरीरको तथा अन्तःकरणमें स्थित मुझ परमात्माको भी कृश करनेवाले हैं उन अज्ञानियोंको तू आसुर निश्चयवाले (आसुरी सम्पदावाले) समझ।
english_meaning: (And who,) being non-discriminating, torture, all the organs in the body as also even Me who reside in the body,-know them as possessed of demoniacal conviction.
practical_guidance: You are not your circumstances, roles, or emotions. Take a moment to rest in your deepest, unchanging self — the silent witness behind all experience.

sanskrit_text: आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः। यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं श्रृणु
transliteration: āhārastvapi sarvasya trividho bhavati priyaḥ, yajñastapastathā dānaṃ teṣāṃ bhedamimaṃ śrṛṇu
hindi_meaning: आहार भी सबको तीन प्रकारका प्रिय होता है और वैसे ही यज्ञ, दान और तप भी तीन प्रकारके होते हैं अर्थात् शास्त्रीय कर्मोंमें भी तीन प्रकारकी रुचि होती है, तू उनके इस भेदको सुन।
english_meaning: Food also, which is dear to all, is of three kinds; and so also are sacrifices, austerity and charity. Listen to this classification of them.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: आयुःसत्त्वबलारोग्यसुखप्रीतिविवर्धनाः। रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः
transliteration: āyuḥsattvabalārogyasukhaprītivivardhanāḥ, rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hṛdyā āhārāḥ sāttvikapriyāḥ
hindi_meaning: आयु, सत्त्वगुण, बल, आरोग्य, सुख और प्रसन्नता बढ़ानेवाले, स्थिर रहनेवाले, हृदयको शक्ति देनेवाले, रसयुक्त तथा चिकने -- ऐसे आहार अर्थात् भोजन करनेके पदार्थ सात्त्विक मनुष्यको प्रिय होते हैं।
english_meaning: Foods that augment life, firmless of mind, strength, health, happiness and delight, and which are succulent, oleaginous, substantial and agreeable, are dear to one endowed with sattva.
practical_guidance: Fear and courage live side by side. The Gita doesn't ask you to be fearless — only to act rightly despite the fear. Take one brave step today.

sanskrit_text: कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः। आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकामयप्रदाः
transliteration: kaṭvamlalavaṇātyuṣṇatīkṣṇarūkṣavidāhinaḥ, āhārā rājasasyeṣṭā duḥkhaśokāmayapradāḥ
hindi_meaning: अति कड़वे, अति खट्टे, अति नमकीन, अति गरम, अति तीखे, अति रूखे और अति दाहकारक आहार अर्थात् भोजनके पदार्थ राजस मनुष्यको प्रिय होते हैं, जो कि दुःख, शोक और रोगोंको देनेवाले हैं।
english_meaning: Foods that are bitter, sour, salty, very hot, pungent, dry and burning, and which production pain, sorrow and disease, are dear to one having rajas.
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत्। उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम्
transliteration: yātayāmaṃ gatarasaṃ pūti paryuṣitaṃ ca yat, ucchiṣṭamapi cāmedhyaṃ bhojanaṃ tāmasapriyam
hindi_meaning: जो भोजन अधपका, रसरहित, दुर्गन्धित, बासी और उच्छिष्ट है तथा जो महान् अपवित्र भी है, वह तामस मनुष्यको प्रिय होता है।
english_meaning: Food which is not properly cooked, lacking in essence, putrid and stale, and even ort and that which is unfit for sacrifice, is dear to one possessed of tamas.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्यज्ञो विधिदृष्टो य इज्यते। यष्टव्यमेवेति मनः समाधाय स सात्त्विकः
transliteration: aphalākāṅkṣibhiryajño vidhidṛṣṭo ya ijyate, yaṣṭavyameveti manaḥ samādhāya sa sāttvikaḥ
hindi_meaning: यज्ञ करना कर्तव्य है -- इस तरह मनको समाधान करके फलेच्छारहित मनुष्योंद्वारा जो शास्त्रविधिसे नियत यज्ञ किया जाता है, वह सात्त्विक है।
english_meaning: That sacrifice which is in accordance with the injunctions, (and is) performed by persons who do not hanker after results, and with the mental conviction that it is surely obligatory, is done through sattva.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: अभिसंधाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत्। इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम्
transliteration: abhisaṃdhāya tu phalaṃ dambhārthamapi caiva yat, ijyate bharataśreṣṭha taṃ yajñaṃ viddhi rājasam
hindi_meaning: परन्तु हे भरतश्रेष्ठ अर्जुन ! जो यज्ञ फलकी इच्छाको लेकर अथवा दम्भ-(दिखावटीपन-) के लिये भी किया जाता है, उसको तुम राजस समझो।
english_meaning: But that sacrifice which is performed having in veiw a result, as also for ostentation,-know that sacrifice to be done through rajas, O greatest among the descendants of Bharata.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: विधिहीनमसृष्टान्नं मन्त्रहीनमदक्षिणम्। श्रद्धाविरहितं यज्ञं तामसं परिचक्षते
transliteration: vidhihīnamasṛṣṭānnaṃ mantrahīnamadakṣiṇam, śraddhāvirahitaṃ yajñaṃ tāmasaṃ paricakṣate
hindi_meaning: शास्त्रविधिसे हीन, अन्न-दानसे रहित, बिना मन्त्रोंके, बिना दक्षिणाके और बिना श्रद्धाके किये जानेवाले यज्ञको तामस यज्ञ कहते हैं।
english_meaning: They declare that sacrifice as 'done through tamas' which is contrary to injunction, in which food is not distributed, in which mantras are not used, in which offerings are not made to priests, and which is devoid of faith.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: देवद्विजगुरुप्राज्ञपूजनं शौचमार्जवम्। ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसा च शारीरं तप उच्यते
transliteration: devadvijaguruprājñapūjanaṃ śaucamārjavam, brahmacaryamahiṃsā ca śārīraṃ tapa ucyate
hindi_meaning: देवता, ब्राह्मण, गुरुजन और जीवन्मुक्त महापुरुषका पूजन करना, शुद्धि रखना, सरलता, ब्रह्मचर्यका पालन करना और हिंसा न करना -- यह शरीरसम्बन्धी तप कहा जाता है।
english_meaning: The worship of gods, twice-borns, venerable persons and the wise; purity, straightforwardness, celibacy and non-injury,-are said to be bodily austerity.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत्। स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वाङ्मयं तप उच्यते
transliteration: anudvegakaraṃ vākyaṃ satyaṃ priyahitaṃ ca yat, svādhyāyābhyasanaṃ caiva vāṅmayaṃ tapa ucyate
hindi_meaning: उद्वेग न करनेवाला, सत्य, प्रिय, हितकारक भाषण तथा स्वाध्याय और अभ्यास करना -- यह वाणी-सम्बन्धी तप कहा जाता है।
english_meaning: That speech which causes no pain, which is true, agreeable and beneficial; as well as the practice of study of the scriptures,-is said to be austerity of speech.
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: मनःप्रसादः सौम्यत्वं मौनमात्मविनिग्रहः। भावसंशुद्धिरित्येतत्तपो मानसमुच्यते
transliteration: manaḥprasādaḥ saumyatvaṃ maunamātmavinigrahaḥ, bhāvasaṃśuddhirityetattapo mānasamucyate
hindi_meaning: मनकी प्रसन्नता, सौम्य भाव, मननशीलता, मनका निग्रह और भावोंकी शुद्धि -- इस तरह यह मन-सम्बन्धी तप कहा जाता है।
english_meaning: Tranillity of mind, gentleness, reticence, withdrawal of the mind, purity of heart,-these are what is called mental austerity.
practical_guidance: Your mind is your most powerful tool. Spend five minutes today in stillness — not trying to empty it, simply watching it. Observe without judgment.

sanskrit_text: श्रद्धया परया तप्तं तपस्तत्ित्रविधं नरैः। अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्युक्तैः सात्त्विकं परिचक्षते
transliteration: śraddhayā parayā taptaṃ tapastatिtravidhaṃ naraiḥ, aphalākāṅkṣibhiryuktaiḥ sāttvikaṃ paricakṣate
hindi_meaning: परम श्रद्धासे युक्त फलेच्छारहित मनुष्योंके द्वारा तीन प्रकार-(शरीर, वाणी और मन-) का तप किया जाता है, उसको सात्त्विक कहते हैं।
english_meaning: When that threefold austerity is undertaken with supreme faith by people who do not hanker after results and are self-controlled, they speak of it as born of sattva.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: सत्कारमानपूजार्थं तपो दम्भेन चैव यत्। क्रियते तदिह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलमध्रुवम्
transliteration: satkāramānapūjārthaṃ tapo dambhena caiva yat, kriyate tadiha proktaṃ rājasaṃ calamadhruvam
hindi_meaning: जो तप सत्कार, मान और पूजाके लिये तथा दिखानेके भावसे किया जाता है, वह इस लोकमें अनिश्चित और नाशवान् फल देनेवाला तप राजस कहा गया है।
english_meaning: That austerity which is undertaken for earning a name, being honoured and worshipped, and also ostentatiously,-that is spoken of as born of rajas, belonging to this world, uncertain and transitory.
practical_guidance: Offer one act today entirely without expectation — do it as a gift to the divine in all things. Notice the peace and fullness that follows.

sanskrit_text: मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत्पीडया क्रियते तपः। परस्योत्सादनार्थं वा तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्
transliteration: mūḍhagrāheṇātmano yatpīḍayā kriyate tapaḥ, parasyotsādanārthaṃ vā tattāmasamudāhṛtam
hindi_meaning: जो तप मूढ़तापूर्वक हठसे अपनेको पीड़ा देकर अथवा दूसरोंको कष्ट देनेके लिये किया जाता है, वह तप तामस कहा गया है।
english_meaning: That austerity which is undertaken with a foolish intent, by causing pain to oneself, or for the destruction of others-that is said to be born of tamas.
practical_guidance: Grief is valid and natural. Honor your feelings fully. Then, when ready, remember that the soul is eternal — what was truly real can never be lost.

sanskrit_text: दातव्यमिति यद्दानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे। देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम्
transliteration: dātavyamiti yaddānaṃ dīyate'nupakāriṇe, deśe kāle ca pātre ca taddānaṃ sāttvikaṃ smṛtam
hindi_meaning: दान देना कर्तव्य है -- ऐसे भावसे जो दान देश, काल और पात्रके प्राप्त होनेपर अनुपकारीको दिया जाता है, वह दान सात्त्विक कहा गया है।
english_meaning: That gift is referred to as born of sattva which gift is given with the idea that it ought to be given, to one who will not serve in return, and at the (proper) place, (proper) time and to a (proper) person.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: यत्तु प्रत्युपकारार्थं फलमुद्दिश्य वा पुनः। दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद्दानं राजसं स्मृतम्
transliteration: yattu pratyupakārārthaṃ phalamuddiśya vā punaḥ, dīyate ca parikliṣṭaṃ taddānaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam
hindi_meaning: किन्तु जो दान प्रत्युपकारके लिये अथवा फलप्राप्तिका उद्देश्य बनाकर फिर क्लेशपूर्वक दिया जाता है, वह दान राजस कहा जाता है।
english_meaning: But the gift which is given expecting reciprocation, or again, with a desire for its result, and which is given grudgingly,- that is considered to be born of rajas.
practical_guidance: Practice releasing one expectation today. Do the work with full commitment, then let go of the outcome. Notice how much lighter that feels.

sanskrit_text: अदेशकाले यद्दानमपात्रेभ्यश्च दीयते। असत्कृतमवज्ञातं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्
transliteration: adeśakāle yaddānamapātrebhyaśca dīyate, asatkṛtamavajñātaṃ tattāmasamudāhṛtam
hindi_meaning: जो दान बिना सत्कारके तथा अवज्ञापूर्वक अयोग्य देश और कालमें कुपात्रको दिया जाता है, वह दान तामस कहा गया है।
english_meaning: The gift which is made at an improper place and time, and to undeserving persons, without proper treatment and with disdain, is declared to be born of tamas.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: ॐ तत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः। ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा
transliteration: oṃ tatsaditi nirdeśo brahmaṇastrividhaḥ smṛtaḥ, brāhmaṇāstena vedāśca yajñāśca vihitāḥ purā
hindi_meaning: ऊँ, तत् और सत् -- इन तीनों नामोंसे जिस परमात्माका निर्देश किया गया है, उसी परमात्माने सृष्टिके आदिमें वेदों, ब्राह्मणों और यज्ञोंकी रचना की है।
english_meaning: 'Om-tat-sat' ['Om, That, Existence': 'Om iti brahma, Om is Brahman' (Tai. 1.8.1); 'Tattvamasi, Thou art That' (Ch. 6.8.7); and 'Sadeva somya idamagra asit, This was Existence alone in the beginning, O amiable one' (Ch. 6.2.1)-in these texts Brahman is indicated by the words Om, tat, sat.]-this is considered to be the threefold designation of Brahman. The Brahmanas and Vedas and the sacrifices were ordanined by that in the days of yore.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: तस्मादोमित्युदाहृत्य यज्ञदानतपःक्रियाः। प्रवर्तन्ते विधानोक्ताः सततं ब्रह्मवादिनाम्
transliteration: tasmādomityudāhṛtya yajñadānatapaḥkriyāḥ, pravartante vidhānoktāḥ satataṃ brahmavādinām
hindi_meaning: इसलिये वैदिक सिद्धान्तोंको माननेवाले पुरुषोंकी शास्त्रविधिसे नियत यज्ञ, दान और तपरूप क्रियाएँ सदा 'ऊँ' इस परमात्माके नामका उच्चारण करके ही आरम्भ होती हैं।
english_meaning: Therefore, acts of sacrifice, charity and austerity as prescribed through injunctions, of those who study and expound the Vedas, always commence after uttering the syllable Om.
practical_guidance: Identify the most important duty calling you today. Do it with full heart, without bargaining with results. The effort itself is the offering.

sanskrit_text: तदित्यनभिसन्धाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः। दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षिभि:
transliteration: tadityanabhisandhāya phalaṃ yajñatapaḥkriyāḥ, dānakriyāśca vividhāḥ kriyante mokṣakāṅkṣibhi:
hindi_meaning: 'तत्' नामसे कहे जानेवाले परमात्माके लिये ही सब कुछ है -- ऐसा मानकर मुक्ति चाहनेवाले मनुष्योंद्वारा फलकी इच्छासे रहित होकर अनेक प्रकारकी यज्ञ और तपरूप क्रियाएँ तथा दानरूप क्रियाएँ की जाती हैं।
english_meaning: After (uttering) the word tat, acts of sacrifice and austerity as also the various acts of charity are performed without regard for results by persons aspiring for Liberation.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: सद्भावे साधुभावे च सदित्येतत्प्रयुज्यते। प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते
transliteration: sadbhāve sādhubhāve ca sadityetatprayujyate, praśaste karmaṇi tathā sacchabdaḥ pārtha yujyate
hindi_meaning: हे पार्थ ! परमात्माके 'सत्'--इस नामका सत्तामात्रमें और श्रेष्ठ भावमें प्रयोग किया जाता है तथा प्रशंसनीय कर्मके साथ 'सत्' शब्द जोड़ा जाता है।
english_meaning: This word sat is used with regard to (something) coming into being and with regard to (someone) becoming good. So also, O son of Prtha, the word sat is used with regard to an auspicious rite.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते। कर्म चैव तदर्थीयं सदित्येवाभिधीयते
transliteration: yajñe tapasi dāne ca sthitiḥ saditi cocyate, karma caiva tadarthīyaṃ sadityevābhidhīyate
hindi_meaning: यज्ञ, तप और दानरूप क्रियामें जो स्थिति (निष्ठा) है, वह भी 'सत्' -- ऐसे कही जाती है और उस परमात्माके निमित्त किया जानेवाला कर्म भी 'सत्' -- ऐसा ही कहा जाता है।
english_meaning: And the steadfastness in sacrifice, austerity and charity is spoken of as sat. And even the action meant for these is, verily, called as sat (good).
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत्। असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न च तत्प्रेत्य नो इह
transliteration: aśraddhayā hutaṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat, asadityucyate pārtha na ca tatpretya no iha
hindi_meaning: हे पार्थ ! अश्रद्धासे किया हुआ हवन, दिया हुआ दान और तपा हुआ तप तथा और भी जो,कुछ किया जाय, वह सब 'असत्' -- ऐसा कहा जाता है। उसका फल न यहाँ होता है, न मरनेके बाद ही होता है अर्थात् उसका कहीं भी सत् फल नहीं होता।
english_meaning: O son of Prtha, whatever is offered in sacrifice and given in charity, as also whatever austerity is undertakne or whatever is done without, faith, is said to be of on avail. And it is of no conseence after death, nor here.
practical_guidance: When anger rises, pause before reacting. Ask: 'Is this response aligned with who I want to be?' Channel that energy into purposeful action rather than reaction.

sanskrit_text: संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम्। त्यागस्य च हृषीकेश पृथक्केशिनिषूदन
transliteration: saṃnyāsasya mahābāho tattvamicchāmi veditum, tyāgasya ca hṛṣīkeśa pṛthakkeśiniṣūdana
hindi_meaning: अर्जुन बोले -- हे महाबाहो ! हे हृषीकेश ! हे केशिनिषूदन ! मैं संन्यास और त्यागका तत्त्व अलग-अलग जानना चाहता हूँ।
english_meaning: Arjuna said O mighty-armed Hrsikesa, O slayer of (the demon) Kesi, I want to know serverally the truth about sannyasa as also about tyaga.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः। सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं प्राहुस्त्यागं विचक्षणाः
transliteration: kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ nyāsaṃ saṃnyāsaṃ kavayo viduḥ, sarvakarmaphalatyāgaṃ prāhustyāgaṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले -- कई विद्वान् काम्यकर्मोंके त्यागको संन्यास कहते हैं और कई विद्वान् सम्पूर्ण कर्मोंके फलके त्यागको त्याग कहते हैं। कई विद्वान् कहते हैं कि कर्मोंको दोषकी तरह छोड़ देना चाहिये और कई विद्वान् कहते हैं कि यज्ञ? दान और तपरूप कर्मोंका त्याग नहीं करना चाहिये।
english_meaning: The Blessed Lord said The learned ones know sannyasa to be the giving up of actions done with a desire for reward. The adepts call the abandonment of the results of all works as tyaga.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: त्याज्यं दोषवदित्येके कर्म प्राहुर्मनीषिणः। यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यमिति चापरे
transliteration: tyājyaṃ doṣavadityeke karma prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ, yajñadānatapaḥkarma na tyājyamiti cāpare
hindi_meaning: श्रीभगवान् बोले -- कई विद्वान् काम्य-कर्मोंके त्यागको संन्यास कहते हैं और कई विद्वान् सम्पूर्ण कर्मोंके फलके त्यागको त्याग कहते हैं। कई विद्वान् कहते हैं कि कर्मोंको दोषकी तरह छोड़ देना चाहिये और कई विद्वान् कहते हैं कि यज्ञ, दान और तप-रूप कर्मोंका त्याग नहीं करना चाहिये।
english_meaning: Some learned persons say that action, beset with evil (as it is), should be given up, and others (say) that the practice of sacrifice, charity and austertiy should not be given up.
practical_guidance: Do your best work today without tracking who notices or what you'll receive. The quality of your effort is the practice itself.

sanskrit_text: निश्चयं श्रृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम। त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः संप्रकीर्तितः
transliteration: niścayaṃ śrṛṇu me tatra tyāge bharatasattama, tyāgo hi puruṣavyāghra trividhaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ
hindi_meaning: हे भरतवंशियोंमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुन ! तू संन्यास और त्याग -- इन दोनोंमेंसे पहले त्यागके विषयमें मेरा निश्चय सुन; क्योंकि हे पुरुषश्रेष्ठ ! त्याग तीन प्रकारका कहा गया है।
english_meaning: O the most excellent among the descendants of Bharata, hear from Me the firm conclusion regarding that tyaga. For, O greatest among men, tyaga has been clearly declared to be of three kinds.
practical_guidance: True wisdom comes from experience, reflection, and stillness. Read this verse slowly today. Let one insight land fully before moving on.

sanskrit_text: यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यं कार्यमेव तत्। यज्ञो दानं तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम्
transliteration: yajñadānatapaḥkarma na tyājyaṃ kāryameva tat, yajño dānaṃ tapaścaiva pāvanāni manīṣiṇām
hindi_meaning: यज्ञ, दान और तपरूप कर्मोंका त्याग नहीं करना चाहिये, प्रत्युत उनको तो करना ही चाहिये क्योंकि यज्ञ, दान और तप -- ये तीनों ही कर्म मनीषियोंको पवित्र करनेवाले हैं।
